title: Gangtok Pelling Tour
name: Gangtok Pelling Tour
page_title: Gangtok Pelling Tour 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Discover the serene beauty of Gangtok and Pelling on this 5-day tour. Explore lush landscapes, historic monasteries, and breathtaking views of the Himalayas in these charming destinations.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pelling)Arrival and Transfer to Pelling
itinerary.text: Our representative will be there to receive the Guest at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) – He will be assisting for the transfer to Pelling – Transfer to Pelling (140 kilometers 5 ½ - 6 hours) – C heck in to the hotel – Pelling is at an altitude of 6800 feet / 2072 meters – On a clear day guest can get a clear view of Himalayan range with snow capped mount Pandim, Kumbhakarna, Rathong, Khangchendzonga, Zopuno, Shimbho, Narsing, Sinolchu etc - Evening one is free to stroll around this small settlement - It is one of the exotic settlement with varieties of Rhododendron, Orchids and wildlife - Check into hotel – Evening free to roam around the helipad or Shopping center - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pelling)Pelling Local sightseeing (Full Day)
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel – Drive for Full Day Sight Seeing of Pelling and its surroundings - The routes are forested and the botanical and zoological richness is inspiring - Places of visit are Rimbi water Falls, Rimbi Rock Garden, Kechopalri Lake , it is one of the holy Buddhist lake and it is believed that any wish in front of the lake comes true - Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird and thus the water surface is always free of leaves , Kechopalri Monastery, Kanchenjunga water Falls, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdantse ruins, the scenic view from the top of the ruin to the mystic heights of Kanchendzonga ranges is something to be cherished – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around the helipad or Shopping center - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gangtok)Transfer from Pelling to Gangtok & Gangtok Local Sight Seeing (Half Day)
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast – Transfer from Pelling to Gangtok – Nearly 135 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours - Gangtok – The capital of the 22 nd State of India, Sikkim is one of the most beautiful hill station with varied options for tourist – It is known for the monastery, Orchids, High altitude Lake, hot water spring, majestic Himalayan range and butterflies – Check into Hotel – Drive for visit to Directorate of Handicrafts & Handloom, Research Institute of Tibetology, Do Drul Chorten (Stupa), Enchey Monastery, White Hall, Flower Show, etc – Back to hotel – Evening free - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)
itinerary.text:
Morning breakfast at hotel – Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir nearly 40 kilometers and 2 hours drive along the Kyongnosla Alpine Sanctuary, the home to the red panda and the blood pheasant with Rhododendron and other alpine trees along the road - Situated at an elevation of 3753 meters / 12310 feet - The Lake is oval shaped lake nearly 50 feet deep - Generally covered in snow for most of the year the year – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir known to be a very holy site for all - Nathu La Pass to Republic of China is nearly 20 kilometers and is optional tour - Back to Gangtok - Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Lachung)Excursion to Gurudongmar Lake and Transfer to Lachung -
itinerary.text: Early morning breakfast – Visit to Gurudongmar Lake 55 kilometers, 2 ½ - 3 ½ hours drive - A valley at an altitude of 11, 800 feet through which Lachen Chu flows, generally covered with snow from December to April or even more is known as the Holy / Sacred Lake - Next drive through the cold desert till Tibet / China back to Resort for Lunch – After lunch drive to Lachung - The region is fully covered with Rhododendron forest with Chopta Valley and Thangu are the other places of interest - Back to hotel for lunch - After lunch proceed to Lachung – Nearly 50 kilometers and two hours drive – Check into hotel at Lachung - Evening free to visit Lachung Monastery - Overnight stay at Hotel at Lachung

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Gangtok)Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.text: After breakfast leave for Gangtok - 125 kilometers, 4 – 5 hours drive - On the way stops at Singhik and Mangan - If the weather is fine and the sky is clear one can enjoy the view of Himalayan range with mount Kanchenjunga, mount Pandim, mount Kabru, mount Simvo, mount Jopuno, mount Khanchendzonga and mount Siniolchu - Various location offers a majestic view of these peaks hence photography will consume some time – The drive will be smooth due to the scenic beauty as in spring the forest cover erupts in a riot of colors as Rhododendrons, Primulae and many other Alpine Flowers are in full bloom - Back to Gangtok Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gangtok)Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri railway station, where our driver meets you for the drive to Gangtok (about 125 km, 4–5 hours) along the Teesta river. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to explore MG Marg, Gangtok's car-free main street, lined with shops, cafés and restaurants. Gangtok sits on a ridge with views of the Kanchenjunga range on clear days. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gangtok)Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir excursion
itinerary.text: Leave early for Tsomgo (Changu) Lake at about 12,400 ft, a glacial lake that is frozen in winter and surrounded by mountains. Continue to the Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir. A visit to Nathu La on the India–China border is optional and depends on permits; it is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. Return to Gangtok in the afternoon; the evening is free. Overnight stay in Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pelling)Gangtok to Pelling
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Pelling (about 5–6 hours) in West Sikkim. On the way you can stop at Namchi to see Siddhesvara Dham (Char Dham) and the giant statue of Guru Padmasambhava at Samdruptse hill. After checking in at your hotel in Pelling, the evening is free to explore the small local market or relax with views of Kanchenjunga. Overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pelling)Pelling Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Pelling. Visit Pemayangtse Monastery, one of the oldest in Sikkim, and the Rabdentse ruins, the second capital of the old kingdom of Sikkim, with fine views of the valley. Then see the skywalk and Sangachoeling Monastery, the sacred Khecheopalri Lake in the forest, and the Rimbi and Kanchenjunga waterfalls. Return to your hotel for the overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kalimpong)Pelling to Kalimpong
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Kalimpong (about 4–5 hours). After checking in at your hotel, begin your sightseeing with Deolo Hill, the highest point in Kalimpong, Dr. Graham's Homes, founded in 1900, the Mangal Dham temple and the Pine View Nursery, known for its cactus collection. The evening is free to rest. Overnight stay in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kalimpong)Kalimpong Local Sightseeing and Leisure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue exploring Kalimpong. Visit the Zang Dhok Palri Phodang monastery, which holds rare Tibetan scriptures, Durpin Dara hill with its views of the Teesta valley, and the Tharpa Choling monastery. The afternoon is free to explore the local markets, known for orchids and handicrafts, or simply relax in the quiet of the hills. Overnight stay in Kalimpong.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Kalimpong)Departure from Kalimpong
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kalimpong. Our driver takes you down to Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri railway station (about 3–4 hours) for your onward journey. Enjoy the last views of the Teesta river and the hills on the way. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 6 :(Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour

title: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour
name: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour
page_title: Jewels of Leh Ladakh Tour 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Discover the charm of Kashmir with our 5-day Jewels of Leh Ladakh tour package. Explore the valley's beauty, experience the thrill of adventure, and create unforgettable memories.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrive Leh - Leisure
itinerary.text: On your arrival at Leh airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to the Hotel. Check in to the hotel and the rest of the day is for leisure. A complete rest of the day is necessary for the rest of the day to accustom you and to the obscure air at the high altitude. Leh is situated at the height of 11563 feet. Evening visit Shanti Stupa. Later visit the market (stay for 01hour only). Return back to the hotel for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)LEH – Excursion to Sham Valley Upto Sangam; Monastery Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, you drive downstream along the River Indus on Leh – Kargil Highway. And start our sightseeing with Hall of Fame (Museum Constructed by India Army) near Leh is worth a visit for every Indian, and proceed further to GurudwaraPatthar Sahib Nestled deep in the Himalayas, A drive of another 4 km took us to Magnetic Hill which defies the law of gravity & further Driving through a picturesque landscape we reached the Confluence Of The Indus And Zanskar River. After visiting places we drive back to Leh en route visiting Spituk Monastery, Built-in 15th century during the reign of Grags ‘bum-lde, this new Gelug-pa monastery was built like the fortress on the summit of crags. Later proceed for Indus Valley Monastery Starting with Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism, Thiksey Monastery an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village, Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh, 3 Idiots Rancho School & Sindhu Ghat. After visiting places we drive back to Leh. Evening at leisure to explore the city on your own. Return back to the hotel for Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh–Nubra Valley Via Khardung La 18,390 FT. (120 KMS / 5 – 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Post breakfast drives to Nubra Valley. The road journey from Leh to Nubra Valley passes over Khardung La (The Highest Motorable Road In The World) at 5,602 Mtrs / 18,390 Ft, around 39 km from Leh. From the pass, one can see all the way south over the Indus valley to seemingly endless peaks and ridges of the Zanskar range, and north to the giants of the Sasser massif. Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldumra or the valley of flowers. It is situated in the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. The average altitude of the valley is 10,000 Ft. above sea level.
Upon arrival in Nubra, we check in at our Camp / Hotel for Overnight stay. In the evening you can walk around the tiny villages to see how the locals live in this part of the world. A visit to a Ladakhi home can be arranged. Overnight Stay at the Camp or Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley to Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Diskit Monastery, the oldest in Nubra, with its large Maitreya Buddha statue overlooking the valley. Then drive back to Leh (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) over Khardung La by the private vehicle included for transfers. On arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure in Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Leh)Pangong Lake excursion
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, set out on an excursion to Pangong Lake (about 140 km each way) over the Chang La pass. The lake, which stretches into Tibet, changes colour from blue to green with the light. Spend time by the shore for photographs before driving back to Leh in the evening. It is a long day, so carry warm clothes and water. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, the time is free until your departure; check-out time is 12 noon. You can visit Leh market for last-minute shopping for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. You are then transferred to Leh airport for your onward flight; the departure transfer is included. With this, your Leh Ladakh tour ends.

title: Kalimpong With Gangtok pelling and darjeeling Tour
name: Kalimpong With Gangtok pelling and darjeeling Tour
page_title: Kalimpong With Gangtok pelling and darjeeling Tour 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on an 8-day journey through Kalimpong, Gangtok, Pelling, and Darjeeling. Discover the mesmerizing landscapes, rich culture, and scenic beauty of Northeast India with our expertly curated tour package.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kalimpong)Arrival & Transfer to Kalimpong
itinerary.text: Our representative will be there to receive the Guest at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) - He will assist guest to proceed to Kalimpong - Nearly 85 Kilometers, 3 ½ - 4 Hours - Kalimpong is a historical destination on the old silk route - It is situated on the foothills of the Himalayas at an elevation of 1243 meters / 4078 feet - Kalimpong is a hill station buzzing with colorful people with lovely orchids, Gladiolus, rarest cacti and nurseries and offers spectacular views of the Mount Kanchendzonga and its range - It is ideal setting with milder climate for walks - Check into Hotel / resort – Evening free to roam around the local market or nursery - Over night stay at Kalimpong

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gangtok)Sight Seeing in Kalimpong & Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast in hotel – Drive for sight seeing at Kalimpong - Drive for sight seeing tour through scenic road to Forest Museum (Closed On Thursday), Deolo Hill, Hanuman Mandir, Dr Graham Homes, Durbin Monastery, Mangaldham, Pine View Nurseries (Cactus Only) - Transfer to Gangtok – 130 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours - Gangtok – The capital of the 22 nd State of India, Sikkim is one of the most beautiful hill station with varied options for tourist – It is known for the monastery, Orchids, High altitude Lake and butterflies – Gangtok is the hub of all tourist activities – Lachung, Lachen, Pelling, Namchi and other places of interest are all access able from here - Check into Hotel – Evening free to roam around M G Road or Lal Market - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gangtok)Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir (Full Day)
itinerary.text: Morning breakfast at hotel – Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir nearly 40 kilometers and 2 hours drive along the Kyongnosla Alpine Sanctuary, the home to the red panda and the blood pheasant with Rhododendron and other alpine trees along the road - Situated at an elevation of 3753 meters / 12310 feet - The Lake is oval shaped lake nearly 50 feet deep - Generally covered in snow for most of the year the year – This lake is home to the Brahmini ducks & many migratory birds – Nearby is the sacred Baba Mandir known to be a very holy site for all - Nathu La Pass to Republic of China is nearly 20 kilometers and is optional tour - Back to Gangtok - Evening free to roam around M G Road (Mall) or local Shopping center - Over Night stay at Gangtok

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pelling)Sight Seeing at Gangtok (Half Day) & Transfer to Pelling
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel, depart for Half day city tour of Gangtok - Visit the Directorate of Handicrafts and Handlooms, Research Institute of Tibetology, Chorten (Stupa), Flower Show - Next a drive of 140 kilometers 3 ½ - 4 hours through scenic road – Pelling is situated at an altitude of 2072 meters / 6800 feet - On a clear day guest can get a clear view of Himalayan range with snow capped mount Pandim, Kumbhakarna, Rathong, Khangchendzonga, Zopuno, Shimbho, Narsing, Sinolchu etc - It is one of the exotic settlement with varieties of Rhododendron, Orchids, historical sites, short trek routes and wildlife – Its botanical and zoological richness is inspiring - Yuksom, Ravangla, Rinchenpong and Namchi are some of the tourist spot nearby – Check into hotel - Evening free to roam around the small settlement - Over Night stay atPelling

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pelling)Pelling Local sightseeing (Full Day)
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel – Drive for Full Day Sight Seeing. The routes are forested and the botanical and zoological richness is inspiring. Places of visit are Rimbi water Falls, Rimbi Rock Garden, Kechopalri Lake , it is one of the holy Buddhist lake and it is believed that any wish in front of the lake comes true - Myth is that when a leaf falls on the placid clear water surface, it is picked by a bird and thus the water surface is always free of leaves , Kechopalri Monastery, Kanchenjunga water Falls, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdantse ruins, the scenic view from the top of the ruin to the mystic heights of Kanchendzonga ranges is something to be cherished – Back to hotel – Evening free to roam around the helipad or Shopping center - Over Night stay at Pelling

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Darjeeling)Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.text: After breakfast at hotel and then forwarding journey to Darjeeling – The road is scenic and pass through Gyalsing and Jorethang - Transferto Darjeeling takes nearly 135 Kilometers 3 – 3 ½ hours – It is situated t an height of 2123 meters / 70001 feet - It is a land of breathtaking beauty, sloping tea gardens with spectacular views of the Mount Everest is the Queen of the hills – Darjeeling is home to many international Schools and few of the internationally famous site like Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, etc – It is also home to the famous World Heritage train – The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR) - Check into hotel – Evening free - Over Night stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Darjeeling)Darjeeling Local Sight Seeing (Half Day)
itinerary.text: Early morning at around3:45 AM drive to 8000 feet / 2440 meters through primitive forests of oak, magnolia to Tiger Hill to view sunrise over Kanchendzonga Peak (subject to clear weather) – On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia Loop – On the way back visit Ghoom Monastery, Peace memorial & Batasia Loop – Back to hotel for breakfast - After breakfast rest for half an hour After breakfast next round of sight seeing - Half Day city tour includes Padmaja Naidu Zoological Park, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Closed on Thursday), Ropeway, Tensing Gumpo Rock, Tibetan Refugee Self Help Center (Closed on Sunday), Tea Estate, Natural History Museum (Sunday Closed), Peace Pagoda – Back to hotel – Evening free to stroll around the area - Overnight stay at Darjeeling

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Darjeeling)Departure – Darjeeling to Siliguri New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand (Junction) -
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Darjeeling. Our driver takes you down via Mirik, with its lake and tea gardens, to Siliguri (about 105 km, 3½–4 hours), with the drop at New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP), Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or the Tenzing Norgay Bus Stand, as you need. Start early so there is no rush. The tour ends at your drop point.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kovalam)Arrival in Trivandrum and transfer to Kovalam
itinerary.text: Arrive in Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), where our driver meets you and transfers you to Kovalam (about 16 km). After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is at leisure. Kovalam is known for its three crescent-shaped beaches; Lighthouse Beach is the liveliest, with cafés and a fine view of the sunset. You can also book an optional Ayurvedic massage, paid directly. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kovalam)Kanyakumari day excursion
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive to Kanyakumari (about 85 km, 2–3 hours), the southern tip of mainland India where the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean meet. Take the ferry to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and see the Thiruvalluvar statue (ferry tickets paid locally), and visit the Kumari Amman Temple. En route you can stop at the Padmanabhapuram Palace (closed on Mondays). Watch the sunset if time allows, then return to Kovalam for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kovalam)Trivandrum sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive into Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), about 16 km away, for a half-day city tour. Visit the area of the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (entry for Hindus only, with a dress code), the Napier Museum with its Indo-Saracenic architecture, the art gallery nearby, and the Kuthiramalika Palace Museum. Return to Kovalam in the afternoon to relax on the beach or book an optional Ayurvedic massage. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Trivandrum)Departure from Trivandrum
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and enjoy a last stroll along Lighthouse Beach if time allows. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 16 km) for your onward journey, with memories of Kovalam's beaches and the meeting of three seas at Kanyakumari. The tour ends here.

title: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar
name: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar
page_title: Manali with Dharamshala and amritsar 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the best of Manali, Dharamshala, and Amritsar with our 5-night, 6-day tour. Enjoy scenic landscapes, local sightseeing, and cultural experiences at destinations like Rohtang Pass, Dal Lake, Golden Temple, and more. Book your Himachal adventure now!

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Manali)Chandigarh to Manali (350 kms/9 hrs)
itinerary.text: Our driver picks you up in Chandigarh for the drive to Manali (about 310 km, 8–9 hours) through the Kullu valley, following the Beas river past Mandi and the Pandoh dam. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel. The evening is free to rest or take a short walk on the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Also visit Marhi, Rahalla Falls, Nehru Kund (Cold Water Spring-Named by Late PM Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru). Return back to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Amritsar)Dharamshala to Amritsar via Wagah Border & Local Sightseeing (220 Kms, 6 Hours)
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, check out of your hotel and drive from Dharamshala to Amritsar (about 200 km, 5 hours). itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Arrival in Cochin and drive to Munnar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Cochin airport or railway station, where our driver meets you for the drive to Munnar (about 130 km, 4 hours). On the way you pass spice plantations and the Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Munnar is surrounded by rolling tea estates and misty hills. After checking in at your hotel, the evening is free to relax or walk in the small town. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Munnar sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out to explore Munnar. itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Alleppey)Munnar to Alleppey

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kovalam)Departure from Trivandrum

title: Panorama Ladakh tour
name: Panorama Ladakh Tour
page_title: Panorama Ladakh tour 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a breathtaking 6 nights and 7 days Ladakh tour. Experience the stunning landscapes, rich culture, and serene monasteries of Ladakh in this immersive travel adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrive Leh - day free to relax and acclimatize
itinerary.text: On your arrival at Leh airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to the Hotel. Check in to the hotel and the rest of the day is for leisure. A complete rest for the day is necessary for the rest of the day to accustom you and to the obscure air at the high altitude. Leh is situated at the height of 11563 feet. Evening visit Shanti Stupa. Later visit the market (stay for 01hour only). Return back to the hotel for Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)LEH – Excursion to Sham Valley Upto Sangam; Monastery Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive west from Leh through the Sham valley along the Indus. Stop at the Hall of Fame war museum, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib and Magnetic Hill, where vehicles seem to roll uphill, and continue to the Sangam, where the Zanskar river meets the Indus. On the way back, visit one of the region's monasteries such as Spituk or Phyang. Return to Leh for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh–Nubra Valley Via Khardunga La 18,390 FT. (120 KMS / 5 – 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Post breakfast drives to Nubra Valley. The road journey from Leh to Nubra Valley passes over Khardung La (The Highest Motorable Road In The World) at 5,602 Mtrs / 18,390 Ft, around 39 km from Leh. From the pass, one can see all the way south over the Indus valley to seemingly endless peaks and ridges of the Zanskar range, and north to the giants of the Sasser massif. Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldumra or the valley of flowers. It is situated in the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. The average altitude of the valley is 10,000 Ft. above sea level.
Upon arrival in Nubra, we check in at our Camp / Hotel in Hunder for Overnight stay. In the evening you can walk around the tiny villages to see how the locals live in this part of the world. A visit to a Ladakhi home can be arranged. Overnight Stay at the Camp or Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Leh)Nubra Valley – LEH
itinerary.text:
It is indeed a strange sight as one side of the road are rocky mountains that characterize the Ladakhi landscape and in the distance can be seen snow-capped mountains. On the return stop at Diskit which is the headquarter town of Nubra Valley. Stroll around the bazaar observing the shops and local people going about their daily chores. Diskit is famous for 515 years old Buddhist Monastery, lying magnificently situated on a hilltop, facing the entire Valley.
Later drive back to Leh in the late afternoon via Khardungla Top. On arrival at Leh, you will check in to your Hotel. In the afternoon you can rest and relax. Overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pangong)Leh to Pangong Lake (140 KMS / 4 - 5 HRS – ONE WAY)
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, we leave for Pangong Lake en route visiting Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh & 3 Idiots Rancho School& further 5 Kms Driving through a picturesque landscape and reach Thiksey, an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village. After visiting two monasteries we drive further towards Changla Pass 5486 Mtrs. The long easy ascent takes you to Changla pass through its winding roads passing through Sakti Village. Stop at the Changla Pass for a quick photo session and drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea. Leaving Tangtse for Pangong you pass through few small villages of Changthang and finally, you can have a sudden view of the Pangong Lake situated at 14,000 feet (4,267 m). This famous blue brackish Lake of Pangong is 5/6 Kms wide and over 133 Kms long with half of its running the other side of the "Indo China Border". One rarely feels so close to nature and environment and the scenery is unforgettable. Upon arrival, check-in at the Camp Near Pangong lake. Dinner & Overnight at the Camp.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Leh)Pangong Lake To Leh (140 KMS / 6 HRS)
itinerary.text:
Morning at leisure to explore the beauty of the lake and later we drive back to Leh en route visiting Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism. Drive further to Leh and check in at our hotel for Overnight
In the evening you can stroll around the marketplace for some last minute souvenir shopping.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Leh)Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Leh. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping in Leh market for pashmina, apricots or Tibetan handicrafts. Our driver then transfers you to Leh airport (Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport) for your flight home. The tour ends here.

name: Special Leh Ladakh Tour
page_title: Special Leh Ladakh Tour 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the beauty of Leh Ladakh with our 4 nights and 5 days special tour. Discover the mesmerizing landscapes, ancient monasteries, and unique culture on this unforgettable journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrival in Leh
itinerary.text: Arrive at Leh's Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport; the arrival transfer to your hotel is included. Leh is at about 3,500 m, so the rest of the day is for rest and acclimatisation; drink plenty of water and avoid exertion. In the evening, if you feel well, take a gentle walk to the Shanti Stupa for sunset views over Leh, or stroll in the market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)Leh-Excursion to Monastries-Leh
itinerary.text: Post Breakfast we proceed for Indus Valley Monastery Starting with Hemis Gompa, the largest monastic foundation of Drukpa Kagyu Order of Tibetan Buddhism, Thiksey Monastery an impressive complex rising tier upon tier on a hill above the village, Shey Palace, The ancient capital of Ladakh, 3 Idiots Rancho School & Sindhu Ghat. After visiting these places we drive back to Leh. Evening at leisure to explore the city on your own. Dinner & Overnight at the Hotel

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Leh) Leh-Excursion to Pangong Lake-Leh
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, we leave for Pangong Lake through Changla pass 5486 Mtrs. The long easy ascent takes you to Changla pass through its winding roads passing through Sakti Village. Stop at the Changla Pass for a quick photograph session and drive down to the village of Tangtse, where you can relax for a cup of tea. Leaving Tangtse for Pangong you pass through few small villages of Changthang and finally, you can have a sudden view of the Pangong Lake situated at 14,000 feet (4,267 m). This famous blue brackish Lake of Pangong is 5/6 Kms wide and over 133 Kms long with half of its running the other side of the "INDO CHINA BORDER". title: Srinagar Gulmarg Pahalgam Tour
name: Srinagar Gulmarg Pahalgam Tour
page_title: Srinagar Gulmarg Pahalgam Tour 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the enchanting beauty of Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam with our 7-day tour package. Discover serene landscapes, snow-capped mountains, and cultural richness in this unforgettable Kashmir journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Srinagar)Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport, where our driver meets you and transfers you to your houseboat on Dal Lake or Nigeen Lake. After check-in, the rest of the day is free to settle in and enjoy the calm of the lake. In the late afternoon you can take an optional shikara ride to watch the floating vegetable gardens, lakeside homes and the Zabarwan hills reflected in the water. Dinner and overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Srinagar)Srinagar sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, set out on a half-day tour of Srinagar's Mughal gardens: Nishat Bagh, the "garden of pleasure", Shalimar Bagh, laid out by Emperor Jahangir, and the terraced Chashme Shahi spring garden. Depending on time, you can also visit the Hazratbal shrine on the banks of Dal Lake. The rest of the afternoon is free for the local markets, known for pashmina, papier-mâché and dry fruits. Return to Srinagar for dinner and the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gulmarg)Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Gulmarg (about 56 km, 2 hours), a meadow resort ringed by snow-capped peaks. After checking in, enjoy the open meadows on foot or by pony. You can ride the Gulmarg Gondola, one of the highest cable cars in the world, for close views of the Himalaya; Gondola tickets and pony rides are paid locally. In winter Gulmarg is covered in snow and popular for skiing. Overnight stay in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pahalgam)Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Pahalgam (about 150 km, 4–5 hours) in the Lidder valley. En route you pass saffron fields near Pampore and can stop at the ruins of the Avantipur temples. Pahalgam sits where the Lidder river meets pine forests and green slopes. After checking in, spend the evening walking along the river or in the small local market. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pahalgam)Pahalgam sightseeing
itinerary.text: A full day to explore Pahalgam and its valleys. Popular excursions include Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari, the starting point of the Amarnath Yatra; these are reached by local union vehicles, paid directly. You can also take a gentle pony ride to Baisaran meadow, often called "mini Switzerland". Alternatively, relax by the Lidder river and enjoy the quiet of the valley. Return to your hotel in the evening for dinner and the overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Srinagar (about 95 km, 3 hours). After checking in at your hotel or houseboat, the afternoon is free. You can visit the old city and the Jamia Masjid, shop for Kashmiri handicrafts at the government emporium, or take a sunset shikara ride on Dal Lake if you did not do so on the first day. This is a relaxed last evening in the valley. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Srinagar)Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out at leisure. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping for saffron, walnuts or shawls. Our driver then transfers you to Srinagar airport for your onward journey, taking home memories of the lakes, gardens and meadows of Kashmir. The tour ends here.

description: Experience the beauty of Kashmir with our 5-day Srinagar Gulmarg Pahalgam tour package. Enjoy sightseeing, delicious meals, comfortable accommodation, and much more. Book now and create unforgettable memories!

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pahalgam)Arrival Srinagar Airport to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Arrival on Srinagar Airport you will be met our representative and transfer from Srinagar to Pahalgam by taxi for 02 nights stay. Pahalgam (2133 mts ) also known as ‘The valley of Shepherds or Trekker's Paradise. Pahalgam is the most famous place for Indian Film Industry. On the way visit Awantipura ruins, Saffron fields One of the most beautiful places on earth, the town of Pahalgam offers breath-taking views. One can just enjoy the town of Pahalgam trek to some of the most beautiful places on earth. Pahalgam is also the entry point for the famous Amarnath Cave, a holy site for Hindus. Overnight in hotel in Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pahalgam)Pahalgam Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: A full day in Pahalgam to explore the valley and its surroundings. You can hire a pony to ride to Baisaran meadow, often called "mini Switzerland", and other viewpoints such as Kashmir Valley point and Dabian; pony rides are paid locally. Local union vehicles can take you to Aru Valley, Betaab Valley and Chandanwari at extra cost. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gulmarg)Pahalgam to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: After early breakfast at hotel drive from Pahalgam to Gulmarg by taxi for overnight stay. (8700 ft i.e. 2652 mts ), Discovered by the Kashmiri romantic poet in the 16th century who was inspired with its grassy slopes covered with wild flowers. In winter Gulmarg looks more beautiful due to heavy snow fall. And turns into India's premier Ski resort in winter. The Gondola Cable Car (optional) offers rides to the upland meadows of Kongdori and beyond to the top of Apharwat range to a height of 14000 ft for viewing the Himalayan Peaks in summer and for downhill skiing in winter. One can have Gondola ride (cable car directly payable) from Gulmarg to Khalinmarg . Overnight in hotel in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Srinagar)Gulmarg to Srinagar
itinerary.text:
After breakfast at hotel drive from Gulmarg to Srinagar by taxi for overnight stay. Check in at deluxe houseboat.
Later on proceed to famous Nishat Garden known as ‘Garden of pleasure' built in 16th century (1633) by Mughal King Asif Khan. Then visiting Shalimar Garden known as ‘Garden of love' built in 16th century (1619) by Mughal King Jehangir for his beloved wife Noor Jehan or ( Mehr -un- Nissa ). Evening enjoy the Shikara Ride on the famous Dal Lake to enjoy the beauty that God has graced this city, which is often compared to Venice. You will get a lovely view of some interesting places around the lake. Overnight stay in deluxe houseboat in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Srinagar)Srinagar to Sonmarg Tour (Day Trip) 196 Kms
itinerary.text: Full day excursion to Sonmarg Tour which is the most beautiful drive from Srinagar. On the way we stop at many beautiful spots. Continue drive to Sonmarg 2690 Mtrs (Meadow of Gold). One can ride on horse to visit Thajiwas Glacier where snow remains round the year and Sonmarg is known as Gateway of Ladakh . In the evening return to Houseboat. Overnight at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Srinagar – Departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast at your houseboat or hotel, visit the Shankaracharya Temple on its hilltop overlooking Dal Lake and Srinagar, a short climb of steps from the car park. Then our driver transfers you to Srinagar airport for your onward flight, with plenty of memories of Pahalgam, Gulmarg, Sonmarg and the lakes of Srinagar. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Guirim)Arrival in Goa

itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Kuala Lumpur on your own. itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pattaya)Kuala Lumpur-Pattaya
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok on your own. itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pattaya)Pattaya sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore Pattaya on your own. itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bangkok)Pattaya to Bangkok

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Bangkok)Bangkok sightseeing

title: Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi
name: Do Dham Tour Package
page_title: Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi | Sacred Pilgrimage Tour
description: Embark on a spiritual journey with the Yamunotri Gangotri Do Dham Yatra from Delhi. Explore the holy shrines of Yamunotri and Gangotri, surrounded by the serene beauty of the Himalayas. Book your Do Dham pilgrimage package today!

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival At Delhi And Drive To Haridwar
itinerary.text:
On your arrival at Delhi airport, our airport representative will welcome and escort you to Haridwar. Upon arrival at Haridwar, check into your hotel. Then, in the evening, you can engage in Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri on your own, if possible, with available time and conditions. Enjoy the evening roaming around this spiritual town. We will spend the night at Haridwar.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Har Ki Pauri or Other sights on the edge of Ganga on your own.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Haridwar To Barkot Via Mussoorie
itinerary.text:
After having early morning breakfast, we take a bath in Ganga. Generally, we drive for approximately seven hours with a comfortable ride, stopping for short break at Kempty fall, if preferred. Otherwise, we will move continuously without stopping, and we can reach within six hours. Mostly, during peak season, there will be a massive rush in Mussoorie, so sometimes we divert the way to Barkot via Vikas Nagar. If we need to redirect the way, we should leave sightseeing around Kempty falls while returning. On our way, we will be visiting places such as Satya Narayan Temple in Haridwar, Prakasheshwar temple in Dehradun, and Kempty fall in Mussoorie. After reaching Barkot, we will check into the hotel, have dinner, and retire for the night.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Har Ki Pauri or Other sights on the edge of Ganga on your own.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Barkot To Yamunotri, Return To Barkot
itinerary.text:
Waking up early morning, we leave for Jankichatti through Hanuman Chatti and Phool Chatti. Firstly, we will drive to Hanuman Chatti, from here we need to take local jeeps for Janki Chatti. Taking vehicles helps to reduce the distance to walk by about 8km. If you take the automobile, you will be trekking from Janki Chatti. You need to travel for 6km from here to reach Yamunotri. You will also have the choice of taking a horse or Doli. However, you need to do it on your own expense. Upon arrival at Yamunotri, most people cook rice by packing it in a cloth and dipping it in the natural hot water of the hot Kund. Pilgrims take this rice home as “Prasad.”
Also, you can take a bath in the natural warm water of Jamunabai Kund; you can offer prayer near the temple to Divya Shila. Then, you can move to the temple of Goddess Yamuna and offer your prayers before returning to Barkot. After offering prayers and enjoying the surrounding view, we trek back to Janki Chatti. Then, we will drive back to Barkot, where we will spend the night.
HANUMAN CHATTI: Hanuman Chatti is the confluence of Hanuman Ganga and Yamuna River.
YAMUNOTRI TEMPLE: Maharani Gularia of Jaipur built Yamunotri Temple in the 19th century. This temple has been destroyed and rebuilt a couple of times in the last hundred years.
SURYA KUND: Surya Kund is one of the numerous natural thermal springs in the surrounding area of the temple, which flows into several pools. Surya Kund is the most important among these multitudes of thermal springs.
DIVYA SHILA: Divya Shila is a rock pillar. There is a norm of worshipping Divya Shillal before entering the Yamunotri temple.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Janki Chatti, Bhairav Baba Temple, Yamunotri Temple, Tapt Kund– Return Via Synachatti, Ranachatti

itinerary.title: Day 4: Barkot To Uttarkashi
itinerary.text:
We will start our trip around 10 AM after having a delicious breakfast. As you might be tired due to the trek to Yamunotri, you can rest on the bus as we will be driving for around 4 hours to reach Uttarkashi. You can rest entirely on the van; the further trip will be even more tiring as we will be traveling between our destination most of the time. Driving for about four hours, we will reach Uttarkashi. Uttarkashi lies at the bank of the river Bhagirathi. On our arrival at Uttarkashi, we will pay a visit to Vishwanath Temple. There is a large iron trident erected in the Vishwanath Temple. Other famous temples in this area are Ekadash Rudra, Bhairav, Gyaneshwar, and Goddess Kuteti Devi. Visiting Vishwanath Temple, we will check in the hotel and enjoy the evening resting.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Shiv Gufa, Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Shakti Temple or Nearby Area if possible.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Uttarkashi To Ganganani To Gangotri To Harsil, Return To Uttarkashi
itinerary.text:
We will leave Uttarkashi early in the morning. On the way to Gangotri, we will visit places like Tapt Kund (a hot water spring) and Harsil village. We can also witness some magnificent views of the Himalayas. After praying at Gangotri, we will return to Uttarkashi, where we will spend the night.
GANGOTRI: Built around the 18th century, Gangotri temple is a temple dedicated to Goddess Ganga. Gorkha General Amar Singh Thapa built the temple. The temple lies near a sacred stone where King Bhagirath worshipped Lord Shiva. The sacred stone is Shivling, which is submerged in the river. This natural rock Shivling is the spot where, according to mythology, Lord Shiva sat when he received Ganga in his tangled lock. The stone is most visible during winter months when the water level decreases. There is another legend that Pandavas performed the great Deva Yagna here to atone their sins of killing their kin in the massive battle of Mahabharata. The temple is an exotic structure with a height of 20ft, made of white granite.
KEDAR GANGA SANGAM: About a hundred Yards from the Ganga Temple, the river Kedar Ganga flows. Starting from the Kedar Valle, this river meets the Bhagirathi on its left bank.
GANGNANI: If you walk further up from Gangotri, you will see a hot water spring at Gangnani. There is a Kund called Rishikund where you can have a rejuvenating bath at natural hot water spring. There is also a temple of the Sage Parashar near the spring. The sage Parashar is believed to be the father of Ved Vyas.
RITUAL AND ACTIVITIES: Perform Snan at Gangotri Ghat (VIP Ghat), Ganga Pujan & Aarti at Gangotri Ghat, Darshan of Bhagirath Shila, Darshan of Gauri Ganesha Temple, Finally Gangotri Temple Darshan after that you will offer prayer to Surya Kund. While returning from Gupteshwar Mahadev temple in Dharali, communicate with Tibetan people and learn more about their culture in Harsil.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Gangnani Kund, Harsil, Gangotri Temple

itinerary.title: Day 6: Uttarkashi To Rishikesh To Haridwar
itinerary.text:
Uttarkashi To Rishikesh To Haridwar After having early morning breakfast, we depart towards Rishikesh. On the way, we will get the gorgeous view of Tehri Lake. Rishikesh is a famous sacred town on the bank of Ganga. Shivalik range of the Himalayas bounds it on three sides. There is a belief that Raibhya Rishi did hard penance here, and the god named Rishikesh appeared, henceforth the name came to be known as Rishikesh. Upon arriving at Rishikesh, we will visit Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula on foot, as the vehicle won’t reach these places. The car will be waiting for you in the parking area. It is ideal for visiting this part of Rishikesh is by entering through Laxman Jhula and exiting from Ram Jhula. Likewise, you can see several Ghats, temples, and beautiful ashrams. Rishikesh is the second significant place for Sadhus and Saints. The site is also known as the Capital land of Yoga. If you missed Ganga Aarti before, you could engage in it after arriving at Haridwar. So, it depends on you if you want to explore around and reach Har KI Pauri, Haridwar, for Ganga Aarti. The Ganga Aarti typically starts by 6 PM in summer seasons, and 5:15 PM in winters. Those who did it before can enjoy some more time in Rishikesh and sightsee around. Or you can reach Haridwar and visit this beautiful place. As this is the last day of your trip, you can enjoy shopping in Haridwar.
POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Enroute cross Srinagar Via Dhari Devi Temple, Kirtinagar, Deo Prayag, Rishikesh, Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Return To Delhi
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, we will leave for Delhi and proceed to your destination as per your schedule. On the route, we can visit places like Daksh Temple, Shri Yantra Temple, and Maya Devi Temple. However, there is no sightseeing included in Delhi. If you want to explore Delhi, we can manage an experienced guide for you to enjoy the trip to Delhi.
1POSSIBLE SIGHT-SEEING TODAY: Daksh Temple, Shri Yantra Temple, Maya Devi Temple.

title: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni
name: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni
page_title: Amritsar, Dharamshala and Dalhousie with Jwalamukhi and Chintpurni 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A 5-night, 6-day tour from Amritsar: the Golden Temple and Wagah Border, then the Chintpurni and Jwalamukhi temples on the way to two nights in Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj, and two nights in Dalhousie with a Khajjiar day trip.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive Amritsar – Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh and Wagah Border
itinerary.text: Arrive Amritsar, transfer to hotel and check in. Visit the Golden Temple and later visit the massacre of Jalian Wallan Bagh. Afternoon little free time to rest and evening around 3 PM drive to Wagah Border to see the Closing Ceremony, event starts exactly by 5.30 PM everyday. Border closing 'lowering of the flags' ceremony is a daily military practice that the security forces of India and Pakistan.This ceremony takes place every evening before sunset at the Wagah border, which as part of the Grand Trunk Road was the only road link between these two countries before the opening of the Aman Setu in Kashmir in 1999. The ceremony starts with a blustering parade by the soldiers from both the sides and ends up in the perfectly coordinated lowering of the two nations flags, it is called the beating retreat border ceremony on the international level. One infantryman (Jawan) stands at attention on each side of the gate. As the sun sets, the iron gate at the border is opened and the flags are lowered. The flags are folded and the ceremony ends with a retreat that involves a brusque handshake between soldiers from either side. Return back to Hotel and Overnight

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dharamshala)Amritsar to Dharamshala via the Chintpurni and Jwalamukhi temples
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive into the Himachal foothills. The first stop is the Chintpurni Temple (about 170 km from Amritsar), one of the 51 Shaktipeeths, for darshan. Continue about 35 km to the Jwalamukhi Temple, known for its eternal natural flames, then drive on through the Kangra valley to Dharamshala (about 55 km). It is a long day — about 260 km in all, 8–9 hours with the darshan stops. Check in on arrival. Overnight stay in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dharamshala)Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, go up to McLeod Ganj, the seat of the Dalai Lama. Visit the Tsuglagkhang temple complex, walk to the Bhagsunag temple and waterfall, and see the church of St. John in the Wilderness among the deodar trees. Later, see the cricket stadium in Dharamshala with the Dhauladhar range behind it. The evening is free in the McLeod Ganj market for Tibetan handicrafts and cafés. Overnight stay in Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive to Dalhousie (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) through the Kangra and Chamba foothills. Dalhousie is spread over five hills among pine and deodar forests. After checking in, walk the Mall Road between Gandhi Chowk and Subhash Chowk in the evening. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dalhousie)Khajjiar day trip
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take a day trip to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide meadow ringed by deodar forest with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. The road passes the Kalatop forest. Return to Dalhousie in the afternoon; if time allows, visit the Panchpula and Satdhara springs. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Dalhousie to Amritsar drop (about 210 km, 6 hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive back down to Amritsar (about 210 km, 6 hours) via Pathankot. Drop at the Amritsar railway station, airport or a hotel for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour
name: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour
page_title: Grand Himachal with Mata Vaishno Devi Tour 12 Nights / 13 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience an unforgettable 13-day journey through Himachal Pradesh and Mata Vaishno Devi. This grand tour includes visits to Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, and Amritsar, culminating in a spiritual visit to the Mata Vaishno Devi shrine.
cities: Shimla-2Day - Manali-3Day - Dharamshala-1Day - Dalhousie-1Day - Katra-2Day - Amritsar-1Day - Chandigarh-1Day - Delhi-2Day

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi & Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Shimla (about 380 km, 9 hours), the summer capital of British India. The road climbs from the plains through Chandigarh and the Shivalik hills. After checking in at your hotel in Shimla, the rest of the day is free; in the evening, take a walk on the Mall Road and the Ridge. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Vaishno Devi temple near Kullu. The road follows the Beas through gorges and orchards. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali - Local sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast local sightseeing of Manali “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot Sulphur springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Also visit Marhi, Rahalla Falls, Nehru Kund (Cold Water Spring-Named by Late PM Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru). Return back to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dharamshala to Dalhousie (about 130 km, 4 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to walk along the Mall, see Gandhi Chowk and St. John's Church, and enjoy the small town. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie sightseeing and Khajjiar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Katra)Dalhousie to Katra
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dalhousie to Katra (about 260 km, 8 hours), the base town for the Mata Vaishno Devi yatra in the Trikuta hills. After checking in at your hotel, register for the yatra slip if needed and rest for the climb the next day. The evening is free to see the busy Katra market. Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : (Katra)Mata Vaishno Devi darshan
itinerary.text: After breakfast, begin the 13 km trek from Katra to the holy cave of Mata Vaishno Devi. You can walk, or hire a pony or palki from the shrine board; a helicopter service to Sanjhichhat is also available, at your own cost. After darshan, trek back down to Katra in the evening, sharing the journey with fellow pilgrims. "Jai Mata Di". Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 11 : (Amritsar)Katra to Amritsar via Wagah Border & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Katra to Amritsar (about 260 km, 5–6 hours). On arrival, go directly to the Wagah border to watch the Beating Retreat ceremony between India and Pakistan. Then check in at your hotel and, in the evening, visit the Golden Temple, the holiest shrine of the Sikhs, beautifully lit at night. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 12 : (Chandigarh)Amritsar to Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Jallianwala Bagh near the Golden Temple, then drive to Chandigarh (about 230 km, 5 hours). In the evening, visit the Rock Garden, created by Nek Chand from recycled materials, and Sukhna Lake, a popular place for an evening walk. Chandigarh, planned by Le Corbusier, is known for its green avenues. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 13 : (Delhi)Chandigarh to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Chandigarh and drive back to Delhi (about 250 km, 4–5 hours). Our driver drops you at the railway station or airport in Delhi for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the hills of Himachal, the darshan of Mata Vaishno Devi and the Golden Temple.

title: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett
name: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett
page_title: Haridwar with Mussoorie and Corbett 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the spiritual city of Haridwar, scenic beauty of Mussoorie, and wildlife of Corbett with our 6-day tour package. Visit famous temples, enjoy trekking, and spot exotic wildlife in Uttarakhand's most popular destinations.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Haridwar)Delhi to Haridwar ( 230 Kms - 7 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver picks you up in Delhi, or at the Haridwar railway station if you arrive by train, for the drive to Haridwar (about 230 km, 6–7 hours). After checking in at your hotel, visit the ashrams and temples of this holy town on the Ganga: Shivanand and Geeta Ashram, and the Mansa Devi and Chandi Devi temples, reached by cable car. In the evening, join the Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri, when hundreds of lamps are floated on the river. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mussoorie)Haridwar to Mussoorie ( 90 Kms - 3 Hours)
itinerary.text:
Haridwar to Rishikesh ( 30 Kms - 1 Hour)
After breakfast Check out to hotel and depart to Rishikesh visiting Ram Jhoola, Laxman Jhoola, Trambakeshwar Temple and Geeta Bhawan.
Rishikesh to Dehradun ( 20 Kms - 1 Hour)
Next proceed to Dehradun visiting Sheshtradhara.
Dehradun to Mussoorie ( 40 Kms - 2 Hour)
Proceed to Mussoorie visiting Sheshtradhara. Evening arrive in Mussoorie & check in at your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight at the hotel
Distance between Haridwar to Mussoorie is 100 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Corbett)Mussoorie to Corbett
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out from hotel then drive to Corbett National Park. The park was named after Jim Corbett, the legendary hunter-naturalist turned author and photographer who spent most years of his life in this area and helped set up this park. Check-in to your hotel/resort. Evening free for sightseeing covering Garjia temple and Corbett fall. Dinner and overnight stay in Corbett.
Distance between Mussoorie to Corbett is 270 Kms & 8 Hours drive approx.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Corbett)Corbett Park to Jeep Safari
itinerary.text:
Early morning enjoy jungle safari at the Corbett National Park (at your own cost). Return to the resort for breakfast. In the afternoon, visit Corbett Wildlife Museum, Dhikala which offers an awesome uninterrupted panoramic view of the valley. Back to the resort. Dinner and overnight at the hotel.
Corbett Tiger Reserve:- India's first national park, cradled in the foothills of the Himalayas at 3300 feet asl, spreads over an area of 520 sq km. The magnificent Ramganga River flows through the entire length of the Park. Corbett has the highest density of tiger in India. Other carnivores include the leopard, elephant, bear, deer. Basking along the banks of the Ramganga are the slender snouted gharial and the marsh crocodile. There are watch towers, elephant safaris and jeep safaris for wildlife viewing.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Delhi)Corbett to Delhi( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel near Jim Corbett National Park and drive back to Delhi (about 290 km, 8 hours). On arrival, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the Ganga at Haridwar, the hills of Mussoorie and the forests of Corbett.

title: Manali Volvo Trip weekend
name: Manali Volvo Trip weekend
page_title: Manali Volvo Trip weekend 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Plan a memorable weekend with our 4-night, 5-day Manali Volvo trip. Enjoy sightseeing in Manali, Solang Valley adventures, and a visit to Kullu. Perfect for a quick getaway from Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Manali)Delhi to Manali Transfer by Volvo
itinerary.text: Arrive Delhi and Take Transfer to |Majnu Ka tila / R.K Sharam Marg( by own ) till 05:00 PM | Volvo Stand for Board on volvo to Transfer From Delhi toManali. Travel by overnightVolvobus from Delhi toManali(12 Hours).Manaliis also famous for adventure sports like skiing, hiking, mountaineering, paragliding, rafting, trekking, kayaking, and mountain biking. In short,Manali-is the "Valley of the Gods"and an ideal place for the ones in search of both adventure and comfort. ReachManalinext morning at 08 -09 AM.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Manali)Manali - Arrival - Local Manali
itinerary.text: On arrival at Manali, our representative assists to transfer you to the pre-booked hotel. Check in at the hotel, freshen up and enjoy leisure time at the comfort of your room. After Some time enjoy the city tour visiting to some of the prominent spots and attractions including Hadimba Devi Temple also called Dhungri Temple, Manu Temple, Shiv Temple ,Club House ,Tibetan Monastery and Vashisth Village. Dinner and Overnight stay will be at the hotel inManali.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Manali - Holi Play - Sollang valley
itinerary.text: Today morning after breakfast have excursion trip to Solang Valley where you can admire the enchanting sights of the surroundings and can enjoy various thrilling adventure activities like Paragliding, Zorbing and Horse Riding etc during summer time. As the winter approaches, the same Solang Valley takes a shape of a Snowy Blanket, thus forming a perfect vista for several snow activities. After enjoying this solang outing return to hotel for dinner and Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Delhi)Manali to Kullu, and Volvo to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and set out on an excursion to the Kullu valley. Visit Kullu town and its shawl weaving centres, an Angora rabbit farm and the Vaishno Devi temple on the Kullu road; river rafting on the Beas is optional and paid locally. Return to Manali in the afternoon, and in the evening our cab drops you at the Volvo stand to board the overnight bus to Delhi. Overnight journey on the bus.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Delhi)Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.text: Your overnight Volvo reaches Delhi early in the morning, usually around 7–8 am, at the bus stand where you boarded. From here you continue your onward journey on your own, with memories of Manali, Solang Valley and the Kullu valley. Our services end on arrival in Delhi. Thank you for travelling with us.

title: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Kanyakumari
name: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Kanyakumari
page_title: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Kanyakumari 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the best of Kerala with our 7-day tour package covering Munnar, Thekkady, Alleppey, Kovalam, and Kanyakumari. Book now and enjoy a relaxing and adventurous trip.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Arrive Cochin to Munnar Local
itinerary.text:
On arrival at Cochin, you will be transferred to Munnar. Upon arrival check in at hotel. Munnar is located at the confluence of 03 rivers as the very name signifies. The sprawling tea plantations and picturesque towns make Munnar a popular hill resort town in South India. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-Enroute visit Kodanadu elephant care centre, Cheyyara waterfalls, Valara waterfalls, Attukadu waterfalls, Spice plantations etc.
Distance between Cochin to Munnar 135 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Munnar Local sightseeing
itinerary.text:
In the morning start the sightseeing of Munnar visiting the tea plantations, Tea Museum, the Eravikulam National park home of the endangered Niligiri Thar (Ibex), followed by visit to the Mattupetty dam, the the Kundala Lake and other scenic spots. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-Eravikulam National Park (Raja Malai), mattupetty dam, tea estates, eco point, spice plantation, rose garden, photo point, honey bee tree, tea museum, blossom park, kundale dam and top station
Distance between Cochin to Munnar is 135 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Thekkady)Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.text:
Morning transfer to Thekkady (Periyar) (4 hrs drive). Thekkady has one of the world's most fascinating natural wildlife reserves noted for its geography, diverse wildlife and scenic beauty. Arive at Thekkady and check-in at Hotel: Later afternoon boat ride on the Lake Periyar where one can have a unique experience of viewing wildlife at close quarters from the safety of a boat on the lake. The greatest attraction of Periyar, however are the herds of wild elephants that come down to play in the lake (Wild life viewing is always dependent on one's good fortune). Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeingd :-visit periyar wild life sanctuary where you can see wild elephant, boar, deer, the great Indian tiger and more, mullaperiyar dam and spice plantations tour where one can shop exotic spices
Distance between Munnar to Thekkady is 125 Kms / 3 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Alleppey)Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.text:
Morning leave for Alleppey to enjoy a boat cruise tour in Alleppey Houseboat. Rest of the day at leisure on the House Boat which is world's major tourist attraction. Sit back and relax while the boat cruises through the narrow serene backwater canals of Alleppey. We can see here in breathing green, the village slumbers by the Vembanad Lake. On cruise scenery flashes up vivid contrasts of lush green and deep blues. As the boat glider along the gorgeous green of the fringed palms the ripples in the blue water blend in to little wavelets. Lunch, Evening Tea/ Coffee with snacks, dinner all are provided inside the houseboat. Overnight stay will provide on House Boat.Note:• The cruise commences at 1230 hrs with lunch served on board and continues till dusk. At dusk the boat will anchor in a wide waterway or lake for the night (The backwaters close to boat traffic at dusk as the fisherman lay their nets in the backwaters. Other boats are not allowed to ply in the backwaters after dusk. On the following day the cruise commences again after breakfast and the guest will be dropped at Alleppey by 0900Hrs. Overnight stay at hotel.
Houseboat check in at 12Noon and cruises till 5PM, Boat will be anchored till 8AM and cruises till 9AM for checkout
For A/C Houseboat, A/C will be operating from 9PM till 6AM only (All houseboat related inclusions are applicable only if the Itinerary is including Houseboat stay)
Cruise Time : 6 hrs.
Bed Rooms : 01, 02 or 03 Bedroom as per room occupancy
Boarding @ : 12.00 pm
Ac will be operational from 09.00 PM to 06.00 AM
Distance between Munnar to Thekkady is 125 Kms / 3 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 :(Kovalam)Alleppey Houseboat to Kovalam
itinerary.text:
Morning get up early to enjoy sunrise of backwater , also you will get a chance to see fishermen catching fish of boat men selling household items in their small canoe , After breakfast the boat will move again for a morning cruise, you will check out from the houseboat at 0900 hrs and proceed to Kovalam beach. The journey is through costal areas of Kerala, you can see , view of lagoons rivers, evergreen coconut palms make this journey very enjoyable , Reach Kovalam and check in at your hotel It is one of the beast beaches of India with its lovely slice beach sand and perfectly positioned palms. Evening relax on the Kovalam beach . Overnihgt at Hotel.
Sightseeing:- Light house beach, Howah Beach, Ashoka beach
Distance between Alleppey to Kovalam is 165 Kms / 4.5 hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 6 :(Kovalam)Kovalam – Same Day Kanyakumari - Kovalam
itinerary.text:
Enjoy the sunrise on the beach, after breakfast proceed for same day trip to Kanyakumari enroute visit majestic Padmanaphapuram The capital of the State of Travancore. built in the Travancore architectural style arrive kanyakumari and check in at hotel afternoon go for kanyakumari sightseeing . Visit Vivekananda Rock that houses a memorial dedicated to Swami Vivekanan .The Memorial is built at the convergence of the Indian Ocean, the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal. Kanyakumari is a place where you can enjoy Sun rise and Sunset from the same point, something special to remember.Return back to Kovalam. Overnight at Hotel.
Sightseeing:- Sightseeing includes Kanyakumari beach which is the sangam of Indian ocean, Bay of Bengal and Arabian sea. Visit Vivekananda rock Watch sunset and stay at Kanyakumari
Distance between Kovalam to Kanyakumari is 90 Kms / 02 Hours one way by road

itinerary.title: Day 7 :(Trivandrum)Kovalam to Trivandrum departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kovalam and enjoy a last walk on the beach if time allows. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 16 km) for your onward journey, with memories of Munnar, Thekkady, the backwaters, Kovalam and the southern tip of India at Kanyakumari. The tour ends here.
