title: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Trivandrum
name: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Trivandrum
page_title: Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Trivandrum 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Experience the best of Kerala with our 7-day Munnar Thekkady Alleppey Kovalam Trivandrum tour package. Explore the tea gardens of Munnar, wildlife of Thekkady, backwaters of Alleppey, and beaches of Kovalam and Trivandrum.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Arrive Cochin to Munnar Local
itinerary.text:
On arrival at Cochin, you will be transferred to Munnar. Upon arrival check in at hotel. Munnar is located at the confluence of 03 rivers as the very name signifies. The sprawling tea plantations and picturesque towns make Munnar a popular hill resort town in South India. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeing :-Enroute visit Kodanadu elephant care centre, Cheyyara waterfalls, Valara waterfalls, Attukadu waterfalls, Spice plantations etc.
Distance between Cochin to Munnar 135 Kms (3.5 hours) by road

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Munnar Local sightseeing
itinerary.text:
In the morning start the sightseeing of Munnar visiting the tea plantations, Tea Museum, the Eravikulam National park home of the endangered Niligiri Thar (Ibex), followed by visit to the Mattupetty dam, the the Kundala Lake and other scenic spots. Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeing :-Eravikulam National Park (Raja Malai), mattupetty dam, tea estates, eco point, spice plantation, rose garden, photo point, honey bee tree, tea museum, blossom park, kundale dam and top station

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Thekkady)Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.text:
Morning transfer to Thekkady (Periyar) (4 hrs drive). Thekkady has one of the world's most fascinating natural wildlife reserves noted for its geography, diverse wildlife and scenic beauty. Arive at Thekkady and check-in at Hotel: Later afternoon boat ride on the Lake Periyar where one can have a unique experience of viewing wildlife at close quarters from the safety of a boat on the lake. The greatest attraction of Periyar, however are the herds of wild elephants that come down to play in the lake (Wild life viewing is always dependent on one's good fortune). Overnight stay at the Hotel.
Sightseeing:- visit periyar wild life sanctuary where you can see wild elephant, boar, deer, the great Indian tiger and more, mullaperiyar dam and spice plantations tour where one can shop exotic spices
Distance between Munnar to Thekkady is 125 Kms / 3 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Alleppey)Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.text:
Morning leave for Alleppey to enjoy a boat cruise tour in Alleppey Houseboat. Rest of the day at leisure on the House Boat which is world's major tourist attraction. Sit back and relax while the boat cruises through the narrow serene backwater canals of Alleppey. We can see here in breathing green, the village slumbers by the Vembanad Lake. On cruise scenery flashes up vivid contrasts of lush green and deep blues. As the boat glider along the gorgeous green of the fringed palms the ripples in the blue water blend in to little wavelets. Lunch, Evening Tea/ Coffee with snacks, dinner all are provided inside the houseboat. Overnight stay will provide on House Boat.Note:• The cruise commences at 1230 hrs with lunch served on board and continues till dusk. At dusk the boat will anchor in a wide waterway or lake for the night (The backwaters close to boat traffic at dusk as the fisherman lay their nets in the backwaters. Other boats are not allowed to ply in the backwaters after dusk. On the following day the cruise commences again after breakfast and the guest will be dropped at Alleppey by 0900Hrs. Overnight stay at hotel.
Houseboat check in at 12Noon and cruises till 5PM, Boat will be anchored till 8AM and cruises till 9AM for checkout
For A/C Houseboat, A/C will be operating from 9PM till 6AM only (All houseboat related inclusions are applicable only if the Itinerary is including Houseboat stay)
Cruise Time : 6 hrs.
Bed Rooms : 01, 02 or 03 Bedroom as per room occupancy
Boarding @ : 12.00 pm
Ac will be operational from 09.00 PM to 06.00 AM
Distance between Thekkady to Alleppey is 155 Kms / 4.5 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kovalam)Alleppey Houseboat to Kovalam
itinerary.text:
Morning get up early to enjoy sunrise of backwater , also you will get a chance to see fishermen catching fish of boat men selling household items in their small canoe , After breakfast the boat will move again for a morning cruise, you will check out from the houseboat at 0900 hrs and proceed to Kovalam beach. The journey is through costal areas of Kerala, you can see , view of lagoons rivers, evergreen coconut palms make this journey very enjoyable , Reach Kovalam and check in at your hotel It is one of the beast beaches of India with its lovely slice beach sand and perfectly positioned palms. Evening relax on the Kovalam beach . Overnihgt at Hotel.
Sightseeing:- Light house beach, Howah Beach, Ashoka beach
Distance between Alleppey to Kovalam is 165 Kms / 4.5 hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kovalam)Kovalam to Trivandrum day visit to Kovalam return
itinerary.text:
After breakfast proceed for sightseeing experiencing a tour around Trivandrum: The Napier Museum, Kuthiramalika Museum, and Sri Padmanabha Temple. At afternoon you will be transfered to the famous Kovalam Beach and you can relex your mind and body there. Overnight stay at Hotel in Kovalam.
Sightseeing:- Sree Padmanabha Swami Temple, Kuthiramalika Palace museum, The Napier museum, Sree Chithra art gallery, zoological park, science and technology museum, Kanakakunnu Palace, planetorium
Distance between Kovalam to Trivandrum is 25 Kms / 1/2 Hour one way by road

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Kovalam)Kovalam to Trivandrum departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Kovalam and enjoy a last walk on the beach if time allows. Our driver then transfers you to Trivandrum airport or railway station (about 25 km, half an hour) for your onward journey, with memories of Munnar, Thekkady, the backwaters and the beaches of Kovalam. The tour ends here.

title: Mussoorie with Nainital Almora and Jim Corbett
name: Mussoorie with Nainital Almora and Jim Corbett
page_title: Mussoorie with Nainital Almora and Jim Corbett 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Explore the Queen of Hills, Mussoorie, the Lake City, Nainital, the Cultural Hub, Almora, and the Wildlife Paradise, Jim Corbett National Park with our 7-day tour package..

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mussoorie)Arrive Delhi to Mussoorie ( 310 Kms - 9 Hours)
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi for the drive to Mussoorie (about 310 km, 8–9 hours) via Dehradun, climbing into the Garhwal hills. Arrive in the late afternoon and check in at your hotel. Mussoorie, the "Queen of the Hills", has wide views of the Doon valley and the snow peaks. The evening is free to walk along the Mall Road, lined with shops and cafés. Overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mussoorie)Mussoorie Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast proceed to visit famous Kemtey fall is 15Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is popular tourists point in Mussoorie. Cloud Ends is 7Kms approx. from Mussoorie. It is hightest point of Mussorie offering awesome view to tourists. Camels Back Road is around 3Kms from Mussoorie. As name suggests rocks are shaped like a hump of camel at the end of road. Gun Hill Point is second highest point in Mussoorie. It is also accessible by a cable car. It offers complete view of Mussoorie. Lal Tibba (Red Hills) is located 6Kms from Mussoorie. If is famous among tourists to view sunset and sunrise.Also visit mall road. Back to the hotel. Overnight at Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Corbett)Mussoorie to Corbett
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out from hotel then drive to Corbett National Park. The park was named after Jim Corbett, the legendary hunter-naturalist turned author and photographer who spent most years of his life in this area and helped set up this park. Check-in to your hotel/resort. Evening free for sightseeing covering Garjia temple and Corbett fall. Dinner and overnight stay in Corbett.
Distance between Mussoorie to Corbett is 270 Kms & 8 Hours drive approx.

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Almora)Corbett to Almora (170 Kms/6 Hrs)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Corbett to Almora (about 170 km, 6 hours), a hill town on a ridge at about 5,400 ft in the Kumaon hills, with wide views of the Himalaya. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to explore on your own: the old Lala Bazaar with its wooden-fronted shops, the Nanda Devi temple and the sunset views from the ridge. Overnight stay in Almora.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Nainital)Almora to Nainital( 80 Kms - 2.5 Hours)
itinerary.text:
After breakfast check out and drive to Nainital. On arrival, check in to the hotel. After refreshing yourself at the hotel in Nainital, go on a sightseeing tour, beginning with boating on the famous Naini Lake (at your own cost) and visit to the holy Naina Devi Temple. After that, visit famous tourist spots like Naina Peak, SnowView and Lands End etc. In the evening, enjoy shopping at the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Note:- Tempo traveller or higher seating vehicle are allowed upto Nainital Parking only. For local sightseeing in Nainital guest has to take local vehicle for sightseeing from Nainital Union on direct payment basis.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast drive for lake tour of Nainital. Nainital is the main tourist attraction. Here Naini Lake is famous for boating (Half an hour ride), Bhimtal is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. It is the largest lake amoung Nainital Lake Tour, Sattal(seven lakes) is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. As name suggests is a group of seven lakes interconnected, Naukuchiatal is about 30 kilometers from Nainital. It is 9 cornered lake. Drive back to Hotel, Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Delhi)Nainital to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Nainital. Take a last walk along Naini Lake if time allows, then drive back to Delhi (about 300 km, 7–8 hours) by private cab. Our driver drops you at your hotel, the airport or the railway station in Delhi for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Discover the cultural richness of Mysore and the natural beauty of Wayanad on a 4-day tour. Visit historic palaces, lush green landscapes, and enjoy a perfect blend of heritage and nature.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mysore)Arrive Bangalore to Mysore
itinerary.text: On arrival in Bangalore, our driver meets you for the drive to Mysore (about 150 km, 3–4 hours). After checking in at your hotel in Mysore, visit the Brindavan Gardens in the evening for the musical fountain show. Overnight stay in Mysore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Wayanad)Mysore to Wayanad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Mysore to Wayanad (about 150 km, 3 hours), crossing into the green hills of Kerala. itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Wayanad) Wayanad Local

Overnight stay in Wayanad.

description: Discover the charm of Nainital's lakes, Ranikhet's scenic beauty, and Jim Corbett's wildlife with our tour package. Experience the best of Uttarakhand's hill stations, lakes, and wildlife sanctuaries.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Nainital)Delhi to Nainital
itinerary.text:
On arrival in the Delhi airport/ railway station, proceed directly for Nainital by road. On arrival, check in to the hotel. After refreshing yourself at the hotel in Nainital, proceed for sightseeing tour, beginning with boating on the famous Nainital Lake-Naini Lake (at your own cost) and visit to the holy Naina Devi Temple. After that, visit famous tourist spots like Tiffin Top, Naina Peak, Cave Garden, Bara Pathar, Lover's Point, Lands End, Naina Peak etc.(sightseeing will be covered as per time permitting). In the evening, enjoy shopping at the Mall Road. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.
Note :-Tempo traveller or higher seating vehicle are allowed upto Nainital Parking only. For local sightseeing in Nainital guest has to take local vehicle for sightseeing from Nainital Union on direct payment basis..
Distance between Delhi to Nainital is 320 Kms / 9 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Nainital)Nainital Lake Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast drive for lake tour of Nainital. Nainital is the main tourist attraction. Here Naini Lake is famous for boating (Half an hour ride), Bhimtal is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. It is the largest lake amoung Nainital Lake Tour, Sattal(seven lakes) is about 25 kilometers from Nainital. As name suggests is a group of seven lakes interconnected, Naukuchiatal is about 30 kilometers from Nainital. It is 9 cornered lake. Drive back to Hotel, Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ranikhet)Nainital to Ranikhet
itinerary.text:
Morning drive to drive to Ranikhet, on arrival Ranikhet check in at the hotel. Later visit local sight seeing i.e. Haidakhan Babaji Temple (4kms.), Chaubatia Gardens(10kms.), Bhalu Dam (3kms.), Jhula Devi Temple (7kms.), Mankameshwar Temple, Kalika Temple(5kms.) Tarikhet Village (8kms.), Majhkhali (13kms.) etc. Dinner & Overnight stay at Hotel.
Ranikhet:- Ranikhet reflects the very best of the heavenly Himalayas, their lush green forests, majestic mountain peaks, exotic plant life and attractive wild life. To see nature and its elements in full harmony, the right place to be is Ranikhet. According to a popular belief, this spot had won the heart of Rani Padmini, queen of Raja Sudhardev. She chose this scenic place to be her abode and since then, it has come to be known as Ranikhet, literally “Queen's Field". At an altitude of 1829mtres, above sea level, the invigorating mountain breeze, the singing of birds, the panoramic view of the Himalayas - the sights, sounds and smells leave the onlooker spellbound. During the rains, flowers sprout up every where in rainbow colours, branches of tress stoop with ripened fruits and sunlight peeping through the mist and clouds, endow an enchanting effect all across Ranikhet. As winter comes, the softly falling snowflakes cover the environs in sheets of pure whiteness.
Distance between Nainital to Ranikhet is 70 Kms / 2.5 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 4 :(Corbett)Ranikhet to Corbett( 100 Kms - 3 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jim Corbett National Park (about 100 km, 3 hours). The park is named after Jim Corbett, the hunter-naturalist turned author who spent much of his life here and helped set it up; it is India's oldest national park and home of the Bengal tiger. After checking in at your hotel, visit the Garjia Devi temple on a rock in the Kosi river in the evening. Overnight stay in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Corbett)Corbett to Delhi( 290 Kms - 8 Hours)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel near Jim Corbett National Park and drive back to Delhi (about 290 km, 7–8 hours) through the Terai and the plains of western Uttar Pradesh. On arrival, our driver drops you at the airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here, with memories of the Kumaon hills and the forests of Corbett.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Singapore)Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.text: Welcome to Singapore. On arrival at Changi Airport, our local representative meets you and transfers you privately to your hotel, the ibis Styles Singapore on Macpherson. itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Singapore)Singapore Sightseeing
itinerary.text: In the morning, get ready and you will be transferred to Universal Studio for a day tour. itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kuala Lumpur)Singapore-Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and transfer to the coach terminal for the coach to Kuala Lumpur (about 5–6 hours); the one-way coach transfer is included. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Kuala Lumpur Fraser Business Park. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can see the Petronas Twin Towers lit up. Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kuala Lumpur)Sunway Lagoon Theme Park
itinerary.text:
After breakfast head for sightseeing tour of the famous Sunway Lagoon Theme park which is one of the famous tourist attractions in Singapore.
The park is separated into different themed lands in Wild West and the Waters of Africa, each boasting their own exciting attractions. Splash in for wet rides on the Voodoo Adventure River and the heart-stopping adrenaline rush rides from the toboggans.
Back on dry land, try the roller coaster, the inverted pirate ship or some of the other many attractions. Later by evening return back and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Phuket)Kuala Lumpur-Phuket
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Phuket. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Phuket. The rest of the day is free to relax on the beach or explore Patong's lively Bangla Road in the evening. Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Phuket)Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.text:
The next day is planned for a full day Phi Phi Island Tour by Speed Boat. Phi Phi Island is located just 45 minutes by speedboat from Phuket that offer a great laid back tropical lifestyle. Soak up the sun, go beach hopping or simply enjoy the great outdoors in some of the most beautiful scenery in Asia.
Classic white sandy beaches, surrounded by impressive limestone cliffs and sunlit crystal clear water, Phi Phi actually consist of two islands, Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Ley. Explore the beauty of the place and enjoy the day.
You will be transferred back for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bangkok)Phuket-Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok. On arrival, our local representative meets you and transfers you to the Ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 50. The rest of the day is free; in the evening you can explore a night market or take a river cruise on the Chao Phraya at your own cost. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Bangkok)Bangkok Sight seeing
itinerary.text:
After breakfast proceed to full day safari of world marine park which is one of the famous attractions in Bangkok. No one can resist the excitement of indulging in a day full of experiences and activities at safari world & marine park. Witness the majestic wild creatures like African lion and Bengal tiger on an 8 km long drive, then pass through the most beautiful and fun loving animals like Orangutan, dolphins and colorful bird species. Enjoy watching the Dolphins performance
The park is unique for as it blends the Wild & Herbivorous Animals with the Exotic Fresh Water and Oceanic Life.The diverse species of animals will amaze you who are living in this natural like habitat.
Mesmerize yourself by witnessing the friendly Dolphins performing somersaults
Then enjoy Orang Utan Boxing Show - Man's closest cousins take centre stage as they tickle you with their keen sense of humour and dazzle you with their mathematical gifts.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Bangkok)Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out of your hotel in Bangkok. Depending on your flight time, you may have a little time for last-minute shopping. You are then transferred privately to the airport for your flight home; return airport transfers on a private basis are included. The tour ends here, with memories of Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Phuket and Bangkok.

title: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar
name: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar
page_title: Shimla Manali with Dharamshala Dalhousie and Amritsar 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Embark on a 9-day tour through Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, and Amritsar. Experience the best of Himachal Pradesh and Punjab, including visits to Rohtang Pass, Khajjiar, and the Golden Temple. Ideal for travelers seeking a complete North Indian adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrival Delhi & Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our driver meets you in Delhi (about 380 km, 9 hours) for the drive up to Shimla, the summer capital of British India, through the Shivalik foothills and pine forests. After checking in at your hotel, the rest of the day is free. In the evening, walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge, with Christ Church, Scandal Point and views over the valleys, and plenty of cafés and shops. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Shimla: Full day sightseeing
itinerary.text: Today breakfast proceed for in and around sightseeing of SHIMLA, visit KUFRI, India's one of the best holiday paradise Kufri in Shimla is beautifully tucked on an altitude of 2,622 meter. The place is a tourist hotspot for its awesome scenic and sports activities. Evening free to stroll in the famous shopping place of Shimla town - “THE MALL & THE RIDGE” This large open space in the heart of town presents excellent views of the mountain ranges. Also visit Jakhoo Temple and Hanuman Temple. Shimla's landmarks - the neo- gothic structure of Christ Church (built in 1850's) and the neo - Tudor library building - are worth seeing. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Kullu Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Shimla to Manali (about 280 km, 9–10 hours) through the Kullu valley. On the way, see Sundernagar lake, the Pandoh dam on the Beas river and the Vaishno Devi temple near Kullu. The road follows the Beas through gorges and apple orchards. On arrival in Manali, check in at your hotel and rest. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali to Excursion to Rohtang Pass (Snow Point)
itinerary.text:
Today enjoy excursion to Rohtang Pass also called Snow point- enjoy the beauty of year round snow caped mountains.Tourists can enjoy Snow Scooter, Ski Ride, mountain biking. Famous tourist spot Rohtang Pass is closed during Jan to April month due to heavy glaciers all around and so tourist activities can be spotted in Solang Valley during that period. Evening visit “HADIMBA TEMPLE” Built in 1553 with a superbly crafted four tiered pagoda roof, it is famous for its exquisitely carved doorway . “CLUB HOUSE” The Club House with its comprehensive facilities that include a roller skating rink, an auditorium, billiards rooms, a library, a bar and restaurant makes wonderful outing for the day.” Tibetan Monastery, Van Vihar, and “VASHIST” Well known for its hot springs. There are old temples dedicated to the sage Vashisth and to Lord Rama. Overnight Manali.
Note :Rohtang Pass will be closed on Tuesday. ( Rohtang Pass Sightseeing is not included from 15th May 2015 onwards. It will be chargeable extra payable directly by the guest)

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dharamshala)Manali to Dharamshala - Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text:
Travel by surface to Mc Leodganj (Dharamsala), magnificently set to the background of the Dhauldhar mountains and the seat of his Holiness, the Dalai Lama, the leader of the Tibetans, since 1960. On arrival check in at hotel. Evening half day city tour visiting Dal Lake, Church, Bhagsu Nag Temple and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight at hotel.
Distance between Manali to Dharamshala is 240 Kms / 7 Hours by road

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dalhousie)Dharamshala to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dharamshala to Dalhousie (about 130 km, 4 hours). Dalhousie is a hill station spread over five hills, with colonial-era churches and views of the Dhauladhar range. After checking in, the rest of the day is free to walk along the Mall, see Gandhi Chowk and St. John's Church, and enjoy the small town. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dalhousie)Dalhousie Local Sightseeing - Khajjiar Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 24 km), a wide green meadow ringed by deodar forests, with a small lake and the Khajji Nag temple. It is often called the "mini Switzerland of India". Enjoy the mountain views from Lakkar Mandi on the way. Optional activities such as pony rides are paid locally. Return to Dalhousie in the evening for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Amritsar)Dalhousie to Amritsar via Wagah Border
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive from Dalhousie to Amritsar (about 200 km, 5–6 hours) through Pathankot. In the afternoon, go to the Wagah border to watch the Beating Retreat ceremony between India and Pakistan. Then check in at your hotel and, in the evening, visit the Golden Temple, the holiest shrine of the Sikhs, beautifully lit at night. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Delhi)Amritsar to Delhi
itinerary.text: Visit the Golden Temple again in the early morning if you wish, and the Jallianwala Bagh memorial nearby. After breakfast, check out and drive to Delhi (about 450 km, 8–9 hours) via Chandigarh. On arrival, our driver drops you at the railway station or airport for your onward journey. If you prefer, you can instead be dropped at Amritsar airport or railway station. The tour ends here.

title: Srinagar and Pahalgam Tour
name: Srinagar and Pahalgam Tour
page_title: Srinagar and Pahalgam Tour – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A short Kashmir trip: a night in Srinagar with the Mughal gardens, then two nights in Pahalgam for the Aru, Betaab and Chandanwari valleys along the Lidder river.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Srinagar)Arrive Srinagar – Mughal gardens
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport, where our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. In the afternoon, visit the Mughal gardens — Nishat Bagh, the garden of joy, and Shalimar Bagh, built by Emperor Jahangir — with views over Dal Lake. In the evening, walk along the Boulevard Road beside Dal Lake; a boat ride on the lake can be taken locally at your own cost. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pahalgam)Srinagar to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam (about 95 km, 3 hours) through the saffron fields of Pampore and past the ancient Avantipura temple ruins. Pahalgam sits where the Lidder river meets the Sheshnag stream, ringed by pine-covered hills. Spend the evening walking along the river. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pahalgam)Aru, Betaab and Chandanwari valleys
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore the valleys around Pahalgam by local Pahalgam taxi (local union rules apply; paid locally): Aru valley with its meadows and streams, Betaab valley, named after the film shot there, and Chandanwari, the start of the Amarnath yatra route, where snow often lingers into summer. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Pahalgam to Srinagar airport
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Srinagar (about 95 km, 3 hours) for your flight. If time allows, stop at the Pampore saffron fields on the way. The tour ends at Srinagar airport.

description: Eleven days covering all of Ladakh's great sights: Nubra and Turtuk, Pangong, Tso Moriri on the Changthang plateau and the monasteries around Leh.
cities: Leh - Nubra Valley - Turtuk - Pangong - Tso Moriri

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Leh)Arrive Leh – acclimatisation
itinerary.text: Arrive at Leh airport (about 3,500 m), where our representative meets you and transfers you to your hotel. Rest for the whole day so your body can adjust to the altitude — drink plenty of water and avoid exertion. In the evening, a short walk to the Leh market if you feel well. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Leh)Leh sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, Leh sightseeing along the Srinagar road: the Hall of Fame war museum, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, the Magnetic Hill and the Sangam of the Indus and Zanskar rivers. Return via the Spituk monastery. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nubra Valley)Leh to Nubra via Khardung La
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Nubra valley (about 120 km, 5 hours) over the Khardung La pass, one of the highest motorable roads. In Nubra, visit the Diskit monastery with its large Maitreya Buddha and the Hunder sand dunes, where double-humped Bactrian camel rides are available (paid locally). Overnight stay in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Turtuk)Nubra to Turtuk
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Hunder to Turtuk (about 80 km, 3 hours) along the Shyok river. Turtuk is a Balti village of apricot orchards and stone houses, opened to visitors in 2010; walk through the village and see its small museum. Overnight stay in Turtuk.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Nubra Valley)Turtuk to Nubra
itinerary.text: Morning in Turtuk, then back along the Shyok to Diskit and Hunder for the evening. Overnight stay in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pangong)Nubra to Pangong lake
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Nubra to Pangong lake (about 160 km, 6 hours) along the Shyok river. The lake, about 4,250 m high, changes colour from blue to green through the day. Overnight stay at Pangong.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Leh)Pangong to Leh
itinerary.text: Watch the morning light on Pangong lake, then drive back to Leh (about 160 km, 5–6 hours) over the Chang La pass, stopping at Thiksey monastery on the way if time allows. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Tso Moriri)Leh to Tso Moriri
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Tso Moriri (about 220 km, 7 hours) along the Indus through Chumathang, known for its hot springs, into the Changthang plateau, home of nomadic herders. The lake lies at about 4,500 m; Korzok monastery stands on its shore. Overnight stay at Tso Moriri.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Leh)Tso Moriri to Leh
itinerary.text: Early morning by the lake, then drive back to Leh by way of the Puga valley and Tso Kar salt lake where the road allows. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : (Leh)Monasteries of the Indus valley
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the monasteries east of Leh: Shey palace, Thiksey monastery, often compared to the Potala Palace, and Hemis, the largest monastery in Ladakh. Evening in the Leh market. Overnight stay in Leh.

itinerary.title: Day 11 : Departure from Leh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Leh airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

title: Amarnath Yatra by Helicopter via Pahalgam
name: Amarnath Yatra by Helicopter via Pahalgam
page_title: Amarnath Yatra by Helicopter via Pahalgam – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A four-day Amarnath yatra by helicopter from Pahalgam to Panjtarni, with darshan of the Holy Cave and a night in Srinagar afterwards.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pahalgam)Arrive Srinagar – drive to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport and drive to Pahalgam (about 95 km, 3 hours), the base for the Pahalgam route of the Shri Amarnath Ji Yatra. Complete your yatra formalities and rest. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pahalgam)Holy Cave darshan by helicopter
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, transfer to the Pahalgam helipad for the helicopter to Panjtarni (helicopter tickets are booked through the official yatra service and are not part of the package price). From Panjtarni, the Holy Cave is about 6 km, on foot, by pony or by palki (paid locally). After darshan of the ice Shivling, return to Panjtarni and fly back to Pahalgam. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Srinagar)Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Srinagar and visit the Shankaracharya temple and the Mughal gardens. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Srinagar airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amarnath Yatra with Vaishno Devi
name: Amarnath Yatra with Vaishno Devi
page_title: Amarnath Yatra with Vaishno Devi – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days for two great pilgrimages: Mata Vaishno Devi from Katra, then the Shri Amarnath Ji Yatra by the Baltal route from Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Katra)Arrive Jammu – drive to Katra
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jammu and drive to Katra (about 50 km, 1.5–2 hours), the base town for Mata Vaishno Devi. Rest for the next day's climb. Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Katra)Mata Vaishno Devi darshan
itinerary.text: An early start for the 13 km climb to the Bhawan of Mata Vaishno Devi, on foot or by pony, palki or helicopter to Sanjhichhat (paid locally). After darshan, return to Katra. Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Srinagar)Katra to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Srinagar (about 260 km, 7–8 hours) through the Banihal tunnel into the Kashmir valley. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Sonmarg)Srinagar to Sonmarg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Sonmarg (about 83 km), the base for the Baltal route of the yatra. Complete yatra formalities and rest. Overnight stay in Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Sonmarg)Holy Cave darshan via Baltal
itinerary.text: Very early, drive to Baltal. Go to the Holy Cave either by helicopter from Neelgrath to Panjtarni and then about 6 km on foot, pony or palki, or by the 14 km Baltal trek (helicopter, pony and palki paid locally). After darshan, return to Baltal and drive back to Sonmarg. Overnight stay in Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Sonmarg to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After a rest morning, drive back to Srinagar and visit the Hazratbal shrine and the Mughal gardens. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for a last walk by Dal Lake or a little shopping before the transfer to Srinagar airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

title: Amarnath Yatra with Kashmir Sightseeing
name: Amarnath Yatra with Kashmir Sightseeing
page_title: Amarnath Yatra with Kashmir Sightseeing – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days pairing the Amarnath yatra by the Baltal route with Kashmir's valleys — Sonmarg, Gulmarg and Pahalgam — and Srinagar's Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Srinagar)Arrive Srinagar
itinerary.text: On arrival at Srinagar airport, you are met and taken to your hotel. After a short rest, drive along Dal Lake to the terraced Nishat Bagh and the Chashme Shahi spring garden. The evening is free to enjoy the lake front; boat rides on the lake are available locally at your own cost. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sonmarg)Srinagar to Sonmarg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Sonmarg (about 83 km, 3 hours) along the Sindh river, the base for the Baltal route. Complete yatra formalities. Overnight stay in Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sonmarg)Holy Cave darshan via Baltal
itinerary.text: Before dawn, drive to Baltal and continue to the Holy Cave by the 14 km trek or by helicopter from Neelgrath to Panjtarni (helicopter, pony and palki paid locally). After darshan of the ice Shivling, return to Baltal and Sonmarg. Overnight stay in Sonmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Srinagar)Sonmarg to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After a slow morning, drive back to Srinagar. Evening by Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gulmarg)Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive up through pine forests to Gulmarg, the meadow of flowers, at about 2,650 m. The afternoon is free for the Gulmarg Gondola (paid locally) or a pony ride to Khilanmarg. Overnight stay in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pahalgam)Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take a last walk on the Gulmarg meadow, then drive to Pahalgam (about 150 km, 5 hours) by way of Srinagar and the saffron fields of Pampore. Check in and spend the evening by the Lidder river. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Srinagar)Pahalgam valleys – back to Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Betaab valley and Chandanwari by local Pahalgam taxi (paid locally), then drive back to Srinagar. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Srinagar airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amarnath Yatra Trek from Jammu via Pahalgam
name: Amarnath Yatra Trek from Jammu via Pahalgam
page_title: Amarnath Yatra Trek from Jammu via Pahalgam – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days on the traditional Pahalgam trek route of the Amarnath yatra — Chandanwari, Sheshnag and Panjtarni — returning by Baltal to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jammu)Arrive Jammu
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jammu and transfer to your hotel. Complete your yatra registration checks and rest before the drive into Kashmir. Overnight stay in Jammu.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pahalgam)Jammu to Pahalgam
itinerary.text: An early start for the drive to Pahalgam (about 250 km, 8–9 hours) by the Jammu–Srinagar highway through the Banihal tunnel. Overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sheshnag)Chandanwari to Sheshnag
itinerary.text: Drive to Chandanwari (about 16 km), where the trek begins. Walk past Pissu Top to Sheshnag lake (about 12 km), surrounded by peaks. Overnight stay in a camp at Sheshnag.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Panjtarni)Sheshnag to Panjtarni
itinerary.text: Continue over the Mahagunas pass, the highest point of the route, and down to Panjtarni (about 14 km), where five streams meet. Overnight stay in a camp at Panjtarni.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Srinagar)Holy Cave darshan – Baltal – Srinagar
itinerary.text: Walk the last 6 km to the Holy Cave for darshan of the ice Shivling, then descend to Baltal (about 14 km) and drive to Srinagar (about 95 km). Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Srinagar)Rest day in Srinagar
itinerary.text: A rest day after the trek, with an easy afternoon at the Mughal gardens and the Hazratbal shrine. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for a last walk by Dal Lake or a little shopping before the transfer to Srinagar airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

title: Manali with Solang Valley and Sissu (Atal Tunnel)
name: Manali with Solang Valley and Sissu (Atal Tunnel)
page_title: Manali with Solang Valley and Sissu (Atal Tunnel) – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days based in Manali with a day through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul, Solang valley, Naggar castle and Kullu, and old Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Manali)Arrive Manali
itinerary.text: Arrive in Manali and check in. In the afternoon, visit the Hadimba temple in its cedar forest, the hot springs at Vashisht and the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Manali)Solang valley and Sissu via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Solang valley (about 14 km), where paragliding, zorbing and the ropeway are available (paid locally), and then through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul to Sissu, with its waterfall and the Chandra river. Return to Manali in the evening. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Naggar and Kullu
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down the valley to Naggar to see the old Naggar castle and the Roerich art gallery, then on to Kullu for its shawl weavers and the Beas river. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Old Manali and Jogini falls
itinerary.text: A relaxed day: walk through old Manali village and up to the Jogini waterfall near Vashisht, then spend the evening in the cafés and shops of the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out for your onward journey from Manali. The tour ends here.

title: Kasol and Manikaran: Parvati Valley Tour
name: Kasol and Manikaran: Parvati Valley Tour
page_title: Kasol and Manikaran: Parvati Valley Tour – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Parvati valley: riverside Kasol, the Manikaran Sahib gurudwara and hot springs, Chalal village and Tosh at the head of the valley.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kasol)Arrive Bhuntar – drive to Kasol
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhuntar (Kullu) airport, where our representative meets you, and drive up the Parvati valley to Kasol (about 31 km, 1 hour). In the afternoon, cross the bridge to Chalal village and walk along the Parvati river through the pine forest. Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kasol)Manikaran Sahib and hot springs
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Manikaran (about 4 km), a pilgrimage town for both Sikhs and Hindus. Visit the Gurudwara Manikaran Sahib and its langar, the Ram and Shiva temples, and the hot springs where rice is cooked in the boiling water. Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kasol)Barshaini and Tosh village
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Barshaini at the head of the road (about 16 km) and walk up to Tosh village (about 1.5 km uphill), with its wooden houses and views of the snow peaks at the end of the valley. Return to Kasol for a quiet evening by the river. Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Bhuntar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bhuntar airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Spiti Valley Circuit: Shimla to Manali
name: Spiti Valley Circuit: Shimla to Manali
page_title: Spiti Valley Circuit: Shimla to Manali – 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A nine-day circuit through Kinnaur and Spiti: Sarahan, Kalpa, Nako, the thousand-year-old Tabo monastery, Kaza and the high villages, and Chandratal lake, ending in Manali.
cities: Shimla - Sarahan - Kalpa - Tabo - Kaza - Chandratal - Manali

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrive Shimla
itinerary.text: Arrive in Shimla and check in. In the evening, walk along the Mall Road and the Ridge. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sarahan)Shimla to Sarahan
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Sarahan (about 170 km, 6–7 hours) by way of Narkanda and the Sutlej valley. Visit the Bhimakali temple, built in a mix of Hindu and Buddhist styles, with Shrikhand peak across the valley. Overnight stay in Sarahan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kalpa)Sarahan to Kalpa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive into Kinnaur to Kalpa (about 110 km, 4–5 hours). In the evening, watch the light on the Kinner Kailash range and walk to Roghi village among the apple orchards. Overnight stay in Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Tabo)Kalpa to Tabo via Nako
itinerary.text: After breakfast, follow the Sutlej and then the Spiti river to Nako, a village by a small lake, and on to Tabo (about 165 km, 7 hours). Tabo monastery, founded in 996 AD, has some of the oldest wall paintings in the Himalaya. Overnight stay in Tabo.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kaza)Tabo to Kaza via Dhankar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Dhankar, whose monastery is built on a ridge above the meeting of the Spiti and Pin rivers, and continue to Kaza (about 50 km in all), the main town of Spiti. Overnight stay in Kaza.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kaza)Key, Kibber, Langza and Hikkim
itinerary.text: A full day around Kaza: Key monastery on its hill, Kibber village, Langza with its large Buddha statue and fossil beds, and Hikkim, home of one of the highest post offices in the world. Overnight stay in Kaza.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Chandratal)Kaza to Chandratal via Kunzum La
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive over the Kunzum La pass (about 4,550 m) to Chandratal (about 85 km, 4–5 hours), the moon lake. Walk to the lake shore in the afternoon. Overnight stay in a camp near Chandratal.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Manali)Chandratal to Manali via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive down to Batal and Gramphu and through the Atal Tunnel to Manali (about 120 km, 5–6 hours). Evening at leisure on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : Departure from Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out for your onward journey from Manali. The tour ends here.

name: Kinnaur Valley Tour: Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa
page_title: Kinnaur Valley Tour: Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days in Kinnaur from Shimla: the Bhimakali temple at Sarahan, the Baspa valley at Sangla, Chitkul village, Kalpa below Kinner Kailash, and Narkanda on the way back.
cities: Shimla - Sarahan - Sangla - Chitkul - Kalpa - Narkanda

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Arrive Shimla
itinerary.text: Arrive in Shimla and check in. The evening is free on the Mall Road and the Ridge. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sarahan)Shimla to Sarahan
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Sarahan (about 170 km, 6–7 hours) through Narkanda and down to the Sutlej. Visit the Bhimakali temple in the evening. Overnight stay in Sarahan.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Kalpa (about 50 km, 2 hours), facing the Kinner Kailash range. Walk to Roghi village through the apple orchards. Overnight stay in Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Narkanda to Shimla – departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Shimla (about 60 km, 2 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends in Shimla.

description: Six days in the quieter valleys of Kullu: the Tirthan river, Jibhi's wooden villages, the Jalori Pass and Serolsar lake, then Manali and Solang.

itinerary.text: After a morning walk along the Tirthan river, drive to Jibhi (about 20 km). Visit the Jibhi waterfall and walk up to Chehni Kothi, an old tower temple built in the wood-and-stone style of the region. Overnight stay in Jibhi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Jibhi to Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Manali (about 110 km, 4 hours) through Banjar, Aut and the Kullu valley. Evening on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Manali and Solang valley

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Manali to Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Chandigarh (about 310 km, 8–9 hours). The tour ends here.

name: Chamba, Dalhousie and Khajjiar Tour
page_title: Chamba, Dalhousie and Khajjiar Tour – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in the Chamba valley: Dalhousie and Khajjiar, two nights in the old temple town of Chamba, and a day trip to Bharmour's Chaurasi temples.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dalhousie)Pathankot to Dalhousie
itinerary.text: Arrive at Pathankot and drive to Dalhousie (about 80 km, 3 hours). Evening walk on the Mall to Gandhi Chowk. Overnight stay in Dalhousie.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Khajjiar (about 22 km) for its meadow and the Khajji Nag temple, then continue down to Chamba on the Ravi (about 24 km). Evening at the Chaugan, the town's open green. Overnight stay in Chamba.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Dalhousie to Pathankot

name: Shimla and Manali Tour from Delhi
page_title: Shimla and Manali Tour from Delhi – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days by road from Delhi: two nights in Shimla with Kufri, and three nights in Manali with Solang valley and the Atal Tunnel.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shimla)Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Delhi for the drive to Shimla (about 350 km, 8–9 hours) by way of Chandigarh and the Kalka–Shimla highway. Check in and spend the evening on the Mall Road and the Ridge. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shimla)Kufri and Shimla
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Kufri (about 16 km) for views of the snow ranges and pony rides (paid locally). In the afternoon, visit the Jakhoo temple on Shimla's highest hill and the Viceregal Lodge at Summer Hill (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Manali)Shimla to Manali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Manali (about 250 km, 8–9 hours) along the Sutlej and then the Beas river, through Mandi and the Kullu valley, with a stop at the Pandoh dam. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Manali)Manali sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Hadimba Devi temple in its cedar forest, the hot springs at Vashisht, the Tibetan monastery and Manu temple in old Manali. Evening on the Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Manali)Solang valley and Atal Tunnel
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Solang valley (about 14 km) for paragliding, zorbing or the ropeway (all paid locally), then continue through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul when the road is open. Return to Manali in the evening. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Manali to Delhi
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive back to Delhi (about 540 km, 12–13 hours), arriving late in the evening. The tour ends in Delhi.

name: Auli and Joshimath Tour
page_title: Auli and Joshimath Tour – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days to Auli, the snow slopes above Joshimath: Devprayag on the way, two nights in Auli with the walk to Gorson Bugyal, and Nanda Devi views.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rudraprayag)Haridwar to Rudraprayag
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Haridwar into the Garhwal hills to Rudraprayag (about 165 km, 6–7 hours), stopping at Devprayag, where the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet to form the Ganga. Overnight stay in Rudraprayag.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Auli)Rudraprayag to Auli

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Auli)Auli and Gorson Bugyal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, walk from Auli to the Gorson Bugyal meadow (about 3 km) for views of Nanda Devi and the Garhwal peaks. In winter (about January to March), skiing and the Auli chairlift are available when operating (paid locally). Overnight stay in Auli.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Rudraprayag)Auli to Rudraprayag
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to Joshimath to visit the Narsingh temple, then on to Rudraprayag (about 150 km). Overnight stay in Rudraprayag.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Rudraprayag to Haridwar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Haridwar (about 165 km, 6–7 hours) along the Alaknanda and Ganga. The tour ends at Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Rudraprayag to Haridwar

name: Kausani and Binsar Tour
page_title: Kausani and Binsar Tour – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in Kumaon for its Himalayan views: Binsar's forest sanctuary and the Jageshwar temples, then Kausani, Gandhi's Anasakti Ashram and Baijnath.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Binsar)Kathgodam to Binsar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kathgodam railway station and drive to Binsar (about 120 km, 4–5 hours) through Almora. Binsar is a forest sanctuary on a ridge with a long view of the Himalaya. Overnight stay in Binsar.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, walk through the oak and rhododendron forest to Zero Point (sanctuary entry paid locally) for the view of Nanda Devi, Trishul and Panchachuli. In the afternoon, visit the Jageshwar temple group of more than a hundred stone shrines. Overnight stay in Binsar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kausani)Binsar to Kausani

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kausani)Baijnath and the tea estate
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Baijnath temples on the Gomti river (about 16 km), the Kausani tea estate and a local shawl weaving centre. Overnight stay in Kausani.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Kausani to Kathgodam

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Mukteshwar to Kathgodam

page_title: Haridwar, Rishikesh, Mussoorie and Dhanaulti – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from the Ganga to the hills: the Ganga aarti at Haridwar, two nights in Rishikesh, and Mussoorie with Dhanaulti and Kempty Falls.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Mussoorie to Dehradun

title: Rishikesh, Auli and Chopta Tour
name: Rishikesh, Auli and Chopta Tour
page_title: Rishikesh, Auli and Chopta Tour – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days in the high Garhwal hills: Rishikesh on the Ganga, two nights in Auli below Nanda Devi, and two at Chopta for the Tungnath and Chandrashila walk.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rishikesh)Haridwar to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: Arrive in Haridwar and drive to Rishikesh (about 25 km). In the evening, attend the Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat or Parmarth Niketan. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Auli)Rishikesh to Auli
itinerary.text: An early start for the long drive to Auli (about 260 km, 9–10 hours) past the five sacred confluences of Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, Nandprayag and, near Joshimath, Vishnuprayag. Overnight stay in Auli.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Auli)Auli and Gorson Bugyal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, walk to the Gorson Bugyal meadow (about 3 km) for views of Nanda Devi. In winter, skiing and the chairlift are available when operating (paid locally). Overnight stay in Auli.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Chopta)Auli to Chopta
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Chopta (about 165 km, 6 hours) by way of Chamoli and Gopeshwar. Overnight stay in Chopta.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Chopta)Tungnath and Chandrashila
itinerary.text: An early start for the walk to Tungnath (about 3.5 km), one of the Panch Kedar, and on to Chandrashila summit for the view of the high Himalaya. Return to Chopta. Overnight stay in Chopta.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Rishikesh)Chopta to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Rishikesh (about 200 km, 7–8 hours) through Ukhimath and Rudraprayag. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Rishikesh to Haridwar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Haridwar for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Rudraprayag to Haridwar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Haridwar (about 165 km, 6–7 hours) along the Alaknanda and Ganga. The tour ends at Haridwar.

title: Do Dham Yatra: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar
name: Do Dham Yatra: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar
page_title: Do Dham Yatra: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days for the two western dhams: Yamunotri from Barkot and Gangotri from Uttarkashi, ending with the Ganga aarti in Rishikesh.
cities: Haridwar - Barkot - Yamunotri - Uttarkashi - Gangotri - Rishikesh

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Barkot)Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive from Haridwar to Barkot (about 210 km, 7–8 hours) by way of Mussoorie, with a stop at Kempty Falls. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Barkot)Yamunotri darshan
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, drive to Janki Chatti (about 45 km) and walk up to Yamunotri (about 6 km), or go by pony or palki (paid locally). Bathe at the hot spring, offer prayers at the Divya Shila and Surya Kund, and have darshan at the Yamunotri temple. Walk down and drive back to Barkot. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Uttarkashi)Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Uttarkashi (about 100 km, 4 hours) on the Bhagirathi. Visit the Kashi Vishwanath temple in the evening. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Uttarkashi)Gangotri darshan
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, drive to Gangotri (about 100 km, 3–4 hours) through Harsil and past the hot springs at Gangnani. Bathe in the Bhagirathi, have darshan at the Gangotri temple and drive back to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Rishikesh)Uttarkashi to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to Rishikesh (about 150 km, 5–6 hours) through Chamba. In the evening, attend the Ganga aarti at Triveni Ghat. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Rishikesh to Haridwar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Haridwar (about 25 km) for your onward journey. The yatra ends here.

page_title: Hampi Heritage Tour – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days at Hampi, the ruined capital of the Vijayanagara empire: the Virupaksha and Vittala temples, the royal centre, Anegundi and the Tungabhadra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Hampi to Hospet
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Hospet for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Udaipur
name: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Udaipur
page_title: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Udaipur – 9 Nights / 10 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Ten days from Delhi through the Golden Triangle and on to the Blue City of Jodhpur, the Ranakpur temple and the lakes of Udaipur.
cities: Delhi - Agra - Jaipur - Jodhpur - Ranakpur - Udaipur

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Delhi)Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Arrive in Delhi, where our representative meets you at the airport or railway station and transfers you to your hotel. In the evening, drive past India Gate and the government buildings of Rajpath (Kartavya Path). Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Delhi)Delhi sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, see Old and New Delhi: the Red Fort (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) and the Jama Masjid, a cycle-rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk (paid locally), Raj Ghat, Humayun's Tomb and the Qutub Minar. Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Agra)Delhi to Agra
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Agra (about 230 km, 4 hours) on the Yamuna Expressway. In the afternoon, visit Agra Fort and the Itimad-ud-Daulah tomb, often called the Baby Taj, and watch sunset over the Taj Mahal from Mehtab Bagh across the river. Overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jaipur)Taj Mahal – Fatehpur Sikri – Jaipur
itinerary.text: Visit the Taj Mahal at sunrise (closed on Fridays). After breakfast, drive to Jaipur (about 240 km, 5 hours), stopping at Fatehpur Sikri, the abandoned Mughal capital and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jaipur)Amber Fort and the Pink City
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Amber Fort on its hill above Maota Lake, stopping for a photo of the Jal Mahal on the way. itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Jodhpur)Jaipur to Jodhpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jodhpur (about 335 km, 6 hours). In the evening, walk through the old city around the Clock Tower. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Jodhpur)Jodhpur sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Mehrangarh Fort, rising above the blue houses of the old city, and the marble Jaswant Thada memorial. In the afternoon, see the Umaid Bhawan Palace museum and walk through the market at the Clock Tower. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Udaipur)Jodhpur to Udaipur via Ranakpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Udaipur (about 260 km, 6–7 hours), visiting the marble Jain temple at Ranakpur, with its 1,444 carved pillars, on the way. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Udaipur)Udaipur sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the City Palace above Lake Pichola, the Jagdish temple and the Saheliyon Ki Bari gardens. In the evening, take a boat on Lake Pichola (paid locally) or watch the folk dance show at Bagore Ki Haveli (paid locally). Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Udaipur airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

In the afternoon, drive to Sarnath (about 10 km), where the Buddha gave his first sermon: the Dhamek Stupa and the museum with the Lion Capital of Ashoka (the museum is closed on Fridays). itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Prayagraj (about 170 km, 4 hours). In the late afternoon, take a boat to the Triveni Sangam (paid locally) and visit the Bade Hanuman temple. Overnight stay in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Prayagraj
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Anand Bhawan if time allows (entry paid locally), then transfer to Prayagraj airport or railway station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: An early start for the climb from Katra through Banganga and Ardhkuwari to the Bhawan (about 13 km), on foot or by pony or palki (paid locally); the helicopter to Sanjhichhat is booked separately. After darshan of the Holy Cave, take the ropeway or walk up to the Bhairon temple, then return to Katra. Overnight stay in Katra.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jwalamukhi)Katra to Chintpurni and Jwalamukhi
itinerary.text: After a late breakfast, drive to Chintpurni (about 170 km, 5 hours) for darshan at the Chintpurni Mata temple, then on to Jwalamukhi (about 35 km). Overnight stay at Jwalamukhi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jwalamukhi)Jwalamukhi and Kangra Devi
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at the Jwalamukhi temple, where natural flames burn from the rock, then drive to Kangra for the Brajeshwari Devi temple and Kangra Fort. Return to Jwalamukhi. Overnight stay at Jwalamukhi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Amritsar)Jwalamukhi to Amritsar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Amritsar (about 200 km, 5 hours). In the evening, visit the Golden Temple for the Palki Sahib ceremony. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Amritsar)Amritsar and the Attari border
itinerary.text: Morning at the Golden Temple, with langar, then Jallianwala Bagh and the Durgiana temple. In the afternoon, drive to the Attari–Wagah border for the Beating Retreat ceremony. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Amritsar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Amritsar airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Madurai airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Meenakshi Amman temple, with its towering gopurams, and the Thirumalai Nayak Palace. Return to the temple at night for the Palliyarai ceremony if you wish. Overnight stay in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kodaikanal)Madurai to Kodaikanal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive up to Kodaikanal (about 120 km, 3.5 hours), stopping at the Silver Cascade falls. Evening by Kodai Lake. Overnight stay in Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kodaikanal)Kodaikanal sightseeing
itinerary.text: After breakfast, walk along Coaker's Walk, visit Bryant Park, the Pillar Rocks and Guna Caves viewpoint, and take a boat or cycle round Kodai Lake (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Madurai)Kodaikanal to Madurai
itinerary.text: After a slow morning in the hills, drive back to Madurai. In the afternoon, visit the Gandhi Memorial Museum and the Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam tank. Overnight stay in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Madurai
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Madurai airport or railway station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Pondicherry and Auroville Break
page_title: Pondicherry and Auroville Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: A three-day break in Pondicherry from Chennai: the French Quarter and Promenade, the Aurobindo Ashram, Auroville, and the boat to Paradise Beach.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pondicherry)Chennai to Pondicherry
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Chennai airport or railway station for the drive down the East Coast Road to Pondicherry (about 150 km, 3.5 hours). In the evening, walk along the Promenade on Goubert Avenue, where the road closes to traffic at night. Overnight stay in Pondicherry.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pondicherry)French Quarter, Auroville and Paradise Beach
itinerary.text: After breakfast, explore the French Quarter — Rue Romain Rolland, the Notre Dame des Anges church and the Sri Aurobindo Ashram — then drive to Auroville for the Matrimandir viewing point (the inner chamber needs advance booking). In the afternoon, take the boat from Chunnambar to Paradise Beach (paid locally). Overnight stay in Pondicherry.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Pondicherry to Chennai
itinerary.text: After a slow breakfast at a café in White Town, drive back to Chennai (about 150 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Rameswaram and Kanyakumari Tour
name: Rameswaram and Kanyakumari Tour
page_title: Rameswaram and Kanyakumari Tour – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days from Madurai to the tip of India: Rameswaram's temple and holy wells, Dhanushkodi, and sunset and sunrise at Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rameswaram)Madurai to Rameswaram
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Madurai airport or railway station for the drive to Rameswaram (about 175 km, 4 hours), crossing to the island on the Pamban bridge. In the evening, have darshan at the Ramanathaswamy temple and walk its long pillared corridor. Overnight stay in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Rameswaram)Theertham bath, Dhanushkodi and Kalam memorial
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, bathe in the 22 holy wells inside the Ramanathaswamy temple and at Agni Theertham (wet clothes are carried; changing rooms are available). Later, drive to Dhanushkodi and Arichal Munai, and visit the Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam memorial on the way back. Overnight stay in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kanyakumari)Rameswaram to Kanyakumari
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive south along the coast to Kanyakumari (about 310 km, 6 hours). Arrive in time for sunset where three seas meet. Overnight stay in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Sunrise at Kanyakumari – Trivandrum
itinerary.text: Watch the sunrise, then take the ferry to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial (paid locally) and visit the Kumari Amman temple. Drive to Trivandrum (about 90 km), stopping at Padmanabhapuram Palace (closed on Mondays). The tour ends at Trivandrum.

title: Chennai to Thanjavur: Coast and Chola Temples
name: Chennai to Thanjavur: Coast and Chola Temples
page_title: Chennai to Thanjavur: Coast and Chola Temples – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from Chennai down the coast to the Chola country: Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, the Nataraja temple at Chidambaram, and Thanjavur.
cities: Chennai - Mahabalipuram - Pondicherry - Chidambaram - Thanjavur - Trichy

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Chennai)Arrive in Chennai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Chennai airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit the Government Museum and its bronze gallery, the Kapaleeshwarar temple and Marina Beach. Overnight stay in Chennai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mahabalipuram)Chennai to Mahabalipuram
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Mahabalipuram (about 58 km). Spend the day among the Pallava monuments — the Shore Temple, the Five Rathas, Arjuna's Penance and the cave temples — a UNESCO World Heritage Site (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Mahabalipuram.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pondicherry)Mahabalipuram to Pondicherry
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Pondicherry (about 100 km, 2.5 hours). In the afternoon, walk through the French Quarter and visit the Sri Aurobindo Ashram; evening on the Promenade. Overnight stay in Pondicherry.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Thanjavur)Pondicherry to Thanjavur via Chidambaram
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Chidambaram (about 70 km) for the Nataraja temple, where Shiva is worshipped as the cosmic dancer, then on to Thanjavur (about 120 km). Overnight stay in Thanjavur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Thanjavur)Brihadeeswarar and Darasuram
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Brihadeeswarar temple, built by Rajaraja Chola, and the Thanjavur Palace with its art gallery. In the afternoon, drive to Darasuram for the Airavatesvara temple. Overnight stay in Thanjavur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Thanjavur to Trichy
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Trichy (about 60 km), visiting the Srirangam temple before your onward journey. The tour ends at Trichy.

title: Temples, Coast and Hills of Tamil Nadu
name: Temples, Coast and Hills of Tamil Nadu
page_title: Temples, Coast and Hills of Tamil Nadu – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days in a loop of southern Tamil Nadu: the Meenakshi temple at Madurai, Rameswaram and Dhanushkodi, Kanyakumari, and the cool hills of Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Madurai)Arrive in Madurai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Madurai airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the evening, visit the Meenakshi Amman temple, with its fourteen gopurams, and stay for the night ceremony if you wish. Overnight stay in Madurai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Rameswaram)Madurai to Rameswaram
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a visit to the Thirumalai Nayak Palace, drive to Rameswaram (about 175 km) across the Pamban bridge. Evening darshan at the Ramanathaswamy temple. Overnight stay in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Rameswaram)Holy wells and Dhanushkodi
itinerary.text: Early morning bath in the temple's holy wells, then drive to Dhanushkodi and Arichal Munai at the tip of the island. Visit the Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam memorial in the afternoon. Overnight stay in Rameswaram.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kanyakumari)Rameswaram to Kanyakumari
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Kanyakumari (about 310 km, 6 hours). Sunset over the sea in the evening. Overnight stay in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kanyakumari)Kanyakumari and Suchindram
itinerary.text: Sunrise at the tip of India, then the ferry to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and the Thiruvalluvar statue (paid locally). In the afternoon, visit the Suchindram temple with its musical pillars. Overnight stay in Kanyakumari.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kodaikanal)Kanyakumari to Kodaikanal
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive north to Kodaikanal (about 330 km, 7–8 hours) by way of Tirunelveli and up the ghat road. Overnight stay in Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Kodaikanal)Kodaikanal
itinerary.text: A day in the hills: Coaker's Walk, Bryant Park, the Pillar Rocks and a boat or cycle round Kodai Lake (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kodaikanal.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Kodaikanal to Madurai
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to Madurai (about 120 km, 3.5 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pattaya)Coral Island
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take a speedboat to Coral Island (Koh Larn) for its clear water and white-sand beaches; parasailing and sea walks are available (boat and activities paid locally). Evening free, with the Alcazar show optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bangkok)Pattaya to Bangkok – city tour

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Bangkok

title: Bangkok and Ayutthaya Tour
name: Bangkok and Ayutthaya Tour
page_title: Bangkok and Ayutthaya Tour – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of Bangkok's temples and history: the Grand Palace, Wat Pho and Wat Arun, the ruined royal capital of Ayutthaya, and a floating market.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bangkok)Arrive in Bangkok
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangkok airport, where our representative meets you, and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, take a walk through the lights of Sukhumvit or a market such as Asiatique by the river. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bangkok)Grand Palace and the river temples
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Grand Palace and the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, Wat Pho with its 46-metre reclining Buddha, and cross the Chao Phraya by ferry to Wat Arun (temple entry paid locally; covered shoulders and knees). Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bangkok)Ayutthaya
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Ayutthaya (about 80 km), the old royal capital and a UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Buddha head in the tree roots at Wat Mahathat, Wat Phra Si Sanphet and Wat Chaiwatthanaram by the river. Return to Bangkok in the evening. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Floating market – departure
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, visit the Damnoen Saduak floating market (about 100 km; boat paid locally) if your flight time allows, then transfer to the airport. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Phuket)Arrive in Phuket
itinerary.text: Arrive at Phuket airport, where our representative meets you, and transfer to your hotel near Patong, Kata or Karon beach. Evening free on the beach. Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Phuket)Phuket island tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a half-day tour of Phuket: the Big Buddha on Nakkerd Hill, Wat Chalong, the colourful Sino-Portuguese shophouses of Old Phuket Town and the Karon viewpoint over three bays. Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Phuket)Phi Phi Islands
itinerary.text: A full day by speedboat to the Phi Phi Islands: Maya Bay (open with daily limits), Pileh Lagoon and snorkelling stops (tour and national park fee paid locally; Maya Bay may close in the monsoon). Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Phuket)Phang Nga Bay
itinerary.text: A day trip to Phang Nga Bay, with limestone towers rising from the sea, sea-canoeing through caves and James Bond Island (tour and park fee paid locally). Overnight stay in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Phuket
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Phuket airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Krabi)Arrive in Krabi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Krabi airport, where our representative meets you, and transfer to your hotel at Ao Nang. Evening on the beach, with limestone cliffs at both ends. Overnight stay in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Krabi)Four Islands tour
itinerary.text: A day on the water: the Four Islands tour by longtail boat — Phra Nang Cave beach, the sandbar between Chicken and Tup islands, and Poda island (tour and park fee paid locally). Overnight stay in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Krabi)Hong Islands
itinerary.text: A day by longtail or speedboat to the Hong Islands, with a hidden lagoon ringed by cliffs and quiet beaches for swimming (tour and park fee paid locally). Overnight stay in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Krabi)Tiger Cave temple and Emerald Pool
itinerary.text: After breakfast, climb the more than 1,200 steps to the Tiger Cave temple for the view over the coast, then cool off at the Emerald Pool in the forest (entry paid locally). Evening on Ao Nang beach. Overnight stay in Krabi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Krabi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Krabi airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ubud)Arrive in Bali – Ubud
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bali (Denpasar) airport, where our representative meets you, and drive to Ubud (about 1.5 hours). Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ubud)Ubud
itinerary.text: After breakfast, spend the day around Ubud: the Tegallalang rice terraces, the Sacred Monkey Forest, the Ubud Palace and the art market (entry fees paid locally). Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gili Trawangan)Fast boat to the Gili Islands
itinerary.text: An early transfer to Padang Bai for the fast boat to Gili Trawangan off Lombok (about 2 hours; boat ticket not included). The island has no cars — get around on foot, by bicycle or horse cart. Sunset on the west coast. Overnight stay on Gili Trawangan.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gili Trawangan)Snorkelling with turtles
itinerary.text: A glass-bottom boat trip round the three Gili islands, snorkelling with sea turtles and over the underwater statues off Gili Meno (paid locally). Overnight stay on Gili Trawangan.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Seminyak)Back to Bali – Seminyak
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take the fast boat back to Bali and transfer to Seminyak. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Seminyak)Tanah Lot and Uluwatu
itinerary.text: After a free morning, visit the Tanah Lot temple on its rock in the sea, then drive to the Uluwatu temple on its cliff for sunset; the Kecak fire dance is optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Bali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bali (Denpasar) airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

page_title: Yogyakarta and Bali: Borobudur and Prambanan – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days in Indonesia: the great temples of Borobudur and Prambanan from Yogyakarta on Java, then Bali's Ubud, Tanah Lot and Uluwatu.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Yogyakarta)Arrive in Yogyakarta
itinerary.text: Arrive at Yogyakarta airport, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit the Kraton, the Sultan's palace, and the Taman Sari water castle, and walk along Malioboro Street in the evening. Overnight stay in Yogyakarta.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Yogyakarta)Borobudur and Prambanan
itinerary.text: An early start for Borobudur, the largest Buddhist monument in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site (entry paid locally; access to the upper terraces is limited). In the afternoon, visit the Hindu temples of Prambanan, also on the UNESCO list. Overnight stay in Yogyakarta.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ubud)Yogyakarta to Bali
itinerary.text: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Bali (about 1 hour 15 minutes; ticket not included). Our representative meets you and drives you to Ubud. Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, see the Tegallalang rice terraces, drive up to Kintamani for the view of Mount Batur, and visit the Tirta Empul water temple (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Kuta)Ubud to Kuta – Tanah Lot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, move to Kuta, visiting the Tanah Lot sea temple for sunset on the way. Overnight stay in Kuta.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kuta)Uluwatu
itinerary.text: A free morning on the beach, then the Uluwatu temple on its cliff for sunset; the Kecak dance is optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kuta.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Bali
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bali (Denpasar) airport for your flight home. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dirang)Guwahati to Dirang
itinerary.text: Arrive at Guwahati airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. Drive north across the Brahmaputra plain to Bhalukpong on the Arunachal border, where permits are checked, then climb through Tenga to Dirang (about 300 km, 9–10 hours). Overnight stay in Dirang.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive over the Sela pass (about 4,170 m), with its high lake, to the Jaswant Garh war memorial and down to Tawang (about 140 km, 6 hours). Overnight stay in Tawang.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tawang)Tawang monastery
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Tawang monastery, the largest in India, founded in the 17th century, with its library and giant Buddha statue, the Tawang war memorial, and the Urgelling monastery, birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama. Overnight stay in Tawang.
