title: Tawang with Bum La Pass
name: Tawang with Bum La Pass
page_title: Tawang with Bum La Pass – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days to Tawang with a day to Bum La pass on the China border and Madhuri lake, plus Dirang, the Sela pass and Bomdila.
cities: Guwahati - Dirang - Tawang - Bum La - Madhuri Lake - Bomdila

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dirang)Guwahati to Dirang
itinerary.text: You are met at Guwahati airport or station for the long first day: north across the plains to the Arunachal border at Bhalukpong, where your Inner Line Permit is checked, then up the Kameng valley past Tenga to Dirang (about 300 km, 9–10 hours). Overnight stay in Dirang.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dirang)Dirang
itinerary.text: A rest day for the altitude: the Dirang dzong, the hot springs and the Sangti valley. Overnight stay in Dirang.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tawang)Dirang to Tawang
itinerary.text: The road climbs steadily to the Sela pass, often snowbound in winter, with its frozen or deep-blue lake beside a prayer-flag gate. Pay respects at Jaswant Garh, the memorial to a rifleman of the 1962 war, and descend into the Tawang valley (about 140 km). Overnight stay in Tawang.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Tawang)Tawang monastery
itinerary.text: A day in Tawang town: the Galden Namgyal Lhatse monastery, home to several hundred monks and a two-storey golden Buddha, the hilltop war memorial with the names of the soldiers of 1962, and the small Urgelling gompa where the 6th Dalai Lama was born. Overnight stay in Tawang.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Tawang)Bum La pass and Madhuri lake
itinerary.text: With the special army permit arranged through the Tawang district office, drive to Bum La pass (about 4,600 m) on the India–China border, and on the way back stop at Madhuri (Sangetsar) lake (shared local vehicle paid locally; the road is open only on some days and in good weather). Overnight stay in Tawang.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Bomdila)Tawang to Bomdila
itinerary.text: Leave Tawang after breakfast and recross the Sela pass, stopping at the roaring Jang (Nuranang) waterfall, before the long descent to Bomdila (about 180 km). The upper Gompa there looks out over the Kameng hills. Overnight stay in Bomdila.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Guwahati)Bomdila to Guwahati
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Guwahati (about 280 km). Overnight stay in Guwahati.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Guwahati
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the Assam State Museum or a little shopping for Assam silk and tea before the transfer to Guwahati airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive over the Sela pass to Tawang (about 180 km), stopping at the Jaswant Garh war memorial. Overnight stay in Tawang.

name: Central Arunachal: Ziro, Along and Pasighat
page_title: Central Arunachal: Ziro, Along and Pasighat – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days across central Arunachal by road: Itanagar, the Ziro valley, Daporijo, Along on the Siyom and Pasighat on the Siang, ending in Dibrugarh.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Itanagar)Arrive in Itanagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Itanagar airport or Naharlagun station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Ita fort and the state museum. Overnight stay in Itanagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ziro)Itanagar to Ziro
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive north through the forested Lower Subansiri hills to the Ziro valley (about 115 km, 4–5 hours). In the evening, walk into Hong, one of the largest Apatani villages, with its bamboo houses and prayer poles. Overnight stay in Ziro.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ziro)Ziro valley
itinerary.text: A day among the Apatani villages of Hari and Hija and their rice fields, where fish are raised in the flooded paddies, then a drive through the pine and bamboo forest towards the Talley valley wildlife sanctuary (forest permit paid locally). Overnight stay in Ziro.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Daporijo)Ziro to Daporijo
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue east to Daporijo on the Subansiri river (about 160 km, 6 hours), through the hills of the Tagin people, with stops at hanging bridges and village viewpoints on the way. Overnight stay in Daporijo.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Along)Daporijo to Along
itinerary.text: Drive to Along (Aalo) on the Siyom river (about 150 km), home of the Galo people, and walk across a cane suspension bridge. Overnight stay in Along.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Pasighat)Along to Pasighat
itinerary.text: Drive down the Siang valley to Pasighat (about 110 km), the oldest town in Arunachal, where the Siang leaves the hills. Evening by the river. Overnight stay in Pasighat.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dibrugarh)Pasighat to Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to the plains and cross the Bogibeel bridge, India's longest rail-cum-road bridge, over the Brahmaputra to Dibrugarh (about 160 km). Evening free in the tea city. Overnight stay in Dibrugarh.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for a walk on the Brahmaputra riverfront or a last look at a tea garden before the transfer to Dibrugarh airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Dibrugarh airport, where our representative meets you, and drive east to Miao (about 160 km, 5 hours), the gateway to Namdapha National Park. Visit the Tibetan refugee settlement and the mini zoo. Overnight stay in Miao.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Deban)Miao to Deban
itinerary.text: Drive into the park to Deban on the Noa-Dihing river (about 25 km), with walks in the rainforest, one of the most varied in India, home to hornbills, gibbons and four big cats (forest permit and guide paid locally). Overnight stay at the Deban forest lodge or at Miao.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Deban)Rainforest walk
itinerary.text: A guided walk along the Noa-Dihing river or up to the Hornbill viewpoint for birds, butterflies and, with luck, the hoolock gibbons calling in the canopy (guide paid locally). Overnight stay at Deban or Miao.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Miao)Deban to Miao
itinerary.text: An early bird walk by the river at Deban, the best time for hornbills and kingfishers, then drive back out of the park to Miao and an afternoon at the Tibetan refugee settlement's carpet weavers. Overnight stay in Miao.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dibrugarh)Miao to Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Dibrugarh, stopping at Digboi for its war cemetery and the museum of India's oldest working oil refinery (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Dibrugarh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for a walk on the Brahmaputra riverfront or a last look at a tea garden before the transfer to Dibrugarh airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Parshuram Kund Pilgrimage
name: Parshuram Kund Pilgrimage
page_title: Parshuram Kund Pilgrimage – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days for the pilgrimage to Parshuram Kund on the Lohit river, with Tezu and the Mishmi hills of eastern Arunachal.
cities: Dibrugarh - Tezu - Parshuram Kund - Lohit River

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Tezu)Dibrugarh to Tezu
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dibrugarh airport, where our representative meets you, and drive to Tezu over the Dhola–Sadiya (Bhupen Hazarika) bridge (about 200 km, 5–6 hours). Overnight stay in Tezu.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Tezu)Parshuram Kund
itinerary.text: Drive to Parshuram Kund on the Lohit river (about 25 km), where Parshuram is said to have washed away his sin; take the holy bath and visit the temple. Overnight stay in Tezu.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tezu)Tezu and Glow lake
itinerary.text: A day by the Lohit: the Tezu market and the Mishmi villages, or, for walkers, the forest trail to Glow lake (guide paid locally). Overnight stay in Tezu.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dibrugarh)Tezu to Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After a last morning by the Lohit river, drive back over the Dhola–Sadiya bridge, one of India's longest river bridges, to Dibrugarh (about 200 km). Overnight stay in Dibrugarh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for a walk on the Brahmaputra riverfront or a last look at a tea garden before the transfer to Dibrugarh airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

page_title: Kohima and Khonoma – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kohima)Kohima

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Khonoma)Khonoma green village

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kohima)Khonoma to Kohima
itinerary.text: A morning walk in the terraced fields, then back to Kohima for the market. Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Kohima to Dimapur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to Dimapur for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kohima)Dzukou to Kohima

page_title: Hornbill Festival, Kohima – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days for the Hornbill Festival in Kohima (1–10 December): three days among the Naga tribes at Kisama, plus the war cemetery and Khonoma.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Dimapur airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. See the Kachari ruins, then drive up to Kohima (about 75 km, 3 hours). Evening at the Hornbill night bazaar. Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kohima)Hornbill Festival
itinerary.text: A full day at the Hornbill Festival at the Kisama Heritage Village, where all the Naga tribes gather with dances, songs, games, food and crafts in front of their traditional houses (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kohima)Kohima and Khonoma – festival evening
itinerary.text: Morning at the Kohima War Cemetery, then Khonoma village. Afternoon back at Kisama for the festival. Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kohima)Hornbill Festival
itinerary.text: Another day at the festival, with the morning ceremonies and the Naga wrestling and chilli-eating contests. Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Kohima to Dimapur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down to Dimapur for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mon and Longwa: Konyak Country
name: Mon and Longwa: Konyak Country
page_title: Mon and Longwa: Konyak Country – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days to the Konyak country of Nagaland: Mon, the border village of Longwa where the chief's house is half in Myanmar, and Sivasagar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Sivasagar)Dibrugarh to Sivasagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dibrugarh airport, where our representative meets you, and drive to Sivasagar (about 80 km) for the Ahom monuments: the Shivadol temple, the Rang Ghar and the Talatal Ghar. Overnight stay in Sivasagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mon)Sivasagar to Mon
itinerary.text: Drive through Sonari into Nagaland to Mon (about 110 km), home of the Konyak Nagas, once headhunters, known for their facial tattoos. Overnight stay in Mon.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Longwa)Mon to Longwa
itinerary.text: Drive to Longwa (about 40 km), a Konyak village that sits across the India–Myanmar border; the chief's (Angh's) house stands half in each country. Overnight stay in a Longwa homestay.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Mon)Longwa to Mon
itinerary.text: A morning walk through Longwa and its fields, then back to Mon and the nearby villages of Shangnyu or Chui. Overnight stay in Mon.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Mon)Konyak villages
itinerary.text: A day visiting Konyak villages with a local guide (paid locally), to see the morungs and woodcarving. Overnight stay in Mon.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Dibrugarh)Mon to Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, leave the Konyak hills and drive back through Sonari to Dibrugarh (about 160 km, 5 hours), with time in the evening for the Brahmaputra riverfront. Overnight stay in Dibrugarh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Dibrugarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for a walk on the Brahmaputra riverfront or a last look at a tea garden before the transfer to Dibrugarh airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Kohima and Kaziranga
page_title: Kohima and Kaziranga – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days in Nagaland and Assam: Kohima's war cemetery and Khonoma, then rhinos at Kaziranga and the Kamakhya temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kohima)Dimapur to Kohima
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dimapur airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. See the Kachari ruins, then drive up to Kohima (about 75 km, 3 hours). Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kohima)Kohima and Khonoma
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Kohima War Cemetery and the state museum, then drive to Khonoma village (about 20 km). Overnight stay in Kohima.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kaziranga)Kohima to Kaziranga
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down from the Naga hills to the plains and on to Kaziranga (about 200 km, 6 hours) through Dimapur and Bokakhat. Evening free at your lodge on the park edge. Overnight stay at Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kaziranga)Kaziranga safaris
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon jeep safaris in Kaziranga for the one-horned rhino, elephants and wild buffalo (paid locally). Overnight stay at Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Guwahati)Kaziranga to Guwahati
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive west to Guwahati (about 200 km, 5 hours). In the afternoon, visit the Kamakhya temple on Nilachal hill, one of the most important Shakti Peeths, and the Brahmaputra riverfront. Overnight stay in Guwahati.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Guwahati
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the Assam State Museum or a little shopping for Assam silk and tea before the transfer to Guwahati airport or station. The tour ends here.

name: Puri Jagannath Darshan
page_title: Puri Jagannath Darshan – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Puri for darshan at the Jagannath temple, with Dhauli, Pipili and the painters' village of Raghurajpur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Puri)Bhubaneswar to Puri
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you, and take the road south to Puri (around 1.5 hours), breaking the journey at the white Peace Pagoda on Dhauli hill, the site of the Kalinga war, and in Pipili, where the lanes are hung with bright appliqué lanterns and canopies. Evening aarti at the Jagannath temple and a walk on the Grand Road. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Puri)Jagannath darshan and Raghurajpur
itinerary.text: Rise early for darshan of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra at the 12th-century Shree Jagannath temple, one of the Char Dham (phones, cameras and leather are kept outside). In the afternoon, drive to Raghurajpur, where every house is a painter's studio for pattachitra and palm-leaf art, and return for a walk on the sands. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Puri to Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: Check out after breakfast and drive from Puri back to Bhubaneswar (about 60 km) for your train or flight. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhubaneswar)Dhauli, museum and Nandankanan

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bhubaneswar airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhubaneswar)Arrive in Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Puri)Konark – Puri

itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue to the coast at Puri, with two stops on the way: Dhauli, where Ashoka's rock edicts mark the end of his wars, and Pipili, a village of craftsmen stitching colourful appliqué. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Baripada)Bhubaneswar to Baripada
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you, and drive north to Baripada (about 250 km, 5–6 hours), the gateway to Simlipal. Overnight stay in Baripada or near the park gate.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Simlipal)Into Simlipal
itinerary.text: Enter the tiger reserve by the Pithabata gate in a permitted vehicle (entry and vehicle paid locally) through sal forests to the Barehipani falls, one of the highest in India, and the Joranda falls. Overnight stay in a forest lodge or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Simlipal)Simlipal
itinerary.text: A second day in the forest for elephants, gaur and birds, and the Chahala meadows. Overnight stay in a forest lodge or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Baripada)Simlipal to Baripada
itinerary.text: Back to Baripada for the Ambika temple and the Mayurbhanj palace. Overnight stay in Baripada.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Baripada to Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bhubaneswar for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bhitarkanika Mangroves
name: Bhitarkanika Mangroves
page_title: Bhitarkanika Mangroves – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in the Bhitarkanika mangroves: boat trips through the creeks for saltwater crocodiles and birds, the heronry and the Gahirmatha coast.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhitarkanika)Bhubaneswar to Bhitarkanika
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Khola or Gupti jetty (about 150 km, 4 hours) for the boat through the creeks of Bhitarkanika National Park to Dangmal (boat and entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Dangmal or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhitarkanika)Creeks and crocodiles
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon boats through the mangrove creeks for saltwater crocodiles, monitor lizards, spotted deer and kingfishers, and a walk at the crocodile breeding centre. Overnight stay at Dangmal or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhitarkanika)Heronry and Ekakula
itinerary.text: A boat to the Bagagahana heronry (in season) and Ekakula beach near the Gahirmatha coast, where olive ridley turtles nest. Overnight stay at Dangmal or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bhubaneswar)Bhitarkanika to Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, return by boat and drive to Bhubaneswar. In the afternoon, see the old temple town of Bhubaneswar: the towering Lingaraj, the small, richly carved Mukteswara, often called the gem of Odisha architecture, and the red-sandstone Rajarani, followed by the hill caves cut for Jain monks at Udayagiri and Khandagiri (fees paid locally). Overnight stay in Bhubaneswar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bhubaneswar airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Puri, Konark and Bhitarkanika
name: Puri, Konark and Bhitarkanika
page_title: Puri, Konark and Bhitarkanika – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days in Odisha: the temples of Bhubaneswar and Puri, the Konark Sun Temple, and two nights in the Bhitarkanika mangroves.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Puri)Bhubaneswar to Puri
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the morning, see the old temple town of Bhubaneswar: the towering Lingaraj, the small, richly carved Mukteswara, often called the gem of Odisha architecture, and the red-sandstone Rajarani, followed by the hill caves cut for Jain monks at Udayagiri and Khandagiri (fees paid locally). Then continue to the coast at Puri, with two stops on the way: Dhauli, where Ashoka's rock edicts mark the end of his wars, and Pipili, a village of craftsmen stitching colourful appliqué. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Puri)Jagannath and Raghurajpur
itinerary.text: A morning at the Jagannath temple for darshan and the sight of the mahaprasad kitchens at work (no phones or leather inside), then the Gundicha temple at the end of the Rath Yatra road. After lunch, visit the heritage crafts village of Raghurajpur for pattachitra paintings. Evening by the sea. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Puri)Konark Sun Temple
itinerary.text: After breakfast, head up the Marine Drive to Konark (about 35 km) and its Sun Temple, the "Black Pagoda" of old sailors, whose wheels double as sundials; the archaeological museum next door holds carvings from the temple (entry paid locally). Return by Chandrabhaga beach. Return to Puri. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bhitarkanika)Puri to Bhitarkanika
itinerary.text: Drive to Khola jetty (about 200 km) and take the boat into Bhitarkanika National Park to Dangmal (boat and entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Dangmal or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Bhitarkanika)Bhitarkanika creeks
itinerary.text: Boats through the mangrove creeks for saltwater crocodiles, birds and deer, and the crocodile breeding centre. Overnight stay at Dangmal or near the park.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Bhubaneswar)Bhitarkanika to Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: Return by boat and drive to Bhubaneswar. Overnight stay in Bhubaneswar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bhubaneswar airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Koraput and Jeypore: Tribal Odisha
name: Koraput and Jeypore: Tribal Odisha
page_title: Koraput and Jeypore: Tribal Odisha – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days in tribal south Odisha: the Araku valley, Koraput's tribal museum, the Duduma falls and the Thursday market at Onukadelli.
cities: Visakhapatnam - Araku - Koraput - Jeypore - Onukadelli - Duduma Falls

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Araku)Visakhapatnam to Araku
itinerary.text: Arrive at Visakhapatnam airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive up through the Eastern Ghats to the Araku valley (about 115 km), visiting the Borra caves on the way (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Araku.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Koraput)Araku to Koraput
itinerary.text: Drive into Odisha to Koraput (about 110 km). Visit the Sabara Srikhetra Jagannath temple and the Tribal Museum. Overnight stay in Koraput.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jeypore)Koraput to Jeypore – Duduma
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jeypore (about 25 km), once the seat of a princely state, and on to the Duduma falls, where the Machkund river drops into a deep gorge on the Andhra border. Overnight stay in Jeypore.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jeypore)Onukadelli market
itinerary.text: On Thursday, drive to the weekly market at Onukadelli (about 75 km), where the Bonda and Gadaba people come to trade, with a local guide (paid locally); on other days, a village market nearby. Overnight stay in Jeypore.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jeypore)Deomali and Gupteswar
itinerary.text: A day to the Gupteswar cave temple in the forest by the Kolab river, or a drive towards Deomali, Odisha's highest peak. Overnight stay in Jeypore.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Visakhapatnam)Jeypore to Visakhapatnam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back down through the Eastern Ghats to Visakhapatnam (about 230 km, 6–7 hours). In the evening, walk on the Ramakrishna beach front. Overnight stay in Visakhapatnam.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Visakhapatnam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time to visit the Kailasagiri hill viewpoint or the submarine museum on the beach before the transfer to Visakhapatnam airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Sambalpur and Hirakud
name: Sambalpur and Hirakud
page_title: Sambalpur and Hirakud – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in western Odisha: Sambalpur's temple and ikat weavers, the Hirakud dam, the leaning temple of Huma and the Debrigarh sanctuary.
cities: Jharsuguda - Sambalpur - Hirakud Dam - Debrigarh - Huma

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Sambalpur)Jharsuguda to Sambalpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jharsuguda airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Sambalpur (about 50 km). Visit the Samaleswari temple and the weaving lanes, home of the Sambalpuri ikat sari. Overnight stay in Sambalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sambalpur)Hirakud dam and Huma
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to the Hirakud dam, one of the longest earthen dams in the world, with the view from the Gandhi and Nehru towers, then the leaning Shiva temple at Huma on the Mahanadi. Overnight stay in Sambalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Debrigarh)Debrigarh wildlife sanctuary
itinerary.text: Drive to the Debrigarh sanctuary on the Hirakud reservoir for a jeep drive or boat for gaur, deer and migratory birds in winter (paid locally). Overnight stay at Debrigarh or Sambalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Sambalpur)Back to Sambalpur
itinerary.text: A morning in the sanctuary, then back to Sambalpur and its handloom market. Overnight stay in Sambalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Jharsuguda
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Jharsuguda airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Grand Odisha
name: Grand Odisha
page_title: Grand Odisha – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days round Odisha: Bhubaneswar, Puri and Konark, the Chilika dolphins, Gopalpur-on-Sea and the hills of Daringbadi.
cities: Bhubaneswar - Puri - Konark - Chilika - Gopalpur - Daringbadi

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhubaneswar)Arrive in Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhubaneswar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, tour the temples of the "City of Temples": the 11th-century Lingaraj (seen from the viewing platform by non-Hindus), the Parasurameswara and Mukteswara, and the Rajarani with its graceful carved figures, then climb to the rock-cut Jain cells of Udayagiri (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Bhubaneswar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Puri)Bhubaneswar to Puri
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Puri (about 60 km), stopping at Dhauli, where Emperor Ashoka turned to Buddhism after the Kalinga war, and at Pipili, the village of appliqué work. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Puri)Jagannath and Konark
itinerary.text: Early darshan at the Jagannath temple, then head up the Marine Drive to Konark (about 35 km) and its Sun Temple, the "Black Pagoda" of old sailors, whose wheels double as sundials; the archaeological museum next door holds carvings from the temple (entry paid locally). Return by Chandrabhaga beach. Overnight stay in Puri.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gopalpur)Chilika to Gopalpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Satapada on the Chilika lagoon, Asia's largest brackish-water lagoon, for a boat trip to see the Irrawaddy dolphins and the sea mouth where the lagoon meets the Bay of Bengal (boat paid locally). Continue round the lagoon to Gopalpur-on-Sea. Overnight stay in Gopalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Daringbadi)Gopalpur to Daringbadi
itinerary.text: Drive into the hills by the Taptapani hot springs to Daringbadi, the pine-and-coffee hill station of Kandhamal. Overnight stay in Daringbadi.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Daringbadi)Daringbadi
itinerary.text: See the coffee gardens, pine forest and waterfalls of Daringbadi. Overnight stay in Daringbadi.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bhubaneswar)Daringbadi to Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: A long drive back to Bhubaneswar (about 250 km). Overnight stay in Bhubaneswar.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Bhubaneswar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, transfer to Bhubaneswar airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Ahmedabad Heritage Break
name: Ahmedabad Heritage Break
page_title: Ahmedabad Heritage Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Ahmedabad, India's first UNESCO World Heritage City: the Sabarmati Ashram, the Adalaj stepwell, the pols of the old city and Manek Chowk.
cities: Ahmedabad - Sabarmati Ashram - Adalaj - Old City

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ahmedabad)Arrive in Ahmedabad – Sabarmati and Adalaj
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Sabarmati Ashram, Gandhiji's home from 1917 to 1930, and drive out to the five-storey Adalaj stepwell with its carved pillars. Evening on the Sabarmati Riverfront. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ahmedabad)The walled city
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, join the heritage walk through the pols of the old city, India's first UNESCO World Heritage City, with its carved wooden houses and bird feeders. See the Sidi Saiyyed mosque and its stone tree-of-life window, the Jama Masjid and Bhadra fort, and at night eat at the Manek Chowk food market. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the Kankaria lake or a little shopping for bandhani and block prints at Law Garden before the transfer to Ahmedabad airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Statue of Unity Short Trip
name: Statue of Unity Short Trip
page_title: Statue of Unity Short Trip – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days at the Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue: the viewing gallery, the evening laser show, the Sardar Sarovar dam and the river parks.
cities: Vadodara - Statue of Unity - Ekta Nagar - Sardar Sarovar Dam

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ekta Nagar)Vadodara to the Statue of Unity
itinerary.text: Arrive at Vadodara airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Ekta Nagar (Kevadia), about 90 km. In the afternoon, go up the 182-metre Statue of Unity of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel to the viewing gallery, and stay for the evening laser show (tickets paid locally; closed on Mondays). Overnight stay at Ekta Nagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ekta Nagar)Sardar Sarovar and the parks
itinerary.text: A day around the statue: the Sardar Sarovar dam viewpoint on the Narmada, the Valley of Flowers along the river, the cactus garden and butterfly garden, and the Jungle Safari park (all paid locally; electric buses link the sights). Overnight stay at Ekta Nagar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Ekta Nagar to Vadodara
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Vadodara (about 90 km). If time allows, see the Laxmi Vilas Palace of the Gaekwads from outside before your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Ahmedabad and the Statue of Unity
name: Ahmedabad and the Statue of Unity
page_title: Ahmedabad and the Statue of Unity – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days joining Ahmedabad's ashram, Jain temple and stepwell with a night at the Statue of Unity and the Sardar Sarovar dam.
cities: Ahmedabad - Adalaj - Statue of Unity - Sardar Sarovar Dam

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ahmedabad)Arrive in Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at the Sabarmati Ashram and the Hutheesing Jain temple of white marble; evening at the riverfront and the Atal footbridge. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ekta Nagar)Ahmedabad to Ekta Nagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive south to Ekta Nagar (about 200 km, 4 hours). Late afternoon at the Statue of Unity, where a lift takes you up inside to the gallery at 153 metres, then the laser show on the statue after dark (paid locally). Overnight stay at Ekta Nagar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ahmedabad)Sardar Sarovar – back to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: A morning at the Sardar Sarovar dam and the Valley of Flowers by the Narmada, then drive back to Ahmedabad. Evening at the Adalaj stepwell, lit softly as the light fades. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, walk through a pol of the old city or visit the Calico Museum of Textiles if you have booked a slot, then transfer to Ahmedabad airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Vadodara, Champaner and the Statue of Unity
name: Vadodara, Champaner and the Statue of Unity
page_title: Vadodara, Champaner and the Statue of Unity – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days from Vadodara: the Laxmi Vilas Palace, the UNESCO-listed Champaner-Pavagadh park and Kalika Mata temple, and two nights at the Statue of Unity.
cities: Vadodara - Champaner - Pavagadh - Statue of Unity

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vadodara)Arrive in Vadodara
itinerary.text: Arrive at Vadodara airport or station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit the Laxmi Vilas Palace of the Gaekwad rulers, four times the size of Buckingham Palace (entry paid locally), and the Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum with its Raja Ravi Varma paintings. Overnight stay in Vadodara.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vadodara)Champaner and Pavagadh
itinerary.text: A day trip to the Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park (about 50 km), a UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Jami Masjid with its 172 pillars and the old city walls. Take the ropeway up Pavagadh hill to the Kalika Mata temple (paid locally). Return to Vadodara. Overnight stay in Vadodara.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ekta Nagar)Vadodara to the Statue of Unity
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Ekta Nagar (about 90 km) for the Statue of Unity, the gallery inside its chest and the exhibition hall below, then the evening laser show (paid locally; closed on Mondays). Overnight stay at Ekta Nagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ekta Nagar)Narmada dam and gardens
itinerary.text: Spend the day by the Narmada: the Sardar Sarovar dam, the Valley of Flowers, the cactus garden and the boat ride near the statue when it runs (paid locally). Overnight stay at Ekta Nagar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Ekta Nagar to Vadodara
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Vadodara (about 90 km), with a stop at the Sursagar lake and its tall Shiva statue in the city centre, before your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Dakor, Pavagadh and Champaner
name: Dakor, Pavagadh and Champaner
page_title: Dakor, Pavagadh and Champaner – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of pilgrimage from Ahmedabad: the Ranchhodraiji temple at Dakor, the Kalika Mata Shakti Peeth on Pavagadh hill, and the mosques of Champaner.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dakor)Ahmedabad to Dakor
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dakor (about 90 km) for darshan at the Ranchhodraiji temple, where Krishna is worshipped as the one who left the battlefield. Evening aarti and a walk round the Gomti tank. Overnight stay at Dakor.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pavagadh)Dakor to Pavagadh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Pavagadh (about 100 km). Take the ropeway up to the hilltop Kalika Mata temple, one of the Shakti Peeths (ropeway paid locally; the last stretch is on foot). Overnight stay near Pavagadh or at Halol.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ahmedabad)Champaner – Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: A morning among the monuments of Champaner, a UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Jami Masjid, the Saher ki Masjid and the Kevda mosque. Then drive back to Ahmedabad (about 150 km). Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Sabarmati Ashram, then transfer to Ahmedabad airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Modhera, Patan and Ambaji
name: Modhera, Patan and Ambaji
page_title: Modhera, Patan and Ambaji – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in north Gujarat: the Modhera Sun Temple, Rani ki Vav and the Patola weavers at Patan, and the Ambaji Shakti Peeth with Gabbar hill.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Patan)Ahmedabad to Modhera and Patan
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north to the Sun Temple at Modhera (about 100 km), built in 1026 with a great stepped tank in front. Continue to Patan for Rani ki Vav, the queen's stepwell, a UNESCO World Heritage Site (entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Patan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ambaji)Patan weavers – Ambaji
itinerary.text: In the morning, visit a Patola weaving family, who make the double-ikat silk sari on hand looms. Drive to Ambaji (about 120 km) for evening darshan at the Ambaji temple, one of the Shakti Peeths. Overnight stay at Ambaji.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ahmedabad)Gabbar hill – Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: Early morning, ride the ropeway up Gabbar hill to the original seat of the goddess (paid locally), then drive back to Ahmedabad (about 180 km), stopping at the Adalaj stepwell. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the riverfront or a little shopping in the Law Garden market before the transfer to Ahmedabad airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Polo Forest and Idar
name: Polo Forest and Idar
page_title: Polo Forest and Idar – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Polo Forest, a valley of ruined medieval temples on the Harnav river in north-east Gujarat, with the granite hills of Idar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Polo Forest)Ahmedabad to Polo Forest
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north-east to the Polo Forest near Vijaynagar (about 150 km). Stop at Idar on the way for its granite hills and old fort. Evening walk by the Harnav river. Overnight stay near Polo Forest.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Polo Forest)Temples in the forest
itinerary.text: A day among the ruined 15th-century temples hidden in the forest: the Sadevant Savlinga temple, the Lakhena and Shiv Shakti temples and the old Jain temples, with walks along the river and the Harnav dam (forest entry paid locally). The forest is at its greenest after the monsoon. Overnight stay near Polo Forest.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Polo Forest to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last walk in the forest, drive back to Ahmedabad (about 150 km) for your onward journey, with a short stop at the Idar hills if you missed them. The tour ends here.

title: Little Rann of Kutch: Wild Ass Sanctuary
name: Little Rann of Kutch: Wild Ass Sanctuary
page_title: Little Rann of Kutch: Wild Ass Sanctuary – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Little Rann of Kutch: jeep drives for the Indian wild ass, winter birds on the salt flats, and the salt workers and Rabari villages.
cities: Ahmedabad - Dasada - Little Rann of Kutch - Modhera

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dasada)Ahmedabad to Dasada
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dasada (about 100 km) on the edge of the Little Rann of Kutch. In the late afternoon, a jeep drive onto the salt flats for the Indian wild ass, found nowhere else, and the sunset (jeep and permit paid locally). Overnight stay at Dasada.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dasada)Salt pans and birds
itinerary.text: A dawn jeep drive for wild ass, nilgai, desert foxes and, in winter, flamingos, cranes and pelicans. Later, visit the salt workers (Agariyas) who harvest salt from the pans, and a Rabari village of herders. Overnight stay at Dasada.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Dasada to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back towards Ahmedabad, stopping at the Modhera Sun Temple if time allows (about 30 km detour), before your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bhuj and the White Rann
name: Bhuj and the White Rann
page_title: Bhuj and the White Rann – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Kutch: Bhuj's palaces, sunset and moonrise on the White Rann at Dhordo, Kalo Dungar, and the craft villages of Bhujodi, Ajrakhpur and Nirona.
cities: Bhuj - White Rann - Dhordo - Kalo Dungar

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhuj)Arrive in Bhuj
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhuj airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Aina Mahal, a palace of mirrors and clocks, the Prag Mahal with its Italian Gothic tower, and the Kutch Museum, the oldest in Gujarat (closed on Wednesdays). Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhuj)Kalo Dungar and the White Rann
itinerary.text: Drive north to Kalo Dungar (Black Hill), the highest point in Kutch, for the view across the Rann. In the afternoon, continue to Dhordo for the White Rann, the great salt desert, and stay for the sunset and moonrise over the salt (permit paid locally). Return to Bhuj. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhuj)Craft villages
itinerary.text: A day in the craft villages around Bhuj: Bhujodi for weaving and the Shrujan centre for Kutchi embroidery, Ajrakhpur for block-printed ajrakh, and Nirona for rogan painting and copper bells. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Bhuj
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a walk round the Hamirsar lake and the old bazaar, then the transfer to Bhuj airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bhuj, Mandvi and Kutch
name: Bhuj, Mandvi and Kutch
page_title: Bhuj, Mandvi and Kutch – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in Kutch: Bhuj, the wooden shipyards and beach of Mandvi, the craft villages, and sunset on the White Rann at Dhordo.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhuj)Arrive in Bhuj
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Bhuj airport or station. In the afternoon, see the Aina Mahal and the bell tower of the Prag Mahal, and the old walled town around the Darbargadh. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mandvi)Bhuj to Mandvi
itinerary.text: Drive to Mandvi on the Gulf of Kutch (about 60 km). See the yards where wooden ships are still built by hand, the Vijay Vilas Palace of the Kutch rulers, and spend the late afternoon on the Mandvi beach. Overnight stay in Mandvi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhuj)Mandvi to Bhuj via the craft villages
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back towards Bhuj through the craft villages of Ajrakhpur, for natural-dye block printing, and Bhujodi, for weaving and the Vande Mataram memorial. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bhuj)The White Rann
itinerary.text: In the afternoon, drive to Dhordo for the White Rann, the salt desert of Kutch, for sunset, with a stop at the Hodka village of mud-walled bhunga houses (permit paid locally). Return to Bhuj. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Bhuj
itinerary.text: A slow last morning: the Kutch Museum (closed Wednesdays) or the Bharatiya Sanskriti Darshan folk museum, then the transfer to Bhuj airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhuj airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Aina Mahal and the Kutch Museum (closed Wednesdays), with its Harappan seals and Kutchi crafts. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhuj)Kalo Dungar and the White Rann
itinerary.text: Drive to Kalo Dungar for the view over the Rann, then Dhordo for the White Rann at sunset (permit paid locally). Return to Bhuj. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dholavira)Bhuj to Dholavira
itinerary.text: Drive east across Kutch to Dholavira on Khadir Bet island (about 250 km, 5 hours). The last stretch runs across the Rann on a causeway. Late afternoon at the Fossil Park, with its fossilised wood. Overnight stay at Dholavira (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bhuj)Harappan Dholavira – Bhuj
itinerary.text: Spend the morning at Dholavira, a 4,500-year-old Harappan city and UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its stone reservoirs, citadel and the signboard inscription, and the site museum (entry paid locally). Drive back to Bhuj. Overnight stay in Bhuj.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Bhuj

title: Dwarka, Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
name: Dwarka, Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
page_title: Dwarka, Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for darshan at Dwarka: the Dwarkadhish temple, the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Rukmini Devi and Bet Dwarka, from Jamnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dwarka)Jamnagar to Dwarka
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jamnagar airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dwarka (about 135 km, 3 hours). In the evening, have darshan at the Dwarkadhish temple and watch the aarti from the Gomti ghat, where the river meets the sea. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dwarka)Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, the Gopi Talav and the Rukmini Devi temple, then cross the Sudarshan Setu bridge to Bet Dwarka for the temple of Krishna's home (darshan timings vary). Evening at the Sunset Point and the lighthouse. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jamnagar)Dwarka to Jamnagar
itinerary.text: An early darshan at the Dwarkadhish temple, then drive back to Jamnagar. Visit the Bala Hanuman temple, where the Ram dhun has been chanted without a break since 1964, and the Lakhota lake. Overnight stay in Jamnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Jamnagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the bandhani shops of the old city before the transfer to Jamnagar airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Dwarka and Somnath
name: Dwarka and Somnath
page_title: Dwarka and Somnath – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days visiting two Jyotirlinga temples on the Saurashtra coast: Dwarka with Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka, Gandhi's birthplace at Porbandar, and Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dwarka)Rajkot to Dwarka
itinerary.text: Arrive at Rajkot airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dwarka (about 225 km, 4.5 hours). Evening darshan and aarti at the Dwarkadhish temple. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dwarka)Dwarka temples
itinerary.text: A day of darshan: the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, the Rukmini Devi temple and Bet Dwarka across the Sudarshan Setu bridge, with an evening on the Gomti ghat. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Somnath)Dwarka to Somnath via Porbandar
itinerary.text: Drive down the coast to Somnath (about 235 km), stopping at Porbandar for Kirti Mandir, the house where Mahatma Gandhi was born. Evening aarti at the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple on the sea, then the light-and-sound show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Somnath)Somnath
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at Somnath, then the Bhalka Tirth, where Krishna is said to have been struck by the hunter's arrow, the Triveni Sangam and the Gita Mandir. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Somnath to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Rajkot (about 200 km), with a stop at the Watson Museum or the Kaba Gandhi no Delo if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Ahmedabad, Dwarka and Somnath
name: Ahmedabad, Dwarka and Somnath
page_title: Ahmedabad, Dwarka and Somnath – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from Ahmedabad to the two Jyotirlinga shrines of the Saurashtra coast, Dwarka with Nageshwar and Somnath, with Bet Dwarka and Porbandar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ahmedabad)Arrive in Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit the Sabarmati Ashram and the Swaminarayan temple at Kalupur, the first of the sect, built in 1822, and walk on the riverfront at dusk. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dwarka)Ahmedabad to Dwarka
itinerary.text: A long drive across Saurashtra to Dwarka (about 440 km, 8 hours), with breaks on the way. Evening aarti at the Dwarkadhish temple if you arrive in time. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dwarka)Dwarka, Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at Dwarkadhish, then the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Rukmini Devi, and Bet Dwarka over the Sudarshan Setu. Evening by the sea at the Sunset Point. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Somnath)Dwarka to Somnath
itinerary.text: Drive along the coast to Somnath (about 235 km) via Porbandar's Kirti Mandir. Evening aarti at the Somnath temple and the show on its history (paid locally). Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Ahmedabad)Somnath to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: An early darshan at Somnath and the Bhalka Tirth, then the long drive back to Ahmedabad (about 400 km, 8 hours). Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a short visit to the Adalaj stepwell on the way to Ahmedabad airport, or the transfer to the station, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Dwarka, Somnath and Gir
name: Dwarka, Somnath and Gir
page_title: Dwarka, Somnath and Gir – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days in Saurashtra: the Dwarka and Somnath temples on the coast, then the Asiatic lions of Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dwarka)Rajkot to Dwarka
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Rajkot airport or station for the drive to Dwarka (about 225 km). Watch the evening aarti at the Dwarkadhish temple from the Gomti ghat. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dwarka)Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
itinerary.text: A morning at the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga with its tall Shiva statue and the Rukmini Devi temple, then Bet Dwarka across the sea bridge. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Somnath)Dwarka to Somnath
itinerary.text: Drive down the coast to Somnath (about 235 km), passing Porbandar. Evening aarti at the Somnath temple, whose spire rises over the Arabian Sea. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Sasan Gir)Somnath to Sasan Gir
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at Somnath and the Bhalka Tirth, then drive to Sasan Gir (about 45 km). In the afternoon, visit the Devalia safari park, the fenced interpretation zone where lions are usually seen (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Sasan Gir)Gir lion safari
itinerary.text: An early jeep safari in Gir National Park, the last home of the Asiatic lion, with leopards, deer and many birds (permit booked in advance, paid locally). Afternoon free at your lodge. Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Sasan Gir to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Rajkot (about 160 km) for your onward journey, with a stop at Junagadh for the Mahabat Maqbara if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Jamnagar and Dwarka with the Marine Park
name: Jamnagar and Dwarka with the Marine Park
page_title: Jamnagar and Dwarka with the Marine Park – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days on the Gulf of Kutch: Jamnagar, a low-tide walk on the coral reef of the Narara Marine National Park, and the temples of Dwarka.
cities: Jamnagar - Narara Marine National Park - Dwarka - Bet Dwarka

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jamnagar)Arrive in Jamnagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jamnagar airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Lakhota palace on its lake, the Bala Hanuman temple with its unbroken chanting, and the bandhani tie-dye lanes of the old town. Overnight stay in Jamnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jamnagar)Narara Marine National Park
itinerary.text: Drive to Narara (about 60 km) for a guided walk at low tide on the reef of the Marine National Park, India's first, among corals, starfish, sea anemones and octopus (forest guide and entry paid locally; timings follow the tide). Overnight stay in Jamnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dwarka)Jamnagar to Dwarka
itinerary.text: Drive to Dwarka (about 135 km). Evening darshan at the Dwarkadhish temple and aarti on the Gomti ghat. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dwarka)Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
itinerary.text: A day of darshan at the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, the Rukmini Devi temple and Bet Dwarka, reached by the Sudarshan Setu bridge. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Dwarka to Jamnagar
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive back to Jamnagar (about 135 km) for your onward journey, with a stop at the Khijadiya bird sanctuary in winter if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Sasan Gir Lion Safari
name: Sasan Gir Lion Safari
page_title: Sasan Gir Lion Safari – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days at Sasan Gir for the Asiatic lion: a jeep safari in Gir National Park, the Devalia park, and the Siddi village of Jambur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Sasan Gir)Rajkot to Sasan Gir
itinerary.text: Arrive at Rajkot airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Sasan Gir (about 160 km, 3.5 hours). In the afternoon, visit the Devalia safari park, where lions, leopards and deer are seen in a large fenced area (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sasan Gir)Gir jeep safari
itinerary.text: An early morning jeep safari in Gir National Park, the only home of the Asiatic lion in the wild (permit booked in advance, paid locally). Later, visit the Siddi village of Jambur, known for its Dhamal dance, or the Kamleshwar dam with its crocodiles. Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Sasan Gir to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast and, if you have a second permit, another short drive in the forest, travel back to Rajkot (about 160 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Junagadh, Girnar and Gir
name: Junagadh, Girnar and Gir
page_title: Junagadh, Girnar and Gir – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in Saurashtra: the Girnar ropeway, the Uparkot fort and Mahabat Maqbara in Junagadh, and lion safaris at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Junagadh)Rajkot to Junagadh
itinerary.text: Arrive at Rajkot airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Junagadh (about 100 km). See the Mahabat Maqbara with its silver doors and spiral minarets, and Ashoka's rock edict at the foot of Girnar. Overnight stay in Junagadh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Junagadh)Girnar ropeway and Uparkot
itinerary.text: Ride the Girnar ropeway up to the Ambaji temple on the mountain (paid locally); walkers can continue on the steps to the Jain temples and the Dattatreya peak. In the afternoon, explore the Uparkot fort with its Buddhist caves and the Adi Kadi stepwell. Overnight stay in Junagadh.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sasan Gir)Junagadh to Sasan Gir
itinerary.text: Drive to Sasan Gir (about 60 km). Afternoon at the Devalia safari park for lions in the fenced interpretation zone (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Sasan Gir)Gir jeep safari
itinerary.text: An early jeep safari in Gir National Park for the Asiatic lion, leopard and spotted deer (permit booked in advance, paid locally). Afternoon free by the Hiran river. Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Sasan Gir to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Rajkot (about 160 km), stopping at the Gondal palaces if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Somnath, Gir and Diu
name: Somnath, Gir and Diu
page_title: Somnath, Gir and Diu – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days on the Saurashtra coast: the Somnath temple, lion safaris at Gir, and the Portuguese fort, caves and beaches of Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Somnath)Rajkot to Somnath
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Rajkot airport or station for the drive to Somnath (about 200 km). Evening aarti at the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple and the sound-and-light show by the sea (paid locally). Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sasan Gir)Somnath to Sasan Gir
itinerary.text: Morning darshan and the Bhalka Tirth, then drive to Sasan Gir (about 45 km). Afternoon at the Devalia safari park (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sasan Gir)Gir jeep safari
itinerary.text: An early jeep safari in Gir National Park for the Asiatic lion (permit booked in advance, paid locally); afternoon at your lodge or the Kamleshwar dam. Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Diu)Gir to Diu
itinerary.text: Drive to Diu (about 100 km), a former Portuguese island. Visit the Diu fort on the sea, St Paul's church and the Naida caves, and watch the sunset from the Gangeshwar shore temple, where the waves wash over five lingas. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Diu)Diu beaches
itinerary.text: A free day on the quiet Nagoa and Ghoghla beaches, with water sports optional (paid locally), and the old town's painted houses and the shell museum. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Diu to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Rajkot (about 250 km, 5 hours) for your onward journey; Diu also has its own small airport. The tour ends here.

title: Diu and Somnath
name: Diu and Somnath
page_title: Diu and Somnath – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days by the sea in Saurashtra: the Portuguese island of Diu with its fort, caves and beaches, and the Somnath temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Diu)Rajkot to Diu
itinerary.text: Arrive at Rajkot airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Diu (about 250 km, 5 hours). Evening by the sea at the Diu fort, with its lighthouse and cannons. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Diu)Diu
itinerary.text: After breakfast, see St Paul's church, the Naida caves with their light shafts, the INS Khukri memorial and the shore temple at Gangeshwar; afternoon on Nagoa beach (water sports optional, paid locally). Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Somnath)Diu to Somnath
itinerary.text: Drive to Somnath (about 90 km). Evening aarti at the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple on the Arabian Sea and the sound-and-light show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Somnath)Somnath
itinerary.text: Early darshan at Somnath, then the Bhalka Tirth, the Triveni Sangam of three rivers and the old Somnath temple of Ahilyabai. Afternoon free by the sea. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Somnath to Rajkot
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Rajkot (about 200 km) for your onward journey, with a lunch stop on the way at Junagadh or Gondal. The tour ends here.

title: Palitana and Bhavnagar
name: Palitana and Bhavnagar
page_title: Palitana and Bhavnagar – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for the Jain pilgrimage to Shatrunjaya hill at Palitana and its 800-plus temples, with Bhavnagar and Ahmedabad's Hutheesing temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhavnagar)Ahmedabad to Bhavnagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Bhavnagar (about 170 km). Visit the Takhteshwar temple on its hill and the Gaurishankar lake at sunset. Overnight stay in Bhavnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Palitana)Shatrunjaya hill
itinerary.text: Drive to Palitana (about 50 km) before dawn and climb the 3,500 or so steps of Shatrunjaya hill to more than 800 Jain temples, the holiest Jain pilgrimage in Gujarat (dolis can be hired at the foot, paid locally). Descend by early afternoon; no food is taken on the hill. Overnight stay in Palitana.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ahmedabad)Palitana to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Jain museum and the temples in the town, then drive back to Ahmedabad (about 215 km). Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, see the Hutheesing Jain temple of white marble in Ahmedabad before the transfer to the airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Velavadar Blackbuck National Park
name: Velavadar Blackbuck National Park
page_title: Velavadar Blackbuck National Park – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for wildlife lovers at Velavadar: herds of blackbuck, wolves and winter harriers on the grasslands, with Bhavnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Velavadar)Ahmedabad to Velavadar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Velavadar (about 150 km), a grassland park on the Gulf of Khambhat. Late-afternoon drive in the park for herds of blackbuck with their spiral horns (entry and vehicle paid locally). Overnight stay near Velavadar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Velavadar)Grasslands and harriers
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon drives for blackbuck, nilgai, wolves and jungle cats, and, in winter, one of the world's largest roosts of harriers (migratory hawks) and many waterbirds. Overnight stay near Velavadar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhavnagar)Velavadar to Bhavnagar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Bhavnagar (about 65 km): the Takhteshwar temple, the Nilambag palace grounds and the Gaurishankar lake at sunset. Overnight stay in Bhavnagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Bhavnagar to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Ahmedabad (about 170 km) for your onward journey, with a stop at the Lothal Harappan port site on the way if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Saputara Hills
name: Saputara Hills
page_title: Saputara Hills – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Saputara, Gujarat's only hill station in the Sahyadri forest: the lake, the ropeway, sunset point and the Gira falls.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Saputara)Surat to Saputara
itinerary.text: Arrive at Surat airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive into the Sahyadri hills of the Dang forest to Saputara (about 160 km, 4 hours). Evening at the Sunset Point and a boat on the Saputara lake (paid locally). Overnight stay in Saputara.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Saputara)Saputara and Gira falls
itinerary.text: After breakfast, ride the ropeway to the Table Point (paid locally), see the Step Garden, the rose garden and the Dang tribal museum, then drive to the Gira waterfall near Waghai, at its best in the monsoon. Overnight stay in Saputara.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Saputara to Surat
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last walk by the lake, drive back down through the forest to Surat (about 160 km) for your onward journey, with a stop at the Waghai botanical garden. The tour ends here.

title: Grand Saurashtra
name: Grand Saurashtra
page_title: Grand Saurashtra – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days around Saurashtra: Ahmedabad, the Dwarka and Somnath temples, Gandhi's Porbandar, the lions of Gir and the island of Diu.
cities: Ahmedabad - Dwarka - Porbandar - Somnath - Sasan Gir - Diu

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ahmedabad)Arrive in Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Ahmedabad airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at the Sabarmati Ashram and the Adalaj stepwell; evening at Manek Chowk for street food. Overnight stay in Ahmedabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dwarka)Ahmedabad to Dwarka
itinerary.text: Set off early across the Saurashtra peninsula to Dwarka (about 440 km, 8 hours). Evening darshan at the Dwarkadhish temple, with its five-storey spire and 72 pillars. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Dwarka)Nageshwar and Bet Dwarka
itinerary.text: A day for the Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, Rukmini Devi and the island temple of Bet Dwarka across the Sudarshan Setu. Sunset by the lighthouse. Overnight stay in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Somnath)Porbandar – Somnath
itinerary.text: Drive along the coast to Porbandar for Kirti Mandir, Gandhiji's birthplace, and the Sudama temple, then on to Somnath for the evening aarti. Overnight stay in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Sasan Gir)Somnath to Sasan Gir
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at Somnath and the Bhalka Tirth, then drive to Sasan Gir. Afternoon at the Devalia safari park (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Diu)Gir safari – Diu
itinerary.text: An early jeep safari in Gir National Park for the Asiatic lion (permit paid locally), then drive to Diu (about 100 km) for sunset at the Gangeshwar temple. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Diu)Diu
itinerary.text: A day on Diu: the fort, St Paul's church, the Naida caves and the beach at Nagoa. Overnight stay in Diu.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Diu to Ahmedabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a long drive back to Ahmedabad (about 370 km), or a flight from Diu airport if you prefer (ticket not included), for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Khajuraho Temples
name: Khajuraho Temples
page_title: Khajuraho Temples – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days at Khajuraho: the carved Chandela temples of the Western, Eastern and Southern groups, the light-and-sound show and the Raneh falls canyon.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Khajuraho)Arrive in Khajuraho
itinerary.text: Arrive at Khajuraho airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, explore the Western Group of temples, a UNESCO World Heritage Site built by the Chandela kings around a thousand years ago, with the Kandariya Mahadeva and Lakshmana temples (entry paid locally). Stay for the evening light-and-sound show. Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Khajuraho)Eastern and Southern groups – Raneh falls
itinerary.text: After breakfast, see the Jain temples of the Eastern Group, with the Parsvanath temple, and the Duladeo and Chaturbhuj temples of the Southern Group. In the afternoon, drive to the Raneh falls (about 20 km), where the Ken river cuts a canyon of red, pink and grey granite (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Khajuraho
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a last walk round the Shivsagar lake and the Matangeshwar temple, still in daily worship, before the transfer to Khajuraho airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Khajuraho and Orchha
name: Khajuraho and Orchha
page_title: Khajuraho and Orchha – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Bundelkhand: the Khajuraho temples, then the palaces, temples and riverside chhatris of Orchha, ending at Jhansi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Khajuraho)Arrive in Khajuraho
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Khajuraho airport or station. Spend the afternoon among the Western Group temples, the finest work of the Chandela builders, and watch the sound-and-light show in the evening (paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Orchha)Khajuraho to Orchha
itinerary.text: After a morning at the Jain temples of the Eastern Group, drive to Orchha (about 175 km, 4 hours), the old Bundela capital on the Betwa river. Evening aarti at the Ram Raja temple, the only temple where Rama is worshipped as a king. Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Orchha)Orchha
itinerary.text: A day in Orchha: the Jahangir Mahal and Raj Mahal with their painted ceilings, the tall Chaturbhuj temple and the row of royal chhatris (cenotaphs) on the Betwa, best at sunset (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Orchha to Jhansi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jhansi (about 18 km) and, if time allows, see the Jhansi fort of Rani Lakshmibai before your train or onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Panna Tiger Reserve and Khajuraho
page_title: Panna Tiger Reserve and Khajuraho – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days pairing Panna Tiger Reserve, with jeep safaris and the Ken river, and the UNESCO-listed temples of Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Panna)Khajuraho to Panna
itinerary.text: Arrive at Khajuraho airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to the edge of Panna Tiger Reserve (about 25 km). In the afternoon, a boat on the Ken river for gharials and birds, or a visit to the Pandav falls and caves (paid locally). Overnight stay near Panna.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Panna)Panna jeep safaris
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon jeep safaris in Panna, where tigers were brought back after 2009, with leopards, sloth bears, deer and vultures nesting on the gorge cliffs (safaris paid locally). Overnight stay near Panna.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Khajuraho)Khajuraho temples
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Khajuraho for the Western Group of temples and their sculpture, then the evening sound-and-light show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Khajuraho
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Eastern Group's Jain temples or the Adivart tribal museum, then transfer to Khajuraho airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Gwalior and Orchha
name: Gwalior and Orchha
page_title: Gwalior and Orchha – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of forts and palaces: Gwalior fort and the Jai Vilas Palace, the Datia palace, and the Bundela town of Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gwalior)Arrive in Gwalior
itinerary.text: Arrive at Gwalior airport or station, where our representative meets you. Spend the afternoon in Gwalior fort, with the blue-tiled Man Mandir palace, the Teli ka Mandir and the Sas-Bahu temples, and the giant Jain figures cut in the rock at Gopachal (entry paid locally). Evening light-and-sound show at the fort. Overnight stay in Gwalior.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Orchha)Jai Vilas – Datia – Orchha
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Jai Vilas Palace museum of the Scindias, with its giant chandeliers, and Tansen's tomb. Drive to Orchha (about 120 km), stopping at the seven-storey Datia palace. Evening aarti at the Ram Raja temple. Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Orchha)Orchha
itinerary.text: A day among Orchha's palaces, the Chaturbhuj and Lakshminarayan temples with their murals, and the chhatris on the Betwa at sunset (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Orchha to Jhansi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Jhansi (about 18 km) and see the fort where Rani Lakshmibai fought in 1857 before your train or onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Gwalior, Shivpuri and Chanderi
name: Gwalior, Shivpuri and Chanderi
page_title: Gwalior, Shivpuri and Chanderi – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in northern Madhya Pradesh: Gwalior fort, the Scindia chhatris and lakes of Shivpuri, and the weavers' town of Chanderi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gwalior)Arrive in Gwalior
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Gwalior airport or station. In the afternoon, explore the hilltop Gwalior fort and its palaces and temples, then the Jai Vilas Palace museum (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Gwalior.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shivpuri)Gwalior to Shivpuri
itinerary.text: Drive to Shivpuri (about 120 km), the old summer capital of the Scindias. See the marble chhatris of the Scindia rulers, set in a Mughal-style garden, and the Madhav National Park lakes and the George Castle on the hill (park entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Shivpuri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Chanderi)Shivpuri to Chanderi
itinerary.text: Drive to Chanderi (about 125 km), a hill town of Bundela and Mughal monuments and home of the Chanderi sari. See the Badal Mahal gateway, the Koshak Mahal and the fort view over the town. Overnight stay in Chanderi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Chanderi)Chanderi weavers
itinerary.text: A morning with the weavers of Chanderi silk-cotton saris at their hand looms, the Jama Masjid and the Katti Ghati gate cut through the rock; afternoon free. Overnight stay in Chanderi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Chanderi to Gwalior
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Gwalior (about 230 km, 5 hours) for your onward journey, with a lunch stop on the way. The tour ends here.

page_title: Ujjain Mahakal Darshan – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Ujjain for the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and Mahakal Lok, the Shipra aarti and the city's temples, from Indore.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ujjain)Indore to Ujjain
itinerary.text: Arrive at Indore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Ujjain (about 55 km). In the evening, have darshan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, walk the Mahakal Lok corridor, and watch the aarti at Ram Ghat on the Shipra. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ujjain)Bhasma Aarti and the temples of Ujjain
itinerary.text: Before dawn, the Bhasma Aarti at Mahakaleshwar for those with a booking. Later, visit the Kal Bhairav temple, the Harsiddhi Shakti Peeth, the Sandipani ashram where Krishna studied, the Mangalnath temple and the Chintaman Ganesh. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Ujjain to Indore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Indore (about 55 km), with a stop at the Khajrana Ganesh temple, before your onward journey; in the evening there may be time for the Sarafa night food market. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ujjain)Indore to Ujjain
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Indore airport or station for the drive to Ujjain (about 55 km). Evening darshan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and the Shipra aarti at Ram Ghat. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ujjain)Ujjain temples
itinerary.text: An optional Bhasma Aarti before dawn (with booking), then a day at Kal Bhairav, Harsiddhi, Gadkalika, the Sandipani ashram and the Vedh Shala, the old observatory of Jai Singh. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Omkareshwar)Ujjain to Omkareshwar

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Omkareshwar to Indore
itinerary.text: An early darshan or a walk to the Ekatmata Dham statue of Adi Shankaracharya, then drive to Indore (about 80 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Malwa Circuit: Indore, Ujjain, Omkareshwar and Maheshwar
name: Malwa Circuit: Indore, Ujjain, Omkareshwar and Maheshwar
page_title: Malwa Circuit: Indore, Ujjain, Omkareshwar and Maheshwar – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days on the Malwa plateau: Indore's palaces and food streets, Mahakaleshwar at Ujjain, Omkareshwar on the Narmada, and Ahilyabai's Maheshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Indore)Arrive in Indore
itinerary.text: Arrive at Indore airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Rajwada of the Holkars, the Lal Bagh palace and the Kanch Mandir, a Jain temple lined with glass. At night, eat your way down the Sarafa night market. Overnight stay in Indore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ujjain)Indore to Ujjain
itinerary.text: Drive to Ujjain (about 55 km). Darshan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and the Mahakal Lok, then Kal Bhairav and Harsiddhi; evening aarti on the Shipra. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Omkareshwar)Ujjain to Omkareshwar
itinerary.text: An optional Bhasma Aarti (with booking), then drive to Omkareshwar (about 140 km). Afternoon darshan at the Omkareshwar and Mamleshwar temples on either side of the Narmada. Overnight stay in Omkareshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Maheshwar)Omkareshwar to Maheshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Maheshwar (about 65 km), the riverside capital of Rani Ahilyabai Holkar. See the Ahilya fort, the long ghats with their temples, and the Rehwa weaving centre for Maheshwari saris; a sunset boat on the Narmada is optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Maheshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Indore)Maheshwar to Indore
itinerary.text: A quiet morning on the ghats, then drive back to Indore (about 95 km). Evening at Chappan Dukan, the street of 56 food shops. Overnight stay in Indore.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Indore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Khajrana Ganesh temple before the transfer to Indore airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mandu and Maheshwar
name: Mandu and Maheshwar
page_title: Mandu and Maheshwar – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Narmada: the Afghan palaces of Mandu, from the Jahaz Mahal to Rani Roopmati's pavilion, and the ghats and weavers of Maheshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mandu)Indore to Mandu
itinerary.text: Arrive at Indore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Mandu (about 95 km), a fortified plateau of Afghan-era palaces. In the late afternoon, see the Jahaz Mahal, the "ship palace" between two lakes, and the sloping walls of the Hindola Mahal (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Mandu.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mandu)Roopmati and Baz Bahadur
itinerary.text: A day in Mandu: the white marble tomb of Hoshang Shah, said to have inspired the Taj Mahal, the Jami Masjid, the Baz Bahadur palace and the Rani Roopmati pavilion on the cliff edge, with the Narmada valley far below at sunset. Overnight stay in Mandu.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Maheshwar)Mandu to Maheshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Maheshwar (about 40 km). See the Ahilya fort and the Rajwada of Rani Ahilyabai, the temples along the ghats, and the hand looms of the Rehwa society; at dusk, watch the lamps floated on the Narmada. Overnight stay in Maheshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Maheshwar to Indore
itinerary.text: After a sunrise walk on the ghats, drive to Indore (about 95 km) for your onward journey, with time for the Rajwada if your flight is late. The tour ends here.

page_title: Bhopal, Ujjain and Indore – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from Bhopal to Indore: the Upper Lake and Tribal Museum, the stupa at Sanchi, the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga at Ujjain and Indore's palaces and food.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhopal)Arrive in Bhopal
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhopal airport or station, where our representative meets you. See the Upper Lake at sunset, the Taj-ul-Masajid, one of the largest mosques in India, and the old city's Chowk bazaar. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhopal)Sanchi and the Tribal Museum
itinerary.text: A morning trip to Sanchi (about 46 km) for the Great Stupa of Emperor Ashoka and its carved gateways, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Back in Bhopal, visit the Tribal Museum, one of the best in India (closed on Mondays). Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ujjain)Bhopal to Ujjain
itinerary.text: Drive west to Ujjain (about 190 km). Evening darshan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and the aarti at Ram Ghat. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ujjain)Ujjain
itinerary.text: An optional Bhasma Aarti (with booking), then the Kal Bhairav and Harsiddhi temples, the Sandipani ashram and the Mahakal Lok corridor. Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Indore)Ujjain to Indore
itinerary.text: Drive to Indore (about 55 km). Visit the Rajwada, the Lal Bagh palace and the Kanch Mandir, and eat at the Sarafa night market. Overnight stay in Indore.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Indore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, darshan at the Khajrana Ganesh temple, then the transfer to Indore airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.
