name: Bhopal, Sanchi and Bhimbetka
page_title: Bhopal, Sanchi and Bhimbetka – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of history around Bhopal: Ashoka's stupa at Sanchi, the prehistoric rock paintings of Bhimbetka, Udayagiri's caves and the Bhojpur temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhopal)Arrive in Bhopal
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Bhopal airport or station. In the afternoon, visit the Tribal Museum (closed Mondays), the Bharat Bhavan arts centre and the Van Vihar park, and watch the sun set over the Upper Lake. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhopal)Sanchi and Udayagiri
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Sanchi (about 46 km) for the Great Stupa and its four carved gateways, the Ashokan pillar and the site museum (UNESCO World Heritage Site; entry paid locally). Continue to the Gupta-era rock-cut caves of Udayagiri near Vidisha, with the great Varaha panel. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhopal)Bhimbetka and Bhojpur
itinerary.text: Drive to Bhimbetka (about 45 km), where rock shelters hold paintings up to 10,000 years old, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, then to the unfinished Bhojeshwar temple at Bhojpur with its huge single-stone Shiva linga. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Bhopal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, see the Taj-ul-Masajid and the Gauhar Mahal in the old city before the transfer to Bhopal airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Pachmarhi Hills
name: Pachmarhi Hills
page_title: Pachmarhi Hills – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Pachmarhi, the Satpura hill station: waterfalls, the Pandav and Jata Shankar caves, Dhoopgarh at sunset and the Chauragarh temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pachmarhi)Bhopal to Pachmarhi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhopal airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Pachmarhi (about 200 km, 5 hours), the only hill station of Madhya Pradesh in the Satpura range. Evening at the Priyadarshini point, from where the British first saw the plateau. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pachmarhi)Pachmarhi sights
itinerary.text: In an open gypsy (paid locally; private vehicles are not allowed on some forest roads), see the Bee Falls, the Pandav caves, the Jata Shankar cave temple, the Apsara Vihar pool and the Handi Khoh gorge. Sunset from Dhoopgarh, the highest point in the state. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pachmarhi)Chauragarh or a quiet day
itinerary.text: For walkers, the climb of about 1,300 steps to the Chauragarh Shiva temple, hung with thousands of tridents; otherwise, the Christ Church, the Reechgarh caves and the lake. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Pachmarhi to Bhopal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back down to Bhopal (about 200 km) for your onward journey; Pipariya station is the alternative for trains. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhopal airport or station, where our representative meets you. See the Taj-ul-Masajid, the Tribal Museum (closed Mondays) and the Upper Lake at sunset. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pachmarhi)Bhimbetka – Pachmarhi

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Pachmarhi)Waterfalls and caves
itinerary.text: A day by open gypsy (paid locally) to the Bee Falls, the Pandav caves, Apsara Vihar, the Jata Shankar cave temple and the Handi Khoh gorge, ending at Dhoopgarh for the sunset. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Pachmarhi)A free day in the hills

page_title: Satpura National Park (Madhai) – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days at Satpura National Park, where you can explore by jeep, canoe, boat and on foot: gaur, sloth bear and leopard in sal and bamboo forest.
cities: Bhopal - Madhai - Satpura National Park - Denwa River

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Madhai)Bhopal to Madhai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bhopal airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Madhai (about 150 km, 3.5 hours) on the Denwa river, the gateway to Satpura National Park. Evening by the river. Overnight stay near Madhai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Madhai)Satpura safaris
itinerary.text: Cross the Denwa by boat into the park for a morning jeep safari among sal and bamboo forest, with gaur, sloth bear, leopard and giant squirrels; in the afternoon, a canoe or guided walking safari, which few Indian parks allow (all paid locally). Overnight stay near Madhai.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Madhai)Boat on the Denwa
itinerary.text: A morning boat on the Denwa backwaters for birds, crocodiles and the forest edge, and a visit to a nearby Gond village. Afternoon free at your lodge. Overnight stay near Madhai.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Madhai to Bhopal
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bhopal (about 150 km), stopping at Bhimbetka if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Jabalpur and the Marble Rocks
name: Jabalpur and the Marble Rocks
page_title: Jabalpur and the Marble Rocks – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Jabalpur: a boat through the Narmada's marble gorge at Bhedaghat, the Dhuandhar falls, the Chausath Yogini temple and Madan Mahal fort.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jabalpur)Arrive in Jabalpur – Bhedaghat
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jabalpur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Bhedaghat (about 25 km). Overnight stay in Jabalpur.

itinerary.text: After breakfast, climb to the 10th-century Chausath Yogini temple above the gorge, with its circle of 64 goddesses, then see the Madan Mahal fort on its boulder hill and the Balancing Rock. Overnight stay in Jabalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Jabalpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for the Rani Durgavati museum or the Gwarighat aarti on the Narmada before the transfer to Jabalpur airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh
name: Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh
page_title: Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days across the tiger country of central India: Pench, Kanha and Bandhavgarh, ending with the marble rocks at Jabalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pench)Nagpur to Pench
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Nagpur airport or station for the short drive north on the highway to Pench (about 90 km, 2 hours). After lunch at your lodge, an afternoon jeep safari if your permit allows, or a walk in the buffer zone. Overnight stay near Pench.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pench)Pench safaris
itinerary.text: Two jeep safaris along the teak-clad banks of the Pench river and round its reservoir, where tigers, packs of wild dogs, leopards and herds of spotted deer come to drink (safaris paid locally). Overnight stay near Pench.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kanha)Pench to Kanha
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive east to Kanha (about 200 km, 5 hours) through the farmland and forests of Seoni and Mandla districts, arriving in time for an evening walk near your lodge. Overnight stay near Kanha.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kanha)Kanha safaris
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon jeep safaris in Kanha, the park of the Jungle Book, where tigers, gaur and the rare hard-ground barasingha share the wide sal-fringed meadows (safaris paid locally). Overnight stay near Kanha.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Bandhavgarh)Kanha to Bandhavgarh
itinerary.text: A last early safari in Kanha, then drive north to Bandhavgarh (about 250 km, 6 hours) through the Gond and Baiga country of the Maikal hills. Evening free at your lodge near the Tala gate. Overnight stay at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Bandhavgarh)Bandhavgarh safaris
itinerary.text: Two jeep safaris in Bandhavgarh's Tala and Magadhi zones, below the ancient hill fort, in one of the best parks in India for tiger sightings, with leopards, sloth bears and vultures too (safaris paid locally). Overnight stay at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Jabalpur)Bandhavgarh to Jabalpur
itinerary.text: A last morning safari, then drive to Jabalpur (about 170 km) and take a boat through the marble rocks of Bhedaghat in the evening (paid locally). Overnight stay in Jabalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Jabalpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Chausath Yogini temple or the Madan Mahal fort, then transfer to Jabalpur airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Maihar to Satna
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive to Satna (about 40 km) for your onward journey; Maihar also has its own railway station. The tour ends here.

title: Heart of India: Gwalior, Orchha, Khajuraho and Bandhavgarh
name: Heart of India: Gwalior, Orchha, Khajuraho and Bandhavgarh
page_title: Heart of India: Gwalior, Orchha, Khajuraho and Bandhavgarh – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days through the heart of India: Gwalior fort, the Bundela town of Orchha, the Khajuraho temples and tiger safaris at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gwalior)Arrive in Gwalior
itinerary.text: Arrive at Gwalior airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon in the hilltop fort with the Man Mandir palace and the Sas-Bahu temples; evening sound-and-light show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Gwalior.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Orchha)Gwalior to Orchha
itinerary.text: Visit the Jai Vilas Palace museum, then drive to Orchha (about 120 km). Evening aarti at the Ram Raja temple. Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Orchha)Orchha
itinerary.text: A full day in Orchha: the Jahangir Mahal built for the Mughal emperor's visit, the soaring Chaturbhuj temple, the painted ceilings of the Lakshminarayan temple, and the riverside chhatris of the Bundela kings at sunset (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Khajuraho)Orchha to Khajuraho
itinerary.text: Drive east through Bundelkhand to Khajuraho (about 175 km, 4 hours). Spend the afternoon among the Western Group temples, carved with gods, dancers and scenes of daily life, then the evening light-and-sound show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Khajuraho)Khajuraho
itinerary.text: A morning at the Jain temples of the Eastern Group and the Duladeo temple of the Southern Group, then an afternoon at the Raneh falls, where the Ken river has carved a canyon of coloured granite (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Bandhavgarh)Khajuraho to Bandhavgarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a long drive south through Panna and Satna to Bandhavgarh (about 270 km, 6 hours), arriving in the late afternoon for a quiet evening at your lodge. Overnight stay at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Bandhavgarh)Bandhavgarh safaris
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon jeep safaris in Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve, among rocky hills, bamboo and grassland, for tigers, leopards, sloth bears and spotted deer (safaris paid locally). Overnight stay at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Bandhavgarh to Jabalpur
itinerary.text: A final morning safari, then drive to Jabalpur (about 170 km) for your evening flight or train. The tour ends here.

title: Mumbai City Break
name: Mumbai City Break
page_title: Mumbai City Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Mumbai: the Gateway of India, the UNESCO-listed station and Elephanta Caves, Marine Drive at sunset, Siddhivinayak and Haji Ali.
cities: Mumbai - Gateway of India - Elephanta Caves - Marine Drive

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mumbai)Arrive in Mumbai – South Mumbai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mumbai airport or station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, see the Gateway of India and the Taj hotel from the waterfront, the Gothic Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), Flora Fountain and the Kala Ghoda art district, then walk Marine Drive at sunset. Overnight stay in Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mumbai)Elephanta Caves and the city
itinerary.text: Take the ferry from the Gateway to Elephanta island (about an hour; ferry and entry paid locally, closed on Mondays) for the rock-cut cave temple and its giant three-headed Shiva. In the afternoon, visit the Siddhivinayak temple, the Haji Ali dargah at low tide, the Dhobi Ghat open-air laundry and the Bandra–Worli Sea Link. Overnight stay in Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Mumbai
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya museum or Crawford Market before the transfer to Mumbai airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Lonavala and Khandala Weekend
name: Lonavala and Khandala Weekend
page_title: Lonavala and Khandala Weekend – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Sahyadri hills from Mumbai: Lonavala and Khandala's viewpoints, the Buddhist caves of Karla and Bhaja, and Lohagad fort.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Lonavala)Mumbai to Lonavala
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Mumbai airport or station for the drive up the expressway into the Sahyadri hills to Lonavala (about 85 km, 2 hours). In the afternoon, see the Tiger's Leap cliff, the Duke's Nose and the Rajmachi viewpoint, and in the monsoon the Bhushi dam overflow. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Lonavala)Karla and Bhaja caves
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Karla caves, with one of the largest Buddhist prayer halls cut in rock in India, and the older Bhaja caves across the valley (entry paid locally; some steps). Afternoon at the Lohagad fort for walkers, or the wax museum and the chikki shops in town. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Lonavala to Mumbai
itinerary.text: After a slow breakfast and a stop at the Khandala ghat viewpoint, drive back down to Mumbai (about 85 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani
name: Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani
page_title: Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Sahyadri hill stations: Mahabaleshwar's viewpoints and Venna lake, Shivaji's Pratapgad fort, and Panchgani's Table Land.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mahabaleshwar)Pune to Mahabaleshwar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Pune airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Mahabaleshwar (about 120 km, 3 hours) through the Pasarni ghat, stopping at Panchgani on the way. Evening boat on the Venna lake (paid locally) and the market. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mahabaleshwar)Viewpoints and Pratapgad
itinerary.text: Morning at Arthur's Seat, Elephant's Head and Kate's Point, high above the Konkan valleys, and the old Mahabaleshwar temple at the source of the Krishna. In the afternoon, drive to Pratapgad, Shivaji Maharaj's hill fort (about 24 km). Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mahabaleshwar)Panchgani and the strawberry farms
itinerary.text: Visit Panchgani's Table Land, a wide laterite plateau, the Sydney point and the Parsi point, and a strawberry farm in season (December to April) for fresh fruit and cream. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Mahabaleshwar to Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Pune (about 120 km), stopping at the Mapro garden in Gureghar, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mumbai, Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar
name: Mumbai, Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar
page_title: Mumbai, Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from Mumbai to Pune through the hills: South Mumbai, Lonavala and the Karla caves, Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani, and Pune's Shaniwar Wada.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mumbai)Arrive in Mumbai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mumbai airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon in South Mumbai: the Gateway of India, Colaba Causeway and the station building of CSMT, then sunset on Marine Drive. Overnight stay in Mumbai.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Lonavala)Mumbai to Lonavala
itinerary.text: Drive up the ghats to Lonavala (about 85 km). Visit the Karla caves and their great chaitya hall, then the Tiger's Leap viewpoint for sunset. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mahabaleshwar)Lonavala to Mahabaleshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Mahabaleshwar (about 160 km) via Pune and Panchgani, stopping on Panchgani's Table Land. Evening by the Venna lake. Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Mahabaleshwar)Mahabaleshwar
itinerary.text: A day of viewpoints, Arthur's Seat, Wilson Point for sunrise and the Lodwick Point, the Krishna source temple and the Pratapgad fort (about 24 km). Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pune)Mahabaleshwar to Pune
itinerary.text: Drive to Pune (about 120 km). In the afternoon, see the Shaniwar Wada of the Peshwas, the Aga Khan Palace where Gandhiji was held, and the Dagdusheth Ganpati temple. Overnight stay in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for the Raja Dinkar Kelkar museum or a walk on FC Road before the transfer to Pune airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Ajanta and Ellora Caves
name: Ajanta and Ellora Caves
page_title: Ajanta and Ellora Caves – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for the UNESCO-listed caves of Ajanta and Ellora, with the Kailasa temple, the Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga, Daulatabad fort and the Bibi ka Maqbara.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Aurangabad)Arrive in Aurangabad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) airport or station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, see the Bibi ka Maqbara, built for Aurangzeb's wife and modelled on the Taj Mahal, and the Panchakki water mill. Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Aurangabad)Ellora and Daulatabad
itinerary.text: Drive to Ellora (about 30 km; closed Tuesdays), a UNESCO World Heritage Site of 34 Buddhist, Hindu and Jain caves, with the Kailasa temple carved down from a single rock. Visit the Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga nearby, and the Daulatabad fort on its cone of rock on the way back (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Aurangabad)Ajanta caves
itinerary.text: A day trip to Ajanta (about 100 km; closed Mondays), where Buddhist monks cut 30 caves into a horseshoe gorge and painted them with the Jataka stories from the 2nd century BC; a shuttle bus runs from the visitor centre (entry and bus paid locally). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Aurangabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit a Paithani and Himroo weaving workshop, then the transfer to Aurangabad airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shirdi)Arrive in Shirdi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Shirdi airport or Sainagar Shirdi station, where our representative meets you. In the evening, have darshan at the Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir and attend the Dhoop Aarti, then visit the Dwarkamai mosque where Sai Baba lived and the Chavadi. Overnight stay in Shirdi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shirdi)Shani Shingnapur
itinerary.text: After an early Kakad Aarti for those who wish, drive to Shani Shingnapur (about 70 km), the village where houses famously have no doors, for darshan at the open-air Shani stone. Return to Shirdi to visit the Khandoba temple, the Gurusthan and the Lendi Baug. Overnight stay in Shirdi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Shirdi
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last darshan, there is time for the Sai Heritage village or the prasadalaya before the transfer to Shirdi airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Nashik, Trimbakeshwar and Shirdi
name: Nashik, Trimbakeshwar and Shirdi
page_title: Nashik, Trimbakeshwar and Shirdi – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of pilgrimage: Panchavati and the Ramkund at Nashik, the Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga at the source of the Godavari, and Sai Baba's Shirdi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Nashik)Arrive in Nashik – Panchavati
itinerary.text: Arrive at Nashik railway station or airport, where our representative meets you. Visit Panchavati, where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana lived in exile: the Ramkund on the Godavari, the black-stone Kalaram temple and the Sita Gufa cave. Evening aarti at the Ramkund. Overnight stay in Nashik.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Nashik)Trimbakeshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Trimbakeshwar (about 28 km) for darshan at the Jyotirlinga, whose three-faced linga stands for Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, at the foot of the Brahmagiri hill where the Godavari rises. Walkers can climb towards the Godavari source at Gangadwar. Overnight stay in Nashik.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Shirdi)Nashik to Shirdi
itinerary.text: Drive to Shirdi (about 90 km). Afternoon darshan at the Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir and the evening Dhoop Aarti, with Dwarkamai and the Chavadi. Overnight stay in Shirdi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Shirdi
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, visit the Khandoba temple where Sai Baba was first welcomed, then the transfer to Shirdi airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Three Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra
name: Three Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra
page_title: Three Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days to the three Jyotirlingas of Maharashtra: Trimbakeshwar at the source of the Godavari, Grishneshwar by Ellora, and Bhimashankar in the Sahyadri forest.
cities: Mumbai - Trimbakeshwar - Grishneshwar - Ellora - Bhimashankar - Pune

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Nashik)Mumbai to Nashik
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Mumbai airport or station for the drive up the Kasara ghat to Nashik (about 170 km, 4 hours). Evening aarti at the Ramkund in Panchavati. Overnight stay in Nashik.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Nashik)Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga
itinerary.text: Early darshan at the Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga below Brahmagiri, the source of the Godavari (about 28 km), then the Kalaram temple and the Sita Gufa in Nashik. Overnight stay in Nashik.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Aurangabad)Nashik to Grishneshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Grishneshwar (about 200 km), the smallest of the twelve Jyotirlingas, built by Ahilyabai Holkar in red stone. Visit the Ellora caves next door if it is not a Tuesday (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bhimashankar)Aurangabad to Bhimashankar
itinerary.text: A long drive south to Bhimashankar in the Sahyadri forest (about 260 km, 6–7 hours), source of the Bhima river. Evening darshan at the Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga, set in a wildlife sanctuary of the giant Malabar squirrel. Overnight stay near Bhimashankar (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Pune)Bhimashankar to Pune
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive down to Pune (about 110 km). In the afternoon, visit the Dagdusheth Ganpati temple and the Shaniwar Wada. Overnight stay in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast, darshan at the Kasba Ganpati, Pune's guardian deity, then the transfer to Pune airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Kolhapur: Mahalaxmi and Jyotiba
name: Kolhapur: Mahalaxmi and Jyotiba
page_title: Kolhapur: Mahalaxmi and Jyotiba – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Kolhapur: darshan at the Mahalaxmi Shakti Peeth and the hill temple of Jyotiba, Panhala fort, the New Palace and Rankala lake.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kolhapur)Arrive in Kolhapur – Mahalaxmi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kolhapur airport or station, where our representative meets you. Have darshan at the Shree Mahalaxmi (Ambabai) temple, one of the Shakti Peeths, and see the New Palace museum of the Chhatrapatis and the Rankala lake at sunset. Overnight stay in Kolhapur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kolhapur)Jyotiba and Panhala
itinerary.text: Drive to the Jyotiba temple on its hill (about 18 km), whose devotees shower gulal on the Sunday and full-moon festivals, then to Panhala fort (about 20 km), where Shivaji Maharaj was besieged, with its granaries and the Teen Darwaza gate. Back in the city, try a Kolhapuri misal and look for Kolhapuri chappals. Overnight stay in Kolhapur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Kolhapur
itinerary.text: After an early darshan at Mahalaxmi, there is time for the Shalini palace and the Bhavani Mandap before the transfer to Kolhapur airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Konkan Coast: Ganpatipule and Ratnagiri
name: Konkan Coast: Ganpatipule and Ratnagiri
page_title: Konkan Coast: Ganpatipule and Ratnagiri – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days on the Konkan coast: the beach temple of Ganpatipule, Jaigad fort, the cliff road of Aare-Ware, and Ratnagiri's forts, palace and mango country.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ganpatipule)Mumbai to Ganpatipule
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Mumbai airport or station for the long drive down the Konkan coast to Ganpatipule (about 330 km, 8 hours); the Konkan Railway to Ratnagiri is an alternative (ticket not included). Evening on the beach. Overnight stay in Ganpatipule.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ganpatipule)Swayambhu Ganpati and Jaigad
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at the Swayambhu Ganpati temple on the beach, where pilgrims walk round the hill behind it, and the Prachin Konkan open-air museum of village life. Afternoon at the Jaigad fort and lighthouse on the creek mouth. Overnight stay in Ganpatipule.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ratnagiri)Ganpatipule to Ratnagiri
itinerary.text: Drive along the coast via the Aare-Ware cliff road to Ratnagiri (about 25 km). See Lokmanya Tilak's birthplace, the Thibaw palace of the exiled Burmese king and the Ratnadurg fort and lighthouse; sunset at Bhatye beach. Overnight stay in Ratnagiri.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ratnagiri)Konkan villages and mangoes
itinerary.text: A slow day: an Alphonso mango orchard in season (April–May) or a cashew unit, the Pawas ashram, and Konkani fish thali for lunch (paid locally). Overnight stay in Ratnagiri.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Ratnagiri to Mumbai
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Mumbai (about 330 km), or take the Konkan Railway from Ratnagiri (ticket not included), for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Malvan and Tarkarli
name: Malvan and Tarkarli
page_title: Malvan and Tarkarli – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Sindhudurg coast: Tarkarli's white beach, Shivaji's sea fort of Sindhudurg, the Devbag sangam and Malvani food.
cities: Kudal - Malvan - Tarkarli - Sindhudurg Fort - Devbag

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Tarkarli)Kudal to Tarkarli
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kudal station on the Konkan Railway, where our representative meets you, and drive to Tarkarli (about 30 km), a long beach of white sand and casuarina trees on the Sindhudurg coast. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay at Tarkarli or Malvan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Tarkarli)Sindhudurg fort and Devbag
itinerary.text: Take the boat from Malvan jetty to the Sindhudurg sea fort built by Shivaji Maharaj in 1664, with his handprint and footprint in its walls (boat paid locally). In the afternoon, go to the Devbag sangam, where the Karli river meets the sea, with optional snorkelling or a boat to Tsunami Island (paid locally). Overnight stay at Tarkarli or Malvan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tarkarli)Malvan
itinerary.text: A free morning on the beach, then the Rock Garden at Malvan, the Rameshwar temple and the market for Malvani food and kokum; dolphin boats leave early in the morning in calm weather (paid locally). Overnight stay at Tarkarli or Malvan.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Tarkarli to Kudal
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last walk on the sand, drive to Kudal station (about 30 km) for your train; Sindhudurg airport at Chipi is the alternative for flights. The tour ends here.

title: Tadoba Tiger Reserve
name: Tadoba Tiger Reserve
page_title: Tadoba Tiger Reserve – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days at Tadoba, Maharashtra's oldest tiger reserve: jeep safaris through teak and bamboo forest for tigers, sloth bears and wild dogs.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Tadoba)Nagpur to Tadoba
itinerary.text: Arrive at Nagpur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Tadoba (about 140 km, 3 hours), Maharashtra's oldest and largest tiger reserve. Evening at your lodge near the Moharli gate. Overnight stay near Tadoba.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Tadoba)Tadoba jeep safaris
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon jeep safaris in Tadoba's teak and bamboo forest around the Tadoba lake, for tigers, leopards, sloth bears, wild dogs and gaur (safaris paid locally; the core zone is closed on Tuesdays). Overnight stay near Tadoba.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tadoba)Safari and the Erai dam
itinerary.text: A final morning safari, then a slow afternoon or a visit to the Erai dam and a nearby village. Overnight stay near Tadoba.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Tadoba to Nagpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Nagpur (about 140 km) and, if time allows, see the Deekshabhoomi stupa and Zero Mile before your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Ashtavinayak Yatra: the Eight Ganesh Temples
name: Ashtavinayak Yatra: the Eight Ganesh Temples
page_title: Ashtavinayak Yatra: the Eight Ganesh Temples – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for the Ashtavinayak yatra from Pune: all eight self-manifested Ganesh temples, from Morgaon and Siddhatek to Lenyadri's cave and Ranjangaon.
cities: Pune - Morgaon - Siddhatek - Pali - Mahad - Lenyadri - Ozar - Ranjangaon

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pune)Morgaon, Siddhatek and Theur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Pune airport or station, where our representative meets you. Begin the yatra, as tradition asks, at the Mayureshwar temple in Morgaon (about 65 km), then Siddhivinayak at Siddhatek on the Bhima and Chintamani at Theur on the way back. Overnight stay in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Lonavala)Pali and Mahad
itinerary.text: Drive down the ghats to Pali for the Ballaleshwar temple, the only one named after a devotee, and on to Mahad for Varadvinayak, where a lamp has burned since 1892. Return up to Lonavala for the night. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Narayangaon)Lenyadri and Ozar
itinerary.text: Drive to Junnar for Girijatmaj at Lenyadri, a Ganesh shrine inside a Buddhist cave about 300 steps up the hill, then Vighnahar at Ozar with its gold-domed tower. Overnight stay at Narayangaon or Junnar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Ranjangaon – Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Mahaganapati at Ranjangaon, the eighth temple, and, for those who wish to close the circle, return by Morgaon before reaching Pune for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Pune and Lonavala
name: Pune and Lonavala
page_title: Pune and Lonavala – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Pune and the hills: the Peshwas' Shaniwar Wada, Sinhagad fort, the Aga Khan Palace, and the Bhaja caves and viewpoints of Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pune)Arrive in Pune
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Pune airport or station. Spend the afternoon at the Shaniwar Wada, the fortified mansion of the Peshwas, the rock-cut Pataleshwar cave temple and the Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati, Pune's most loved temple. Overnight stay in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pune)Sinhagad and the Aga Khan Palace
itinerary.text: Drive up to Sinhagad fort (about 35 km), where Tanaji Malusare fell in 1670, for the view and a plate of pithla-bhakri at the top. In the afternoon, visit the Aga Khan Palace, where Gandhiji and Kasturba were held and where her samadhi stands, and the Raja Dinkar Kelkar museum. Overnight stay in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Lonavala)Pune to Lonavala
itinerary.text: Drive to Lonavala (about 65 km). Climb to the Bhaja caves, among the oldest Buddhist rock-cut shrines in the Deccan, and watch the sunset from Tiger's Leap. Overnight stay in Lonavala.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Lonavala to Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a stop at the Ekvira Devi temple above the Karla caves, then drive back to Pune (about 65 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Matheran: the Car-Free Hill Station
page_title: Matheran: the Car-Free Hill Station – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Matheran, the car-free hill station near Mumbai: forest paths, horse rides, the toy train and the viewpoints of Louisa and Panorama.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Matheran)Mumbai to Matheran
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Mumbai for the drive to Neral (about 85 km) and on up to Dasturi, where vehicles must stop; Matheran is free of motor traffic. Walk, ride a horse or take a hand-pulled rickshaw (paid locally) to your hotel; the narrow-gauge toy train from Neral runs when the line is open (ticket not included). Overnight stay in Matheran.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Matheran)The points of Matheran
itinerary.text: A day on the red-earth paths to the viewpoints: Echo Point, Louisa Point, One Tree Hill and Panorama Point for sunrise or sunset, with the Charlotte lake in the middle of the forest. Overnight stay in Matheran.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Matheran to Mumbai
itinerary.text: After a slow breakfast and a last walk to the market for chikki and leather sandals, return to Dasturi and drive back to Mumbai (about 85 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Alibaug and Kashid Beaches
name: Alibaug and Kashid Beaches
page_title: Alibaug and Kashid Beaches – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days on the coast south of Mumbai: Alibaug and the Kolaba fort, the white sands of Kashid, and the island fortress of Murud-Janjira.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Alibaug)Mumbai to Alibaug
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Mumbai for the drive round the bay to Alibaug (about 95 km); the ferry from the Gateway of India to Mandwa is a faster option (ticket not included). Walk out to the Kolaba fort at low tide and watch the sunset on Alibaug or Kihim beach. Overnight stay in Alibaug.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kashid)Kashid and Murud-Janjira
itinerary.text: Drive south along the coast past Revdanda to Kashid (about 30 km), a beach of white sand and casuarinas. In the afternoon, take a sailboat from Rajpuri to the Murud-Janjira sea fort, never conquered in its history (boat and entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Kashid.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Kashid to Mumbai
itinerary.text: After a morning swim, visit the Kanakeshwar temple on its hill or the Korlai lighthouse on the way back to Mumbai (about 125 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Shirdi with Ajanta, Ellora and Grishneshwar
name: Shirdi with Ajanta, Ellora and Grishneshwar
page_title: Shirdi with Ajanta, Ellora and Grishneshwar – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days joining Shirdi with the caves of Ajanta and Ellora, the Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga and the monuments of Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shirdi)Arrive in Shirdi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Shirdi airport or Sainagar Shirdi station, where our representative meets you. Evening darshan at the Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir, the Dhoop Aarti, and a walk to Dwarkamai and the Chavadi. Overnight stay in Shirdi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Aurangabad)Shirdi to Ellora and Grishneshwar
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive to Ellora (about 100 km; closed Tuesdays) for the Kailasa temple and the Buddhist and Jain caves, then the Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga next door. Continue to Aurangabad (about 30 km). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Aurangabad)Ajanta caves
itinerary.text: A day at Ajanta (about 100 km; closed Mondays), where the cave walls still hold paintings of the Buddha's lives from 2,000 years ago; the shuttle bus runs from the T-junction visitor centre (entry and bus paid locally). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Aurangabad)Aurangabad
itinerary.text: See the Bibi ka Maqbara, the Aurangabad caves on the hill behind it, the Panchakki and the Daulatabad fort with its dark spiral passage (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Aurangabad.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Aurangabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a stop at a Himroo and Paithani weaving workshop on the way to Aurangabad airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Igatpuri and Bhandardara
name: Igatpuri and Bhandardara
page_title: Igatpuri and Bhandardara – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Sahyadri lake country from Mumbai: the Kasara ghat, Igatpuri, Bhandardara's Arthur lake and Wilson dam, and the Randha falls.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bhandardara)Mumbai to Bhandardara via Igatpuri
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Mumbai for the drive up the Kasara ghat to Igatpuri (about 120 km), with a stop at the Vipassana academy's gardens and the Camel valley viewpoint, then on to Bhandardara (about 45 km) on the Arthur lake. Overnight stay at Bhandardara.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhandardara)Lake, dam and falls
itinerary.text: See the Wilson dam, the Umbrella falls below it in the monsoon, the Randha falls on the Pravara river and the Amruteshwar temple at Ratanwadi; walkers can start up towards Kalsubai, Maharashtra's highest peak, with a local guide (paid locally). Overnight stay at Bhandardara.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Bhandardara to Mumbai
itinerary.text: After a misty morning by the lake, drive back down to Mumbai (about 165 km) for your onward journey, stopping at the Bhatsa river viewpoint on the ghat. The tour ends here.

title: Pandharpur, Tuljapur and Akkalkot
name: Pandharpur, Tuljapur and Akkalkot
page_title: Pandharpur, Tuljapur and Akkalkot – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of pilgrimage from Solapur: Vitthal-Rukmini at Pandharpur, the Tulja Bhavani Shakti Peeth and Swami Samarth's math at Akkalkot.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pandharpur)Solapur to Pandharpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Solapur railway station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Siddheshwar temple in its lake, then drive to Pandharpur (about 75 km) for darshan of Vitthal and Rukmini, the god of the Varkari saints, and the ghats of the Chandrabhaga at dusk. Overnight stay in Pandharpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Solapur)Pandharpur to Tuljapur
itinerary.text: An early darshan at the Vitthal temple and the Pundalik temple in the river, then drive to Tuljapur (about 110 km) for the Tulja Bhavani temple, one of the Shakti Peeths and family goddess of Shivaji Maharaj. Return to Solapur. Overnight stay in Solapur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Solapur)Akkalkot
itinerary.text: Drive to Akkalkot (about 40 km) for the samadhi math of Shri Swami Samarth and the Vatavriksha temple; those who wish can continue to the Dattatreya temple at Ganagapur in Karnataka (about 40 km more). Overnight stay in Solapur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Solapur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, look for Solapuri chaddars and terry towels in the market before the transfer to Solapur station or airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Kaas Plateau, Satara and Mahabaleshwar
name: Kaas Plateau, Satara and Mahabaleshwar
page_title: Kaas Plateau, Satara and Mahabaleshwar – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for the flower season on the Kaas plateau, with Satara's forts, the Thoseghar falls and Mahabaleshwar.
cities: Pune - Satara - Kaas Plateau - Thoseghar - Mahabaleshwar

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Satara)Pune to Satara
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Pune airport or station for the drive to Satara (about 115 km), the old Maratha capital. Climb Ajinkyatara fort for the view, or visit Sajjangad, the hill of Samarth Ramdas Swami. Overnight stay in Satara.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Satara)Kaas plateau and Thoseghar
itinerary.text: An early start for the Kaas plateau (about 25 km), part of the Western Ghats World Heritage Site, carpeted with wild flowers from about late August to October (visitor slots booked online; entry paid locally). Afternoon at the Kaas lake and the Thoseghar waterfalls. Overnight stay in Satara.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mahabaleshwar)Satara to Mahabaleshwar
itinerary.text: Drive to Mahabaleshwar (about 60 km) through Medha and the Yavateshwar ghat. Afternoon at the Wilson and Arthur's Seat points, and a boat on the Venna lake (paid locally). Overnight stay in Mahabaleshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Mahabaleshwar to Pune
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a stop on Panchgani's Table Land, drive back to Pune (about 120 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Gokarna Beaches and Temple Town
name: Gokarna Beaches and Temple Town
page_title: Gokarna Beaches and Temple Town – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Gokarna: the Mahabaleshwar temple of the Atmalinga, the cliff paths of Kudle and Om beaches, boat-only coves and Mirjan fort.
cities: Hubli - Gokarna - Om Beach - Kudle Beach

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gokarna)Hubli to Gokarna
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hubli airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive west through the forest and the ghats to Gokarna (about 160 km, 3.5 hours). Evening darshan at the Mahabaleshwar temple, home of the Atmalinga, and a walk on the main beach at sunset. Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gokarna)The beaches of Gokarna
itinerary.text: Walk the cliff paths between Kudle beach and the curved Om beach, and take a boat on to the Half Moon and Paradise beaches (paid locally). In the afternoon, the Koti Teertha tank and the Mirjan fort (about 25 km) with its moat and laterite walls. Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Gokarna to Hubli
itinerary.text: After a morning swim, drive back to Hubli (about 160 km), with a stop at the Yana rocks or the Siddhivinayak temple at Idagunji if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Temple Coast: Udupi, Murudeshwar and Gokarna
name: Temple Coast: Udupi, Murudeshwar and Gokarna
page_title: Temple Coast: Udupi, Murudeshwar and Gokarna – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days up the temple coast of Karnataka: Udupi's Krishna Matha and Malpe, St Mary's island, Murudeshwar's giant Shiva and Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Udupi)Mangalore to Udupi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Udupi (about 60 km). Darshan at the Sri Krishna Matha, where the deity is seen through the nine-holed Kanakana Kindi window, and an evening on Malpe beach. Overnight stay in Udupi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Murudeshwar)St Mary's island – Murudeshwar
itinerary.text: Take the boat from Malpe to St Mary's island and its columns of basalt rock (paid locally; October to May). Drive north along the coast, past the Maravanthe beach where the road runs between the sea and the river, to Murudeshwar. Overnight stay in Murudeshwar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gokarna)Murudeshwar to Gokarna
itinerary.text: Morning at the Murudeshwar temple, with its 37-metre Shiva statue and the lift up the 20-storey gopuram (paid locally); scuba diving at Netrani island is optional (paid locally). Drive on to Gokarna (about 75 km) for evening darshan at the Mahabaleshwar temple. Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gokarna)Gokarna beaches
itinerary.text: A day on Gokarna's beaches: the cliff walk from Kudle to Om beach and a boat to Half Moon and Paradise (paid locally). Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Gokarna to Hubli
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive inland over the ghats to Hubli (about 160 km) for your onward flight or train, with a stop at the Mirjan fort on the way. The tour ends here.

title: Mangalore and Udupi
name: Mangalore and Udupi
page_title: Mangalore and Udupi – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Karnataka coast: Mangalore's temples and chapel, the Jain towns of Moodbidri and Karkala, Udupi's Krishna Matha and St Mary's island.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mangalore)Arrive in Mangalore
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Kadri Manjunath temple, the St Aloysius chapel with its painted walls and ceiling, and watch the sunset at Panambur or Tannirbhavi beach. Overnight stay in Mangalore.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Udupi)Moodbidri and Karkala – Udupi
itinerary.text: Drive to Moodbidri for the Thousand Pillar Jain basadi, then Karkala for the 13-metre Gommateshwara statue on its rock, and on to Udupi. Evening darshan at the Sri Krishna Matha. Overnight stay in Udupi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Udupi)Malpe, St Mary's and Kapu
itinerary.text: Take the boat from Malpe to St Mary's island (paid locally; October to May), then visit the Kapu lighthouse on its rocky beach and the Manipal end point for the view over the Swarna river. Overnight stay in Udupi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Udupi to Mangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a plate of Udupi dosas, drive back to Mangalore (about 60 km), with a stop at the Mangaladevi temple, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Dharmasthala and Kukke Subramanya
name: Dharmasthala and Kukke Subramanya
page_title: Dharmasthala and Kukke Subramanya – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of pilgrimage in Dakshina Kannada: the Manjunatha temple at Dharmasthala and Kukke Subramanya in the Western Ghats forest.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dharmasthala)Mangalore to Dharmasthala
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dharmasthala (about 75 km) on the Netravati. Evening darshan at the Manjunatha Swamy temple, run by a Jain family for a Shiva shrine, and see the Bahubali statue on Ratnagiri hill. Overnight stay in Dharmasthala.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kukke Subramanya)Dharmasthala to Kukke Subramanya
itinerary.text: After an early darshan and a visit to the vintage car museum, drive to Kukke Subramanya (about 55 km) in the forest at the foot of the Kumara Parvatha. Bathe in the Kumaradhara river and have darshan of Lord Subramanya, the protector of serpents. Overnight stay at Kukke.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kukke Subramanya)Sarpa Samskara and Adi Subramanya
itinerary.text: A morning for those taking the Sarpa Samskara or Ashlesha Bali rituals (booked with the temple), then the Adi Subramanya and the Kukke Shree math. Overnight stay at Kukke.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Kukke to Mangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Mangalore (about 100 km), stopping at the open-air Sowthadka Ganapati in the forest, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Kollur Mookambika and Udupi
page_title: Kollur Mookambika and Udupi – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days for darshan at Kollur Mookambika and Udupi's Krishna Matha, with the Kodachadri peak, the Arasinagundi falls and Maravanthe beach.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Udupi)Mangalore to Udupi
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Mangalore airport or station for the drive to Udupi (about 60 km). Darshan at the Sri Krishna Matha and the Anantheshwara and Chandramouleshwara temples beside it; evening at Malpe beach. Overnight stay in Udupi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kollur)Udupi to Kollur
itinerary.text: Drive north past the Maravanthe beach to Kollur (about 80 km) at the foot of the Kodachadri hills, for darshan of Mookambika Devi, one of the seven Mukti Sthalas, where Adi Shankaracharya is said to have installed the goddess. Evening aarti. Overnight stay in Kollur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kollur)Kodachadri or Arasinagundi
itinerary.text: An optional jeep up to Kodachadri peak and the Sarvajna Peetha of Shankaracharya (shared jeep paid locally), or a forest walk to the Arasinagundi falls. Overnight stay in Kollur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Kollur to Mangalore
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive back down the coast to Mangalore (about 140 km), stopping at Kundapura or the Kumbashi Anegudde Vinayaka temple, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Agumbe, Sringeri and Horanadu
name: Agumbe, Sringeri and Horanadu
page_title: Agumbe, Sringeri and Horanadu – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Malnad hills: the rainforest of Agumbe, Shankaracharya's Sringeri Sharada Peetham and the Annapoorneshwari temple at Horanadu.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Agumbe)Mangalore to Agumbe
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive up the hairpin ghat to Agumbe (about 140 km), the rainforest village called the Cherrapunji of the south, where Malgudi Days was filmed. Evening at the Agumbe sunset point over the Arabian Sea plain. Overnight stay at Agumbe or Sringeri.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sringeri)Sringeri Sharada Peetham
itinerary.text: Drive to Sringeri (about 25 km) on the Tunga river for the Sharada Peetham, the first math founded by Adi Shankaracharya, with the Vidyashankara temple, whose zodiac pillars catch the sun, and the temple fish fed from the ghats. Overnight stay in Sringeri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Horanadu)Sringeri to Horanadu
itinerary.text: Drive through coffee and areca country to Horanadu (about 70 km) for darshan of Annapoorneshwari, where every visitor is given a meal, and the Kalaseshwara temple at Kalasa nearby. Overnight stay at Horanadu.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Horanadu to Mangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down through the Kudremukh forest and the Charmadi or Kalasa ghat to Mangalore (about 140 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal
name: Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal
page_title: Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days among the Chalukya temples: Badami's cave temples and lake, the UNESCO-listed temples of Pattadakal and the ancient temple town of Aihole.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Badami)Hubli to Badami
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hubli airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Badami (about 100 km), the Chalukya capital set in a gorge of red sandstone. In the afternoon, climb to the four cave temples cut into the cliff in the 6th century, and watch the light fall on the Agastya lake and the Bhutanatha temples. Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Badami)Pattadakal and Aihole
itinerary.text: Drive to Pattadakal (about 22 km), a UNESCO World Heritage Site where the Chalukyas built temples in both northern and southern styles, then to Aihole, the "cradle of Indian temple architecture", with the apsidal Durga temple and over a hundred others (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Badami)Badami fort and Banashankari
itinerary.text: A morning walk up to the North Fort and the Malegitti Shivalaya, then the Banashankari temple and the Mahakuta group of temples by their tank. Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Badami to Hubli
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Hubli (about 100 km), with a stop at the Siddharoodha math, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Hampi and Badami
name: Hampi and Badami
page_title: Hampi and Badami – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days across two great capitals of the Deccan: the Vijayanagara ruins of Hampi and the Chalukya temples of Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Hampi)Hubli to Hampi
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Hubli airport or station for the drive to Hampi (about 165 km) through Hospet. At sunset, climb Hemakuta hill above the Virupaksha temple for the view over the boulder landscape of the Vijayanagara capital. Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Hampi)Vijayanagara ruins
itinerary.text: A full day among the ruins of Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Virupaksha temple, the stone chariot and musical pillars of the Vittala temple, the Lotus Mahal, the elephant stables and the Queen's bath (entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Hampi)Coracles and Anegundi
itinerary.text: A coracle ride on the Tungabhadra (paid locally) and a visit across the river to Anegundi and the Anjanadri hill, said to be Hanuman's birthplace, with about 575 steps to the top. Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Badami)Hampi to Badami
itinerary.text: Drive to Badami (about 140 km), stopping at Aihole and Pattadakal for their early Chalukya temples. Evening by the Agastya lake. Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Badami caves – Hubli
itinerary.text: An early climb to the four cave temples of Badami, then the drive to Hubli (about 100 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Shravanabelagola, Belur and Halebidu
name: Shravanabelagola, Belur and Halebidu
page_title: Shravanabelagola, Belur and Halebidu – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days of Jain and Hoysala heritage: the Bahubali statue of Shravanabelagola and the UNESCO-listed temples of Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Hassan)Bangalore to Shravanabelagola and Hassan
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Shravanabelagola (about 145 km). Climb barefoot about 650 steps up Vindhyagiri hill to the 17-metre statue of Gommateshwara (Bahubali), carved from a single rock in 981. Continue to Hassan. Overnight stay in Hassan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Hassan)Belur and Halebidu
itinerary.text: Visit the Chennakeshava temple at Belur and the Hoysaleswara temple at Halebidu (16 km apart), with their star-shaped plinths and dense soapstone carving, part of the UNESCO-listed Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Hassan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bangalore)Somanathapura – Bangalore
itinerary.text: Drive to Somanathapura (about 130 km) for the Keshava temple, the third of the Hoysala World Heritage temples, then on to Bangalore (about 140 km). Overnight stay in Bangalore.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for Lalbagh or the Bangalore Palace before the transfer to Bangalore airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Karnataka Heritage Trail
name: Karnataka Heritage Trail
page_title: Karnataka Heritage Trail – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days on Karnataka's heritage trail: Shravanabelagola, the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu, three nights at Hampi, and Aihole, Pattadakal and Badami.
cities: Bangalore - Belur - Halebidu - Hampi - Pattadakal - Badami

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Hassan)Bangalore to Hassan via Shravanabelagola
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Bangalore airport or station. Drive west to Shravanabelagola for the monolithic Bahubali on Vindhyagiri hill, then on to Hassan. Overnight stay in Hassan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Hassan)Belur and Halebidu
itinerary.text: A day with the Hoysala sculptors at the Chennakeshava temple in Belur and the twin Hoysaleswara temple at Halebidu, with its frieze of elephants, lions and epic scenes. Overnight stay in Hassan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Hampi)Hassan to Hampi
itinerary.text: A long drive north across the Deccan to Hampi (about 330 km, 7 hours) via Chitradurga, where there is time to see the great stone fort. Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Hampi)Hampi: the sacred centre
itinerary.text: The Virupaksha temple, the Hemakuta hill shrines, the monolithic Narasimha and the bazaar street to the Achyutaraya temple, with sunset from Matanga hill. Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Hampi)Hampi: the royal centre
itinerary.text: The Vittala temple and stone chariot, the Lotus Mahal, the elephant stables, the Mahanavami Dibba platform and the stepped tank; a coracle on the river is optional (paid locally). Overnight stay at Hampi or Hospet.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Badami)Hampi to Badami via Aihole
itinerary.text: Drive to Aihole for the Durga temple and the Ravanaphadi cave, then Pattadakal's UNESCO temples, arriving in Badami for the evening. Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Badami)Badami
itinerary.text: Climb to Badami's four cave temples, walk the lakeside to the Bhutanatha group and visit the Banashankari temple. Overnight stay in Badami.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Badami to Hubli
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Hubli (about 100 km) for your onward flight or train. The tour ends here.

page_title: Dandeli: River and Forest – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dandeli)Hubli to Dandeli
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hubli airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Dandeli (about 75 km) on the Kali river, in the teak and bamboo forest of the Kali Tiger Reserve. Evening by the river, watching for hornbills coming in to roost. Overnight stay at a jungle resort in Dandeli.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dandeli)Rafting, Syntheri and the caves
itinerary.text: An optional white-water rafting run on the Kali in the season, or kayaking and a coracle ride (all paid locally). In the afternoon, see the Syntheri rocks, a 300-foot granite monolith over the Kaneri river, and the Kavala caves with their natural lingam (steps down; entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Dandeli.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Dandeli to Hubli
itinerary.text: An early bird walk for the great and Malabar pied hornbills, then drive back to Hubli (about 75 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Jog Falls, Sagara and Shivamogga
page_title: Jog Falls, Sagara and Shivamogga – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Malnad: the Sakrebailu elephant camp, Jog Falls on the Sharavathi, the Nayaka temples of Keladi and Ikkeri, and Honnemaradu.
cities: Bangalore - Shivamogga - Sakrebailu - Jog Falls - Sagara - Ikkeri

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shivamogga)Bangalore to Shivamogga
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north-west to Shivamogga (about 300 km, 6 hours), the gateway to the Malnad. Evening by the Tunga river. Overnight stay in Shivamogga.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sagara)Sakrebailu – Jog Falls
itinerary.text: An early visit to the Sakrebailu elephant camp to watch the elephants bathed in the river, then drive to Jog Falls (about 100 km), where the Sharavathi drops 253 metres in four streams (fullest from July to September). Overnight stay at Sagara or near Jog.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sagara)Keladi and Ikkeri
itinerary.text: Visit the Keladi and Ikkeri temples of the Nayaka kings, with the great Aghoreshwara temple and its stone Nandi, and the backwaters of the Sharavathi at Honnemaradu. Overnight stay at Sagara.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Sagara to Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bangalore (about 360 km, 7 hours) for your onward journey, with a lunch stop on the way. The tour ends here.

name: Gokarna, Jog Falls and Dandeli
page_title: Gokarna, Jog Falls and Dandeli – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days across Uttara Kannada: the temple and beaches of Gokarna, the Jog Falls and Sirsi's Sahasralinga, and the river forest of Dandeli.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gokarna)Hubli to Gokarna
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hubli airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive over the ghats to Gokarna (about 160 km). Evening darshan at the Mahabaleshwar temple and the sunset on the main beach. Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gokarna)Om and Kudle beaches
itinerary.text: A day on foot along the headlands between Kudle and Om beach, with a boat to the quieter Half Moon and Paradise coves (paid locally). Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jog Falls)Gokarna to Jog Falls
itinerary.text: Drive south to Honnavar and up the Sharavathi valley, stopping at the Apsarakonda falls and the Idagunji Ganapati temple, to Jog Falls (about 120 km), India's second-highest plunge falls. Overnight stay near Jog.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Dandeli)Jog Falls to Dandeli
itinerary.text: Drive north through Sirsi, with the Marikamba temple and the Sahasralinga carvings in the Shalmala river, to Dandeli (about 200 km) in the Kali forest. Overnight stay at a jungle resort in Dandeli.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Dandeli)Dandeli
itinerary.text: Optional rafting or kayaking on the Kali river (paid locally), the Syntheri rocks and a dusk walk for hornbills. Overnight stay in Dandeli.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Dandeli to Hubli
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Hubli (about 75 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sakleshpur)Manjarabad and the Bisle ghat

description: Four days in the coffee hills: Chikmagalur's estates and lake, Mullayanagiri and Baba Budangiri, and the shola forests of Kudremukh.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Chikmagalur)Bangalore to Chikmagalur
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Bangalore airport or station for the drive to Chikmagalur (about 245 km, 5 hours), where coffee was first grown in India. Evening at the Hirekolale lake with the hills reflected in it. Overnight stay in Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Chikmagalur)Mullayanagiri and Baba Budangiri
itinerary.text: Drive up to Mullayanagiri, Karnataka's highest peak, for the view over the Baba Budan range, then to the Baba Budangiri shrine and the Manikyadhara falls, and a coffee estate tour in the afternoon (paid locally). Overnight stay in Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kudremukh)Kudremukh and Kalasa
itinerary.text: Drive to the Kudremukh National Park (about 95 km), a shola forest and grassland of the Western Ghats, for the Hanuman Gundi falls and the Kalaseshwara temple at Kalasa (forest entry paid locally; treks need a forest permit). Overnight stay near Kudremukh or Kalasa.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Kudremukh to Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bangalore (about 330 km, 7 hours) via Chikmagalur for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Coorg, Sakleshpur and Chikmagalur
name: Coorg, Sakleshpur and Chikmagalur
page_title: Coorg, Sakleshpur and Chikmagalur – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days through Karnataka's coffee country: Coorg and Talacauvery, Sakleshpur and Manjarabad fort, and Chikmagalur's peaks and lakes.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Coorg)Bangalore to Coorg
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Coorg (Madikeri), about 260 km, stopping at the Namdroling golden temple of the Tibetan settlement at Bylakuppe. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Coorg)Madikeri and Talacauvery
itinerary.text: Visit the Abbey falls and Raja's Seat in Madikeri, then drive to Bhagamandala, where three rivers meet, and up to Talacauvery, the source of the Kaveri. Overnight stay in Coorg.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sakleshpur)Dubare – Sakleshpur
itinerary.text: A morning at the Dubare elephant camp on the Kaveri (paid locally), then drive north to Sakleshpur (about 140 km) and its coffee estates. Overnight stay in Sakleshpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Chikmagalur)Manjarabad – Chikmagalur
itinerary.text: Visit Tipu's star-shaped Manjarabad fort and drive on through Belur, with a stop at the Chennakeshava temple, to Chikmagalur. Overnight stay in Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Chikmagalur)Mullayanagiri
itinerary.text: Drive up the winding road to Mullayanagiri, the highest peak in Karnataka, then on along the ridge to the Baba Budangiri shrine, where coffee is said to have first been planted in India. A shared jeep down a rough track reaches the Jhari falls (paid locally). Overnight stay in Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Chikmagalur)A slow day in the hills
itinerary.text: A slow day in the hills: a guided walk through a coffee and pepper estate to see how the beans are picked and dried, a quiet morning at the Hirekolale lake, and the Ayyanakere lake, one of the oldest reservoirs in the state, at sunset. Overnight stay in Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Chikmagalur to Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bangalore (about 245 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Srisailam)Hyderabad to Srisailam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hyderabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive south through the Nallamala forest of the Amrabad tiger reserve to Srisailam (about 215 km, 5 hours) on the Krishna gorge. Visit the Sakshi Ganapati, then take the ropeway down to the Patala Ganga on the Krishna (paid locally). Overnight stay in Srisailam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Srisailam)Srisailam dam and Akkamahadevi caves
itinerary.text: A morning at the Srisailam dam viewpoint, then a boat up the Krishna gorge to the Akkamahadevi caves (paid locally; runs when the water allows), and the Shikharam peak viewpoint at sunset. Overnight stay in Srisailam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Srisailam to Hyderabad
itinerary.text: After an early darshan, drive back through the forest to Hyderabad (about 215 km), arriving by afternoon for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Hyderabad, Srisailam and Tirupati
name: Hyderabad, Srisailam and Tirupati
page_title: Hyderabad, Srisailam and Tirupati – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days from Hyderabad to Tirupati: Golconda and the Charminar, the Srisailam Jyotirlinga, the Narasimha shrines of Ahobilam, and Tirumala.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Hyderabad)Arrive in Hyderabad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hyderabad airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at the Charminar and the bangle lanes of Laad Bazaar, and the Birla Mandir on its hill at sunset. Overnight stay in Hyderabad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Hyderabad)Golconda and the old city
itinerary.text: Visit the Golconda fort, where a handclap at the gate carries to the top, the Qutb Shahi tombs and the Chowmahalla palace (closed Fridays), with the evening sound-and-light show at Golconda (paid locally). Overnight stay in Hyderabad.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Srisailam)Hyderabad to Srisailam
itinerary.text: Drive through the Nallamala forest to Srisailam (about 215 km). Evening darshan at the Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga and Bhramaramba Devi. Overnight stay in Srisailam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ahobilam)Srisailam to Ahobilam
itinerary.text: An early darshan, the Patala Ganga ropeway (paid locally), then drive to Ahobilam (about 180 km) in the hills, where the nine Narasimha shrines are spread through the forest; visit the lower and upper Ahobilam temples. Overnight stay at Ahobilam or Allagadda.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Tirupati)Ahobilam to Tirupati
itinerary.text: Drive south to Tirupati (about 270 km, 6 hours). Evening darshan at the Padmavathi temple in Tiruchanur. Overnight stay in Tirupati.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Tirupati)Tirumala darshan
itinerary.text: Drive up to Tirumala for darshan of Lord Venkateswara at your Special Entry Darshan time (booked in advance with TTD), then the Akasa Ganga and Silathoranam. Overnight stay in Tirupati.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Tirupati
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Kapila Theertham at the foot of the hills before the transfer to Tirupati airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Warangal and the Ramappa Temple
name: Warangal and the Ramappa Temple
page_title: Warangal and the Ramappa Temple – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Kakatiya country: Warangal's Thousand Pillar temple and fort gateways, the UNESCO-listed Ramappa temple and the Laknavaram lake.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Warangal)Hyderabad to Warangal
itinerary.text: Arrive at Hyderabad airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Warangal (about 150 km), the Kakatiya capital. Visit the Thousand Pillar temple, with its star-shaped base, and the Bhadrakali temple by its lake. Overnight stay in Warangal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Warangal)Ramappa and Laknavaram
itinerary.text: Drive to Palampet (about 65 km) for the Ramappa temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, built of stone light enough to float in water and carved with dancers and musicians. Continue to the Laknavaram lake and its hanging bridge across the islands. Overnight stay in Warangal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Hyderabad)Warangal fort – Hyderabad
itinerary.text: See the four carved Kakatiya gateways (thoranas) of Warangal fort, now the symbol of Telangana, and the Khush Mahal, then drive back to Hyderabad. Overnight stay in Hyderabad.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Hyderabad
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the Charminar and Laad Bazaar before the transfer to Hyderabad airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Bhadrachalam and the Papikondalu Gorge
page_title: Bhadrachalam and the Papikondalu Gorge – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days on the Godavari: a boat through the Papikondalu gorge, the Sita Ramachandra Swamy temple at Bhadrachalam and Parnasala, from Rajahmundry.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rajahmundry)Arrive in Rajahmundry
itinerary.text: Arrive at Rajahmundry airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening on the Pushkar ghat of the Godavari, with the long road-cum-rail bridges across the river, and the Kotilingeswara temple. Overnight stay in Rajahmundry.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhadrachalam)Papikondalu boat
itinerary.text: An early drive to the jetty at Pochavaram or Gandi Pochamma for a day boat up the Godavari through the Papikondalu hills, where the river narrows between forested slopes (boat paid locally; runs when the river allows). Continue by road to Bhadrachalam. Overnight stay in Bhadrachalam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bhadrachalam)Sita Ramachandra Swamy temple – Parnasala
itinerary.text: Darshan at the Sita Ramachandra Swamy temple, built by the saint Bhakta Ramadasu, then Parnasala (about 32 km), where Sita is said to have been taken by Ravana, with its hut shrine by the river. Overnight stay in Bhadrachalam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Rajahmundry)Bhadrachalam to Rajahmundry
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Rajahmundry (about 190 km). Evening aarti on the Godavari ghats. Overnight stay in Rajahmundry.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Rajahmundry
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the ISKCON temple on the riverbank before the transfer to Rajahmundry airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Visakhapatnam, Araku Valley and Borra Caves
page_title: Visakhapatnam, Araku Valley and Borra Caves – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days from Visakhapatnam: the submarine museum and Kailasagiri, the coffee hills and tribal museum of Araku, and the Borra caves.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Visakhapatnam)Arrive in Visakhapatnam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Visakhapatnam airport or station, where our representative meets you. See the INS Kursura submarine museum on Ramakrishna beach and ride up to Kailasagiri hill for the view of the bay (ropeway paid locally). Overnight stay in Visakhapatnam.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Araku)To Araku via the Ananthagiri hills
itinerary.text: Drive up through the Eastern Ghats and the coffee plantations of Ananthagiri to the Araku valley (about 115 km), with stops at the Tyda park and the Galikonda viewpoint. Afternoon at the Tribal Museum and the coffee museum. Overnight stay in Araku.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Araku)Araku valley
itinerary.text: A day in the valley: the Padmapuram botanical gardens, the Chaparai stream, a tribal village of the Araku hills, and the Dhimsa dance in the evening where it is held (paid locally). Overnight stay in Araku.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Visakhapatnam)Borra caves – Visakhapatnam
itinerary.text: Drive down to the Borra caves (about 35 km), a million-year-old limestone cave lit to show its stalactites (entry paid locally), and on to Visakhapatnam. Overnight stay in Visakhapatnam.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Visakhapatnam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Simhachalam Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha temple on its hill before the transfer to Visakhapatnam airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Visakhapatnam)Rushikonda and Bheemili

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vijayawada)Arrive in Vijayawada
itinerary.text: Arrive at Vijayawada airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening darshan at the Kanaka Durga temple on Indrakeeladri hill above the Krishna, and the lights of the Prakasam barrage. Overnight stay in Vijayawada.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vijayawada)Undavalli, Mangalagiri and Amaravati
itinerary.text: See the four-storey rock-cut Undavalli caves with the reclining Vishnu, the Panakala Narasimha temple at Mangalagiri, where jaggery water is offered, then Amaravati (about 35 km) for the Amareswara temple and the museum of the great Buddhist stupa (closed Fridays). Overnight stay in Vijayawada.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Vijayawada)Bhavani island and Kondapalli
itinerary.text: A boat to Bhavani island on the Krishna (paid locally), then the Kondapalli fort and the village where the light-wood Kondapalli toys are carved. Overnight stay in Vijayawada.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Vijayawada
itinerary.text: After an early darshan at Kanaka Durga, the transfer to Vijayawada airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Pancharama Kshetras: the Five Shiva Temples
name: Pancharama Kshetras: the Five Shiva Temples
page_title: Pancharama Kshetras: the Five Shiva Temples – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days to all five Pancharama Shiva temples of Andhra Pradesh: Amararama, Somarama, Ksheerarama, Draksharamam and Kumararama.
cities: Vijayawada - Amaravati - Bhimavaram - Palakollu - Draksharamam - Samalkot

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vijayawada)Arrive – Amararama
itinerary.text: Arrive at Vijayawada airport or station, where our representative meets you. Drive to Amaravati (about 35 km) for Amararama, the first of the five Pancharama temples, whose tall linga is said to come from a single piece of the Shiva linga broken by Kumaraswamy. Evening at Kanaka Durga. Overnight stay in Vijayawada.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bhimavaram)Vijayawada to Bhimavaram – Somarama
itinerary.text: Drive to Bhimavaram (about 110 km) for Somarama, where the linga is said to change colour with the phases of the moon, and the Mavullamma temple of the town's goddess. Overnight stay in Bhimavaram.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Rajahmundry)Ksheerarama and Draksharamam
itinerary.text: Visit Ksheerarama at Palakollu, with its tall white gopuram, then Draksharamam for Bhimeswara Swamy and Manikyamba Devi, a Shakti Peeth, and on to Rajahmundry. Overnight stay in Rajahmundry.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Rajahmundry)Kumararama at Samalkot
itinerary.text: Drive to Samalkot (about 50 km) for Kumararama, the fifth temple, with its two-storey mandapa, completing the Pancharama circuit; evening on the Godavari ghats at Rajahmundry. Overnight stay in Rajahmundry.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Rajahmundry
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the transfer to Rajahmundry airport or station for your onward journey, with a stop at the Kotilingeswara temple on the river. The tour ends here.

title: Lepakshi and Puttaparthi
name: Lepakshi and Puttaparthi
page_title: Lepakshi and Puttaparthi – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days from Bangalore: the Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi, with its hanging pillar and giant Nandi, and Prasanthi Nilayam at Puttaparthi.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Puttaparthi)Bangalore to Lepakshi and Puttaparthi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north to Lepakshi (about 120 km) for the 16th-century Veerabhadra temple, with its hanging pillar, painted ceilings and the giant monolithic Nandi. Continue to Puttaparthi (about 70 km). Overnight stay in Puttaparthi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Puttaparthi)Prasanthi Nilayam
itinerary.text: Attend the morning bhajans at Prasanthi Nilayam, the ashram of Sri Sathya Sai Baba, and visit the Mahasamadhi, the Chaitanya Jyoti museum and the hilltop Hanuman and Kalpavriksha. Evening bhajans. Overnight stay in Puttaparthi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Puttaparthi to Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bangalore (about 160 km), with a stop at the Nandi Hills or a roadside lunch on the way, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Gandikota Gorge and Belum Caves
name: Gandikota Gorge and Belum Caves
page_title: Gandikota Gorge and Belum Caves – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Rayalaseema country: the red-granite gorge and fort of Gandikota, the Belum caves and the Yaganti temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Gandikota)Bangalore to Gandikota
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north to Gandikota (about 290 km, 6 hours). At sunset, walk to the rim of the gorge where the Penna river cuts through red granite, often called the Grand Canyon of India. Overnight stay at Gandikota (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gandikota)Gandikota fort and the gorge
itinerary.text: Sunrise over the gorge, then the Gandikota fort with its Madhavaraya and Ranganatha temples, the Jamia Masjid and the old granary. An optional coracle on the Penna or a walk down to the river (paid locally). Overnight stay at Gandikota.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Belum)Belum caves and Yaganti
itinerary.text: Drive to the Belum caves (about 60 km), the second-longest caves on the Indian plains, with lit passages, stalactites and the Patalganga chamber (entry paid locally). Continue to the Yaganti Uma Maheswara temple, whose stone Nandi is said to grow. Overnight stay near Belum or at Banaganapalle.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Belum to Bangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bangalore (about 300 km, 6 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.
