title: Fort Kochi and Mattancherry Heritage Break
name: Fort Kochi and Mattancherry Heritage Break
page_title: Fort Kochi and Mattancherry Heritage Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in old Kochi: the Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church, the Mattancherry Palace murals, the Paradesi Synagogue and Jew Town.
cities: Kochi - Fort Kochi - Mattancherry - Jew Town

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Fort Kochi)Arrive – Fort Kochi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kochi airport or Ernakulam station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Fort Kochi. Walk past the Chinese fishing nets at sunset, the St Francis Church where Vasco da Gama was first buried, and the Santa Cruz Basilica. Evening Kathakali performance with the make-up session beforehand (paid locally). Overnight stay in Fort Kochi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Fort Kochi)Mattancherry and Jew Town
itinerary.text: See the Mattancherry Palace, also called the Dutch Palace, with its Ramayana murals (closed Fridays), the Paradesi Synagogue of 1568 with its Chinese tiles (closed Fridays and Saturdays) and the spice warehouses of Jew Town, then the Kerala Folklore Museum. Evening on Marine Drive in Ernakulam. Overnight stay in Fort Kochi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Kochi
itinerary.text: After a slow breakfast in one of Fort Kochi's café houses and a last walk past the Dutch cemetery, the transfer to Kochi airport or Ernakulam station. The tour ends here.

title: Guruvayur and Thrissur
name: Guruvayur and Thrissur
page_title: Guruvayur and Thrissur – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days for darshan at the Guruvayur Sri Krishna temple and the Vadakkunnathan temple of Thrissur, the city of the Pooram festival.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Guruvayur)Kochi to Guruvayur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kochi airport or Ernakulam station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Guruvayur (about 90 km). Evening darshan of Guruvayurappan, Krishna as a child, at the Sri Krishna temple, with its lamp-lit deepasthambam (Hindus only; men in mundu without a shirt, women in sari or salwar). Overnight stay in Guruvayur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Thrissur)Punnathur Kotta – Thrissur
itinerary.text: Early darshan, then the Punnathur Kotta elephant yard of the temple. Drive to Thrissur (about 30 km) for the Vadakkunnathan temple, at the heart of the Thrissur Pooram festival, the Shakthan Thampuran palace and the Our Lady of Dolours basilica. Overnight stay in Thrissur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Thrissur to Kochi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Kochi (about 80 km), with a stop at the Kerala Kalamandalam at Cheruthuruthy to see the classical-arts training if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Vagamon and Kumarakom
name: Vagamon and Kumarakom
page_title: Vagamon and Kumarakom – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days from the pine meadows of Vagamon to the lakeside village of Kumarakom on the Vembanad, with its bird sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vagamon)Kochi to Vagamon
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kochi airport or Ernakulam station, where our representative meets you, and drive into the hills to Vagamon (about 100 km), a quiet hill station of meadows and pine woods. Evening at the Vagamon meadows. Overnight stay in Vagamon.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vagamon)Vagamon hills
itinerary.text: Walk through the pine forest, climb to the Kurisumala pilgrimage hill or the Thangal Para rock, and see the tea estates and the Marmala waterfalls; paragliding is optional in the season (paid locally). Overnight stay in Vagamon.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kumarakom)Vagamon to Kumarakom
itinerary.text: Drive down to Kumarakom (about 70 km) on the Vembanad lake. In the evening, a country-boat ride along the canals and the lake shore at sunset (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kumarakom.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kumarakom)Kumarakom bird sanctuary
itinerary.text: An early walk in the Kumarakom bird sanctuary for herons, cormorants and migratory birds in winter, then a lazy afternoon by the lake or a visit to a village of coir makers and toddy tappers. Overnight stay in Kumarakom.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Kumarakom to Kochi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Kochi (about 75 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Marari Beach and Alleppey
name: Marari Beach and Alleppey
page_title: Marari Beach and Alleppey – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the quiet coast of Marari, with a canoe through the canals of Kuttanad near Alleppey and the Ambalappuzha temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Marari)Kochi to Marari
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Kochi airport or Ernakulam station for the drive south to Mararikulam (about 60 km), a quiet fishing-village beach. Evening walk on Marari beach as the boats come in. Overnight stay at Marari.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Marari)Alleppey canals
itinerary.text: Drive into Alleppey (about 15 km) for a canoe ride through the narrow village canals of Kuttanad, between paddy fields below sea level (canoe paid locally), and the old Alleppey pier and lighthouse. Overnight stay at Marari.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Marari)Ambalappuzha and the beach
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at the Ambalappuzha Sri Krishna temple, known for its palpayasam, then a slow afternoon on Marari beach, with an optional Ayurvedic massage (paid locally). Overnight stay at Marari.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Marari to Kochi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Kochi (about 60 km), with a stop at Fort Kochi's fishing nets if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Munnar, Marayoor and Chinnar
name: Munnar, Marayoor and Chinnar
page_title: Munnar, Marayoor and Chinnar – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in the high ranges: Munnar's tea gardens and Eravikulam, then the sandalwood forest, dolmens and jaggery of Marayoor and the Chinnar sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Munnar)Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kochi airport or Ernakulam station, where our representative meets you, and drive up to Munnar (about 130 km), stopping at the Cheeyappara and Valara falls. Evening among the tea gardens. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Munnar)Eravikulam and the tea museum
itinerary.text: Visit Eravikulam National Park for the Nilgiri tahr on the grassy slopes of Anamudi (closed in the calving season, about February to March; entry paid locally), then the Tata tea museum and the Mattupetty dam. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Marayoor)Munnar to Marayoor
itinerary.text: Drive north to Marayoor (about 40 km), in the rain shadow of the Western Ghats, for its sandalwood forest, the Muniyaras dolmens left by Stone Age people, and the jaggery units where sugarcane is boiled down. Overnight stay in Marayoor.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Marayoor)Chinnar wildlife sanctuary
itinerary.text: A guided walk or trek in the Chinnar wildlife sanctuary for the grizzled giant squirrel, deer and the Thoovanam falls (forest trek paid locally). Overnight stay in Marayoor.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Marayoor to Kochi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back through Munnar to Kochi (about 170 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Poovar and Kovalam
name: Poovar and Kovalam
page_title: Poovar and Kovalam – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days at Kovalam's Lighthouse beach, with a boat to the Poovar estuary and the museums and temple of Thiruvananthapuram.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kovalam)Thiruvananthapuram to Kovalam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Thiruvananthapuram airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Kovalam (about 16 km). Afternoon on the Lighthouse beach below the striped lighthouse, with a climb to the top for the view (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kovalam)Poovar estuary
itinerary.text: Drive to Poovar (about 18 km), where the Neyyar river meets the sea at a golden sandbar, and take a boat through the mangroves and backwaters to the estuary beach (boat paid locally). Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kovalam)Thiruvananthapuram city
itinerary.text: A morning in the capital: the Napier Museum and its gardens, the Kuthiramalika palace and, for Hindus, darshan at the Sri Padmanabhaswamy temple (dress code applies). Afternoon on Hawa beach at Kovalam. Overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Kovalam to Thiruvananthapuram
itinerary.text: After a morning swim, the transfer to Thiruvananthapuram airport or station (about 16 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Thiruvananthapuram airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Napier Museum and the Sree Chitra art gallery with its Raja Ravi Varma paintings, then the Shanghumukham beach at sunset. Overnight stay in Thiruvananthapuram.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ponmudi)To Ponmudi
itinerary.text: Drive into the hills to Ponmudi (about 60 km) by a road of 22 hairpin bends, with a stop at the Kallar river. Afternoon in the misty tea and cardamom slopes and the Golden Valley; walkers can go down to the Meenmutty falls (forest guide paid locally). Overnight stay in Ponmudi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Thiruvananthapuram)Neyyar dam – Thiruvananthapuram
itinerary.text: Drive down to the Neyyar dam and its reservoir in the forest, with the crocodile rehabilitation centre (entry paid locally), and back to the city. Overnight stay in Thiruvananthapuram.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Thiruvananthapuram
itinerary.text: After breakfast, darshan at the Sri Padmanabhaswamy temple for Hindus (dress code applies) or the Kuthiramalika palace museum, then the transfer to the airport or station. The tour ends here.

name: Palakkad and Nelliyampathy
page_title: Palakkad and Nelliyampathy – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Palakkad)Coimbatore to Palakkad
itinerary.text: Arrive at Coimbatore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive through the Palakkad gap in the Western Ghats to Palakkad (about 55 km). Visit the Palakkad fort of Tipu Sultan and the Kalpathy agraharam of old Tamil Brahmin houses. Overnight stay in Palakkad.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Nelliyampathy)Malampuzha – Nelliyampathy
itinerary.text: See the Malampuzha dam and gardens with its ropeway (paid locally), then drive up the Pothundi dam road and ten hairpin bends to Nelliyampathy (about 60 km), a hill of orange, coffee and tea estates. Overnight stay in Nelliyampathy.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Nelliyampathy)Seethargundu and Kesavanpara
itinerary.text: Walk to the Seethargundu viewpoint over the Palakkad plains, the Kesavanpara rock, and the government orange farm, watching for hornbills and Nilgiri langurs in the estates. Overnight stay in Nelliyampathy.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Nelliyampathy to Coimbatore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down through Palakkad to Coimbatore (about 110 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bekal Fort and Kasaragod
name: Bekal Fort and Kasaragod
page_title: Bekal Fort and Kasaragod – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Kerala's far north: the keyhole-shaped Bekal fort, the Valiyaparamba backwaters, the Ananthapura lake temple and Ranipuram.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bekal)Mangalore to Bekal
itinerary.text: Arrive at Mangalore airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive south into Kerala to Bekal (about 65 km). Walk the walls of Bekal fort, the largest in Kerala, shaped like a keyhole on the sea, and watch the sunset from its observation tower (entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Bekal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bekal)Valiyaparamba backwaters
itinerary.text: A day on the Valiyaparamba backwaters, the quietest in Kerala, by country boat or canoe among islands and mangroves (paid locally), with the Kappil beach in the late afternoon. Overnight stay at Bekal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bekal)Ananthapura lake temple and Ranipuram
itinerary.text: Visit the Ananthapura lake temple, the only lake temple in Kerala, and the Chandragiri fort, then drive up to the grassy hills of Ranipuram (about 50 km) for the view. Overnight stay at Bekal.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Bekal to Mangalore
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Mangalore (about 65 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Kannur in the Theyyam Season
name: Kannur in the Theyyam Season
page_title: Kannur in the Theyyam Season – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in north Kerala for theyyam, the ritual dance-worship of the village shrines, with Kannur's forts, Thalassery and Muzhappilangad beach.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kannur)Arrive in Kannur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kannur airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the St Angelo fort built by the Portuguese, the Arakkal museum of Kerala's only Muslim royal family, and the Payyambalam beach at sunset. Overnight stay in Kannur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kannur)Theyyam
itinerary.text: With a local guide (paid locally), attend a theyyam at a village kavu (shrine), where performers in vast headdresses and painted faces become the deity in a night-long ritual; performances follow the temple calendar, mostly December to April. Earlier, the Parassinikadavu Muthappan temple, where theyyam is offered every day. Overnight stay in Kannur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kannur)Thalassery and Muzhappilangad
itinerary.text: Drive along the Muzhappilangad drive-in beach, one of the longest in Asia, to Thalassery for its fort, the old spice warehouses and the bakeries said to have baked Kerala's first cakes; visit a handloom weaving unit in Kannur. Overnight stay in Kannur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Kannur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the transfer to Kannur airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

Walk through Fontainhas, the Latin quarter of painted houses and azulejo tiles, to the Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception church above its zigzag steps. Evening on the Mandovi riverfront. Overnight stay in Panjim.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Panjim)Old Goa and Divar
itinerary.text: A day in Old Goa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site: the Basilica of Bom Jesus with the relics of St Francis Xavier, the Se Cathedral, the Church of St Francis of Assisi and the Archaeological Museum. Take the free ferry across to Divar island for its village lanes, and visit the Mangueshi temple at Ponda. Overnight stay in Panjim.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Goa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a stop at the Reis Magos fort across the river before the transfer to Goa airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: North Goa's Quiet Beaches: Morjim, Ashwem and Arambol
page_title: North Goa's Quiet Beaches: Morjim, Ashwem and Arambol – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on North Goa's quietest beaches: Morjim, Ashwem, Mandrem and Arambol, with the Tiracol and Chapora forts.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Morjim)Arrive – Morjim
itinerary.text: Arrive at Goa (Mopa or Dabolim) airport or station, where our representative meets you, and transfer to Morjim at the mouth of the Chapora river, a beach where olive ridley turtles nest in winter. Sunset from the beach. Overnight stay at Morjim or Ashwem.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Morjim)Ashwem, Mandrem and Arambol
itinerary.text: Walk or drive north along the quiet beaches of Ashwem and Mandrem to Arambol, with its sweet-water lake behind the beach and the drum circle at sunset. Overnight stay at Morjim or Ashwem.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Morjim)Querim and Tiracol
itinerary.text: Drive to Querim, Goa's northernmost beach, and cross the river by ferry to the Tiracol fort on the Maharashtra border for the view; on the way back, the Chapora fort above Vagator. Overnight stay at Morjim or Ashwem.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Goa
itinerary.text: After a last swim, the transfer to Goa airport or station (Mopa is about 30 minutes away) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Arrive at Goa (Mopa or Dabolim) airport or station, where our representative meets you, and transfer to Palolem in the far south, a crescent of sand lined with palms and huts. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay at Palolem.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Palolem)Butterfly beach and the dolphins
itinerary.text: Take a morning boat from Palolem to look for dolphins and to Butterfly beach, a cove reached only by sea or forest path (boat paid locally), then Agonda beach, a turtle-nesting beach, in the afternoon. Overnight stay at Palolem.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Palolem)Cabo de Rama and Galgibaga
itinerary.text: Drive to the Cabo de Rama fort on its cliff over the sea, with its small chapel, and the quiet Galgibaga beach of the olive ridley turtles; walkers can visit the Cotigao wildlife sanctuary (entry paid locally). Overnight stay at Palolem.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Goa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the transfer to Goa airport or station (Dabolim is about 1.5 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

description: Four days in Goa's green interior: the Mangueshi and Shantadurga temples, a spice plantation, the Tambdi Surla temple and the Netravali sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ponda)Arrive – Ponda temples
itinerary.text: Arrive at Goa (Mopa or Dabolim) airport or station, where our representative meets you, and transfer inland to Ponda, the temple country of Goa. Visit the Shri Mangueshi and Shantadurga temples, with their lamp towers. Overnight stay near Ponda.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ponda)Spice farm and Tambdi Surla
itinerary.text: A guided walk through a spice plantation of pepper, cardamom, nutmeg and vanilla, with a Goan lunch (paid locally), then the 12th-century Tambdi Surla Mahadev temple of the Kadambas, hidden in the Bhagwan Mahavir sanctuary. Overnight stay near Ponda.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Netravali)Netravali sanctuary
itinerary.text: Drive south to the Netravali wildlife sanctuary for the Budbudyachi Tali, a pond that bubbles when you clap, the Savari waterfall and the forest trails (entry and guide paid locally). Overnight stay near Netravali or Ponda.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Goa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the transfer to Goa airport or station for your onward journey, with a stop at the Bondla forest or the Sahakari spice farm if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Goa and Gokarna
name: Goa and Gokarna
page_title: Goa and Gokarna – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days on the Konkan coast: Panjim, Old Goa and the north Goa beaches, then the temple town and cliff beaches of Gokarna.
cities: Goa - Panjim - Karwar - Gokarna - Om Beach

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Panjim)Arrive in Goa
itinerary.text: Arrive at Goa (Mopa or Dabolim) airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at Miramar beach and an evening walk through Fontainhas in Panjim. Overnight stay in Goa.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Panjim)Old Goa and the north coast
itinerary.text: Visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus and the Se Cathedral in Old Goa, then the Aguada fort and lighthouse and the Candolim and Calangute beaches. Overnight stay in Goa.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gokarna)Goa to Gokarna
itinerary.text: Drive south along the coast through Canacona and over the Kali bridge at Karwar to Gokarna (about 145 km), stopping at the Rabindranath Tagore beach in Karwar. Evening darshan at the Mahabaleshwar temple. Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gokarna)Om and Kudle beaches
itinerary.text: A day on Gokarna's beaches: the cliff path from Kudle to Om beach and a boat to Half Moon and Paradise beaches (paid locally). Overnight stay in Gokarna.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Gokarna to Goa
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back north to Goa airport or station (Dabolim about 3 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amritsar: Golden Temple and Wagah Border
name: Amritsar: Golden Temple and Wagah Border
page_title: Amritsar: Golden Temple and Wagah Border – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Amritsar: the Golden Temple by day, night and dawn, the langar, Jallianwala Bagh, the Partition Museum and the Wagah border ceremony.
cities: Amritsar - Golden Temple - Jallianwala Bagh - Wagah Border

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive in Amritsar – Golden Temple
itinerary.text: Arrive at Amritsar airport or railway station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit Jallianwala Bagh and the Partition Museum in the Town Hall (closed Mondays), then drive to the Wagah–Attari border (about 30 km) for the evening beating-retreat ceremony. Return for the Golden Temple lit at night and the Palki Sahib procession. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Amritsar)Harmandir Sahib and the old city
itinerary.text: Before dawn, the Prakash ceremony as the Guru Granth Sahib is carried into the Harmandir Sahib; later, eat at the langar, the free community kitchen that feeds tens of thousands daily, and see the Akal Takht. In the afternoon, the Durgiana temple, the Gobindgarh fort and the lanes of Katra Jaimal Singh for Amritsari kulcha. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Amritsar
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last parikrama around the sarovar, the transfer to Amritsar airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amritsar, Tarn Taran and Goindwal Sahib
name: Amritsar, Tarn Taran and Goindwal Sahib
page_title: Amritsar, Tarn Taran and Goindwal Sahib – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the gurdwara trail around Amritsar: the Golden Temple, Tarn Taran Sahib, the Baoli of Goindwal Sahib and Khadoor Sahib.
cities: Amritsar - Golden Temple - Tarn Taran - Goindwal Sahib - Khadoor Sahib

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive in Amritsar
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Amritsar airport or station. Evening at the Harmandir Sahib for the Rehras path and the night Palki Sahib, when the holy book is taken to the Akal Takht. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Amritsar)Tarn Taran, Goindwal and Khadoor Sahib
itinerary.text: Drive to Tarn Taran Sahib (about 25 km), founded by Guru Arjan Dev with the largest sarovar of any gurdwara, then Goindwal Sahib on the Beas, where pilgrims descend the 84 steps of the Baoli Sahib, and Khadoor Sahib, the seat of Guru Angad Dev. Return to Amritsar. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Amritsar)Amritsar and the border
itinerary.text: A morning at the Golden Temple and the Central Sikh Museum, Jallianwala Bagh and Ram Tirath, the ashram of Valmiki (about 11 km). Late afternoon at the Attari–Wagah border for the retreat ceremony. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Amritsar
itinerary.text: After breakfast and an early darshan, the transfer to Amritsar airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amritsar, Kapurthala and Jalandhar
name: Amritsar, Kapurthala and Jalandhar
page_title: Amritsar, Kapurthala and Jalandhar – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Doaba: the Golden Temple, Kapurthala's French-style palace and Moorish Mosque, Jalandhar's Devi Talab Mandir and the Wagah ceremony.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive in Amritsar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Amritsar airport or station, where our representative meets you. Walk through the Heritage Street to the Golden Temple for the evening, and the Partition Museum (closed Mondays). Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jalandhar)Kapurthala and Jalandhar
itinerary.text: Drive to Kapurthala (about 65 km), the "Paris of Punjab", for the French-style Jagatjit Palace (seen from outside; it is now a school), the Moorish Mosque modelled on Marrakesh, and the Pushpa Gujral Science City. Continue to Jalandhar for the Devi Talab Mandir. Overnight stay in Jalandhar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Amritsar)Kartarpur – Amritsar – Wagah
itinerary.text: Visit the Kartarpur gurdwara near Jalandhar, then drive back to Amritsar (about 85 km) for the Wagah border ceremony in the late afternoon. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Amritsar
itinerary.text: An early visit for the Prakash at the Golden Temple and breakfast at a dhaba, then the transfer to Amritsar airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Amritsar and Anandpur Sahib
name: Amritsar and Anandpur Sahib
page_title: Amritsar and Anandpur Sahib – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days from Amritsar to Anandpur Sahib, birthplace of the Khalsa: the Golden Temple, Takht Kesgarh Sahib, Virasat-e-Khalsa and Kiratpur.
cities: Amritsar - Golden Temple - Anandpur Sahib - Kiratpur Sahib - Chandigarh

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive in Amritsar
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Amritsar airport or station. In the evening, the Golden Temple and the Palki Sahib procession, after Jallianwala Bagh at dusk. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Anandpur Sahib)Amritsar to Anandpur Sahib
itinerary.text: After the dawn Prakash and the Wagah museum or Gobindgarh fort, drive to Anandpur Sahib (about 200 km) at the foot of the Shivaliks, where Guru Gobind Singh founded the Khalsa in 1699. Evening at Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib. Overnight stay at Anandpur Sahib.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Anandpur Sahib)Virasat-e-Khalsa and Kiratpur
itinerary.text: Visit the Virasat-e-Khalsa, the museum of Sikh history in its striking modern building (closed Mondays), the Qila Anandgarh Sahib, and Kiratpur Sahib, where ashes are immersed in the Sutlej. Overnight stay at Anandpur Sahib.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Anandpur Sahib to Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Chandigarh (about 85 km), stopping at the Rock Garden if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Amritsar, Anandpur Sahib and Chandigarh
name: Amritsar, Anandpur Sahib and Chandigarh
page_title: Amritsar, Anandpur Sahib and Chandigarh – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days through Punjab: the Golden Temple and Wagah, Anandpur Sahib and the Virasat-e-Khalsa, and Chandigarh's Rock Garden and Sukhna lake.
cities: Amritsar - Golden Temple - Anandpur Sahib - Chandigarh - Pinjore

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Amritsar)Arrive in Amritsar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Amritsar airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at the Wagah border ceremony, evening at the Golden Temple reflected in the Amrit Sarovar. Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Amritsar)Amritsar
itinerary.text: The Prakash at dawn, the langar kitchen, the Central Sikh Museum, Jallianwala Bagh, and the Partition Museum (closed Mondays). Overnight stay in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Anandpur Sahib)Amritsar to Anandpur Sahib
itinerary.text: Drive to Anandpur Sahib (about 200 km). Darshan at Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib and an afternoon at the Virasat-e-Khalsa museum (closed Mondays). Overnight stay at Anandpur Sahib.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Chandigarh)Anandpur Sahib to Chandigarh
itinerary.text: Drive to Chandigarh (about 85 km). See the Rock Garden that Nek Chand built from waste, the Sukhna lake at sunset and the Rose Garden. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Pinjore – departure
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Mughal-style Pinjore (Yadavindra) gardens (about 20 km), then the transfer to Chandigarh airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Chandigarh City Break
name: Chandigarh City Break
page_title: Chandigarh City Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Chandigarh, India's planned city: the Rock Garden, Sukhna lake, Le Corbusier's Capitol Complex, the museum and Pinjore gardens.
cities: Chandigarh - Rock Garden - Sukhna Lake - Capitol Complex - Pinjore

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Chandigarh)Arrive in Chandigarh
itinerary.text: Arrive at Chandigarh airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Rock Garden, a maze of sculptures that Nek Chand made from broken pottery and waste, and walk the Sukhna lake promenade at sunset with the Shivalik hills behind. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Chandigarh)Le Corbusier's city and Pinjore
itinerary.text: Join a guided visit to the Capitol Complex, Le Corbusier's UNESCO-listed group of the High Court, Assembly and Open Hand Monument (registration needed; entry paid locally), then the Government Museum and the Rose Garden. In the afternoon, the terraced Mughal-style Pinjore gardens (about 20 km). Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a walk through the Sector 17 plaza, the transfer to Chandigarh airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Chandigarh and Royal Patiala
name: Chandigarh and Royal Patiala
page_title: Chandigarh and Royal Patiala – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days from Chandigarh to the royal city of Patiala: the Qila Mubarak and Sheesh Mahal, Fatehgarh Sahib and Dukh Niwaran Sahib.
cities: Chandigarh - Patiala - Fatehgarh Sahib - Rock Garden

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Chandigarh)Arrive in Chandigarh
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Chandigarh airport or station. Afternoon at the Rock Garden and the Rose Garden, evening by the Sukhna lake. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Patiala)Chandigarh to Patiala via Fatehgarh Sahib
itinerary.text: Drive to Fatehgarh Sahib, where the younger sons of Guru Gobind Singh were martyred, then on to Patiala (about 70 km from Chandigarh). Evening at the Gurdwara Dukh Niwaran Sahib. Overnight stay in Patiala.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Chandigarh)Qila Mubarak and Sheesh Mahal
itinerary.text: See the Qila Mubarak of the Patiala maharajas, the mirrored Sheesh Mahal with its painted walls and museum, and the Moti Bagh palace from outside; shop for Patiala jutti and phulkari in the Adalat bazaar. Return to Chandigarh. Overnight stay in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Chandigarh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the Government Museum or the Pinjore gardens before the transfer to Chandigarh airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Takht Sahib Yatra: Anandpur Sahib and Talwandi Sabo
name: Takht Sahib Yatra: Anandpur Sahib and Talwandi Sabo
page_title: Takht Sahib Yatra: Anandpur Sahib and Talwandi Sabo – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days to two of the five Takhts of the Sikhs: Kesgarh Sahib at Anandpur Sahib and Damdama Sahib at Talwandi Sabo, with Fatehgarh Sahib.
cities: Chandigarh - Anandpur Sahib - Fatehgarh Sahib - Talwandi Sabo - Bathinda

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Anandpur Sahib)Chandigarh to Anandpur Sahib
itinerary.text: Arrive at Chandigarh airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Anandpur Sahib (about 85 km). Evening darshan at Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib, where the Khalsa was created on Baisakhi 1699. Overnight stay at Anandpur Sahib.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Anandpur Sahib)Anandpur Sahib
itinerary.text: Visit the Virasat-e-Khalsa museum (closed Mondays), the Qila Anandgarh Sahib and Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib, and Kiratpur Sahib on the Sutlej. Overnight stay at Anandpur Sahib.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Patiala)Fatehgarh Sahib – Patiala
itinerary.text: Drive to Fatehgarh Sahib for the gurdwaras of the Sahibzadas, then Patiala for the Dukh Niwaran Sahib. Overnight stay in Patiala.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Bathinda)Talwandi Sabo – Damdama Sahib
itinerary.text: Drive to Talwandi Sabo (about 170 km) for Takht Sri Damdama Sahib, where Guru Gobind Singh completed the Guru Granth Sahib, then Bathinda's Qila Mubarak, one of the oldest forts in India. Overnight stay in Bathinda.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Bathinda
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the transfer to Bathinda railway station or airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Bodh Gaya: Place of Enlightenment
page_title: Bodh Gaya: Place of Enlightenment – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Bodh Gaya: the Mahabodhi temple and Bodhi tree, the monasteries of the Buddhist world, the Great Buddha, and the Dungeshwari caves.
cities: Gaya - Bodh Gaya - Mahabodhi Temple - Dungeshwari

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bodh Gaya)Arrive in Bodh Gaya
itinerary.text: Arrive at Gaya airport or railway station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Bodh Gaya (about 15 km). In the evening, sit under the Bodhi tree as monks from many countries chant at the Mahabodhi temple, its 55-metre tower lit up. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bodh Gaya)Temples and monasteries
itinerary.text: Visit the Mahabodhi temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with the Bodhi tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment and the Vajrasana diamond throne, then the monasteries built by Thailand, Japan, Bhutan and Tibet and the 25-metre Great Buddha statue. In the afternoon, the Dungeshwari (Mahakala) caves where the Buddha practised austerities, and Sujata's stupa across the Niranjana river. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Gaya
itinerary.text: A quiet early hour of meditation at the Mahabodhi temple, then the transfer to Gaya airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Gaya)Pind daan
itinerary.text: Perform pind daan for your ancestors at the Phalgu ghats and the Vishnupad, then at the Akshayavat, the immortal banyan, as the priest advises; many families also offer at Pretshila and Ramshila hills (priest's fees and offerings paid locally). In the evening, an optional visit to the Mahabodhi temple at Bodh Gaya (about 15 km). Overnight stay in Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Gaya
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a final offering if the rites need it, the transfer to Gaya airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda
name: Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda
page_title: Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days on the Buddha's path in Bihar: Bodh Gaya, the Vulture's Peak and Shanti Stupa at Rajgir, and the ruins of Nalanda, ending in Patna.
cities: Gaya - Bodh Gaya - Rajgir - Nalanda - Patna

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bodh Gaya)Arrive in Bodh Gaya
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Gaya airport or station for the short drive to Bodh Gaya. Evening chanting at the Mahabodhi temple under the Bodhi tree. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bodh Gaya)Bodh Gaya
itinerary.text: Visit the Mahabodhi temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with the Bodhi tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment and the Vajrasana diamond throne, then the monasteries built by Thailand, Japan, Bhutan and Tibet and the 25-metre Great Buddha statue. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Rajgir)Bodh Gaya to Rajgir
itinerary.text: Drive to Rajgir (about 80 km), the old Magadha capital in a ring of hills. Take the ropeway up Ratnagiri to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa (paid locally) and walk to Griddhakuta, the Vulture's Peak, where the Buddha preached; then the Venuvana bamboo grove and the hot springs at Brahmakund. Overnight stay in Rajgir.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Patna)Nalanda – Patna
itinerary.text: Visit the ruins of Nalanda Mahavihara, the ancient university and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its museum and the Xuanzang memorial (about 15 km), then the Jal Mandir at Pawapuri and on to Patna (about 90 km). Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Patna
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the Bihar Museum (closed Mondays) or the Golghar granary, then the transfer to Patna airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Jain Pilgrimage: Pawapuri, Rajgir and Kundalpur
name: Jain Pilgrimage: Pawapuri, Rajgir and Kundalpur
page_title: Jain Pilgrimage: Pawapuri, Rajgir and Kundalpur – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Jain trail of Bihar: Pawapuri's Jal Mandir where Mahavira attained nirvana, the sacred hills of Rajgir and Kundalpur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rajgir)Patna to Pawapuri and Rajgir
itinerary.text: Arrive at Patna airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Pawapuri (about 95 km), where Bhagwan Mahavira attained nirvana. See the Jal Mandir of white marble in its lotus pond and the Gaon Mandir, then continue to Rajgir. Overnight stay in Rajgir.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Rajgir)The five hills of Rajgir
itinerary.text: In the morning, climb to the Jain temples on Vipulachal and the other sacred hills of Rajgir, where Mahavira spent many rainy seasons; in the afternoon, the Veerayatan museum and the hot springs at Brahmakund. Overnight stay in Rajgir.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Patna)Kundalpur and Nalanda – Patna
itinerary.text: Visit Kundalpur, honoured by many as the birthplace of Mahavira, with its Nandyavarta palace temple, and the ruins of Nalanda nearby, then drive to Patna. Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Patna
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the Patna Museum or Gandhi Maidan, then the transfer to Patna airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Patna, Vaishali and Kesaria
name: Patna, Vaishali and Kesaria
page_title: Patna, Vaishali and Kesaria – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in north Bihar: the Bihar Museum and Golghar in Patna, Vaishali's Ashokan pillar and relic stupa, and the great terraced stupa of Kesaria.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Patna)Arrive in Patna
itinerary.text: Arrive at Patna airport or station, where our representative meets you. Spend the afternoon at the Bihar Museum, with its Didarganj Yakshi and Mauryan galleries (closed Mondays), then climb the Golghar granary for the view of the Ganga. Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vaishali)Patna to Vaishali
itinerary.text: Cross the Ganga by the Mahatma Gandhi Setu to Vaishali (about 55 km), where the Buddha preached his last sermon. See the Ashokan lion pillar at Kolhua, the relic stupa, the Abhishek Pushkarini tank and the Japanese Vishwa Shanti Stupa. Overnight stay in Vaishali.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Patna)Kesaria stupa – Patna
itinerary.text: Drive to Kesaria (about 50 km) for the tallest excavated Buddhist stupa in India, rising in terraces from the fields, then back to Patna. Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Patna
itinerary.text: After breakfast and darshan at Takht Sri Harimandir Ji, Patna Sahib, if you wish, the transfer to Patna airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Patna)Arrive in Patna – Patna Sahib
itinerary.text: Arrive at Patna airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening darshan at Takht Sri Harimandir Ji, Patna Sahib, the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh and one of the five Takhts, with its museum of the Guru's relics; stay for the Rehras and the langar. Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Patna)The gurdwaras of Patna
itinerary.text: Morning darshan, then the Gurdwara Bal Lila, where the young Guru played, the Gurdwara Gai Ghat on the Ganga, visited by Guru Nanak, and the Gurdwara Guru ka Bagh. In the afternoon, the Bihar Museum (closed Mondays) and the Gandhi Ghat aarti. Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Patna
itinerary.text: After an early darshan at the Takht Sahib, the transfer to Patna airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Buddhist Circuit: Bodh Gaya to Kushinagar
name: Buddhist Circuit: Bodh Gaya to Kushinagar
page_title: Buddhist Circuit: Bodh Gaya to Kushinagar – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days on the Buddhist circuit: enlightenment at Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda, the last sermon at Vaishali, and the mahaparinirvana at Kushinagar.
cities: Gaya - Bodh Gaya - Rajgir - Nalanda - Vaishali - Kushinagar - Gorakhpur

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bodh Gaya)Arrive in Bodh Gaya
itinerary.text: Arrive at Gaya airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening at the Mahabodhi temple and the Bodhi tree, where the Buddha attained enlightenment. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bodh Gaya)Bodh Gaya
itinerary.text: A full day: the Mahabodhi temple and its seven sacred spots, the Great Buddha, the international monasteries and the Archaeological Museum, with the Dungeshwari caves in the afternoon. Overnight stay in Bodh Gaya.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Rajgir)Bodh Gaya to Rajgir
itinerary.text: Drive to Rajgir (about 80 km): the ropeway to the Vishwa Shanti Stupa, the Vulture's Peak and the Venuvana monastery gifted by King Bimbisara. Overnight stay in Rajgir.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Patna)Nalanda – Patna
itinerary.text: The ruins and museum of Nalanda, the Buddhist university that drew scholars from across Asia, then on to Patna (about 90 km). Overnight stay in Patna.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Vaishali)Patna to Vaishali
itinerary.text: Visit the Bihar Museum (closed Mondays) and cross the Ganga to Vaishali for the Ashokan pillar at Kolhua and the relic stupa. Overnight stay in Vaishali.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kushinagar)Kesaria to Kushinagar
itinerary.text: Drive north via the Kesaria stupa to Kushinagar in Uttar Pradesh (about 230 km), where the Buddha attained mahaparinirvana. Evening at the Mahaparinirvana temple and its reclining Buddha. Overnight stay in Kushinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Ramabhar stupa – Gorakhpur
itinerary.text: A morning at the Ramabhar stupa, the cremation place of the Buddha, then drive to Gorakhpur (about 55 km) for your onward flight or train. The tour ends here.

title: Valmiki Tiger Reserve
name: Valmiki Tiger Reserve
page_title: Valmiki Tiger Reserve – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Valmiki Tiger Reserve on the Gandak river and the Nepal border: jeep safaris, river boats and the Tharu villages of Champaran.
cities: Patna - Valmikinagar - Valmiki Tiger Reserve - Gandak River

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Valmikinagar)Patna to Valmikinagar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Patna airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north through Champaran to Valmikinagar on the Nepal border (about 300 km, 7 hours), on the Gandak river below the Shivalik hills. Overnight stay at Valmikinagar (simple eco-stays).

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Valmikinagar)Valmiki Tiger Reserve
itinerary.text: A morning jeep safari in Valmiki Tiger Reserve, Bihar's only tiger reserve, for leopards, sloth bears, deer and many birds, with tigers seen only rarely (safari paid locally). In the afternoon, a boat on the Gandak (paid locally) and the Gandak barrage. Overnight stay at Valmikinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Valmikinagar)Forest and Tharu villages
itinerary.text: A second safari or a forest walk with a guide, and a visit to a Tharu village to see their farming and crafts. Overnight stay at Valmikinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Valmikinagar to Patna
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Patna (about 300 km), with a stop at Bettiah or the Bhitiharwa ashram of Gandhiji's Champaran satyagraha if time allows. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kolkata)Dakshineswar, Belur Math and the old city

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Kolkata

title: Sundarbans Mangrove Break
name: Sundarbans Mangrove Break
page_title: Sundarbans Mangrove Break – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest: boat days through tidal creeks to the watchtowers and the Dobanki canopy walk.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Sundarbans)Kolkata to the Sundarbans
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Kolkata for the drive to Godkhali jetty (about 100 km, 3 hours), then a boat into the delta to your lodge on one of the islands. In the late afternoon, a village walk among the paddy and fish ponds, and a folk performance in the evening where offered. Overnight stay in the Sundarbans.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sundarbans)Creeks and watchtowers
itinerary.text: A full day by boat through the mangrove creeks of the Sundarbans tiger reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, stopping at the Sajnekhali, Sudhanyakhali and Dobanki watchtowers, with its canopy walk, for estuarine crocodiles, spotted deer, kingfishers and the rarely seen tiger (boat and permits paid locally or quoted). Overnight stay in the Sundarbans.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Sundarbans to Kolkata
itinerary.text: An early boat for birds on the creeks, then back to Godkhali and the drive to Kolkata for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Kolkata and the Sundarbans
page_title: Kolkata and the Sundarbans – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days pairing Kolkata's Victoria Memorial, Dakshineswar and Belur Math with two nights on the islands of the Sundarbans mangroves.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kolkata)Arrive in Kolkata
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kolkata airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening at the Victoria Memorial gardens and its sound-and-light show where running (paid locally), and a walk on Park Street. Overnight stay in Kolkata.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sundarbans)Kolkata to the Sundarbans
itinerary.text: Drive to Godkhali jetty and take the boat to your island lodge in the Sundarbans; afternoon on the river among the mangroves. Overnight stay in the Sundarbans.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Sundarbans)The mangrove creeks
itinerary.text: A day on the water to the Sajnekhali watchtower and mangrove interpretation centre, the Sudhanyakhali and Dobanki towers, watching for crocodiles, otters and kingfishers (boat and permits paid locally or quoted). Overnight stay in the Sundarbans.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Kolkata)Back to Kolkata – Dakshineswar
itinerary.text: Return by boat and road to Kolkata. In the afternoon, the Dakshineswar Kali temple and the ferry to Belur Math. Overnight stay in Kolkata.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Departure from Kolkata
itinerary.text: After breakfast, Kumartuli's potters, the Howrah Bridge and the flower market below it before the transfer to Kolkata airport or station. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mayapur)Kolkata to Mayapur
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Kolkata for the drive north to Mayapur (about 130 km, 4 hours), the birthplace of Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and the world headquarters of ISKCON. Evening aarti and kirtan at the Sri Mayapur Chandrodaya Mandir. Overnight stay in Mayapur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mayapur)Mayapur and Nabadwip
itinerary.text: Morning mangala aarti, then the Yogapith, the Srivas Angan and the Chand Kazi samadhi of Mayapur, and the view of the great Temple of the Vedic Planetarium. Cross the Ganga by ferry to Nabadwip (paid locally) for its old Gaudiya temples and the bathing ghats. Overnight stay in Mayapur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Mayapur to Kolkata
itinerary.text: After the morning kirtan and breakfast prasadam, drive back to Kolkata (about 130 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Gangasagar: Kapil Muni Temple
name: Gangasagar: Kapil Muni Temple
page_title: Gangasagar: Kapil Muni Temple – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days to Gangasagar on Sagar island, where the Ganga meets the sea: the holy dip at the confluence and the Kapil Muni temple.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Sagar Island)Kolkata to Sagar island
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Kolkata for the drive south to Harwood Point at Kakdwip (about 100 km), then the vessel across the Muriganga to Kachuberia on Sagar island (ferry paid locally) and the road to Gangasagar (about 30 km). Evening at the beach where the Ganga meets the Bay of Bengal. Overnight stay on Sagar island (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sagar Island)Holy dip and the Kapil Muni temple
itinerary.text: Take the holy dip at the confluence at dawn and have darshan at the Kapil Muni temple, where the sage is said to have meditated and freed King Sagar's sons. Later, visit the Sagar lighthouse and the island villages. Overnight stay on Sagar island.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Sagar island to Kolkata
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the ferry back to Kakdwip and the drive to Kolkata for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Shantiniketan and Bishnupur
name: Shantiniketan and Bishnupur
page_title: Shantiniketan and Bishnupur – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in rural Bengal: Tagore's Shantiniketan and the Sonajhuri haat, and the terracotta temples and Baluchari weavers of Bishnupur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Shantiniketan)Kolkata to Shantiniketan
itinerary.text: Arrive in Kolkata, where our representative meets you, and drive to Shantiniketan (about 160 km), Rabindranath Tagore's university town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Evening at the Kopai river. Overnight stay in Shantiniketan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shantiniketan)Visva-Bharati
itinerary.text: Walk through the Visva-Bharati campus with its open-air classes, the Uttarayan complex of Tagore's houses and the Rabindra Bhavana museum (check closing days), and the murals of Kala Bhavana; on Saturdays, the Sonajhuri haat of Baul singers and village crafts. Overnight stay in Shantiniketan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bishnupur)Shantiniketan to Bishnupur
itinerary.text: Drive to Bishnupur (about 150 km), the temple town of the Malla kings, for its terracotta temples: the Rasmancha, Shyam Rai with its carved panels, Jor Bangla and Madan Mohan, and the Dalmadal cannon. Visit a Baluchari sari weaver. Overnight stay in Bishnupur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Bishnupur to Kolkata
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a look at the terracotta horse makers of Panchmura, drive back to Kolkata (about 150 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Digha and Mandarmani Beaches
name: Digha and Mandarmani Beaches
page_title: Digha and Mandarmani Beaches – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Bengal coast: Mandarmani's long beach, Tajpur and the Shankarpur fishing harbour, and the seaside town of Digha.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mandarmani)Kolkata to Mandarmani
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Kolkata for the drive south-west to Mandarmani (about 170 km), a long beach of hard sand and red crabs on the Bay of Bengal. Evening on the beach. Overnight stay at Mandarmani.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Digha)Tajpur, Shankarpur and Digha
itinerary.text: Drive along the coast to the quiet Tajpur beach and the fishing harbour at Shankarpur, then on to Digha for the new Digha seafront promenade and an evening at the marine aquarium (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Digha.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Digha)Digha and Udaipur beach
itinerary.text: A free morning on the beach, then the Udaipur beach on the Odisha border and the Amarabati lake park; fresh fish at the Digha mohana market. Overnight stay in Digha.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Digha to Kolkata
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Kolkata (about 185 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Dooars: Gorumara and Jaldapara
name: Dooars: Gorumara and Jaldapara
page_title: Dooars: Gorumara and Jaldapara – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in the Dooars of north Bengal: tea gardens, the rhinos of Gorumara and Jaldapara, the Chilapata forest and the Toto village of Totopara.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Lataguri)Bagdogra to Lataguri
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bagdogra airport or New Jalpaiguri station, where our representative meets you, and drive east through the tea gardens of the Dooars to Lataguri (about 90 km), on the edge of Gorumara National Park. Overnight stay at Lataguri.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Lataguri)Gorumara
itinerary.text: Morning and afternoon visits to Gorumara's watchtowers, Jatraprasad and Medla, by forest-department jeep, for the one-horned rhino, gaur, elephants and peacocks (paid locally). Overnight stay at Lataguri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jaldapara)Lataguri to Jaldapara
itinerary.text: Drive to Jaldapara (about 85 km), stopping at the Chapramari forest and a tea estate. In the afternoon, a jeep safari in Jaldapara National Park, the home of the largest number of one-horned rhinos in Bengal (paid locally). Overnight stay at Jaldapara.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jaldapara)Chilapata and Totopara
itinerary.text: Visit the Chilapata forest and the ruins of the Nalraja fort, and the Toto village of Totopara near the Bhutan border. Overnight stay at Jaldapara.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Jaldapara to Bagdogra
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Bagdogra (about 140 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Mathura and Vrindavan from Delhi
page_title: Mathura and Vrindavan from Delhi – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days from Delhi to Krishna's land: the Janmabhoomi and Vishram Ghat in Mathura, and Banke Bihari, Nidhivan, ISKCON and the Prem Mandir in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vrindavan)Delhi to Mathura and Vrindavan
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Delhi for the drive down the Yamuna Expressway to Mathura (about 180 km). Have darshan at the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, the birthplace of Krishna, and the Dwarkadhish temple, then the evening aarti at Vishram Ghat on the Yamuna. Continue to Vrindavan (about 12 km). Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vrindavan)The temples of Vrindavan
itinerary.text: Morning darshan at the Banke Bihari temple, then the Radha Raman temple, the Nidhivan grove, the ISKCON Krishna Balaram Mandir and the Keshi Ghat on the Yamuna. In the evening, the Prem Mandir as its white marble is lit in changing colours. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Vrindavan to Delhi
itinerary.text: After an early aarti and breakfast, drive back to Delhi (about 160 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Mathura, Gokul and Mahavan
page_title: Mathura, Gokul and Mahavan – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in the Braj villages of Krishna's childhood: Gokul and Raman Reti, Mahavan and the Brahmand Ghat, the Dauji temple at Baldeo, and Mathura.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mathura)Delhi to Mathura
itinerary.text: Arrive in Delhi, where our representative meets you, and drive to Mathura (about 180 km). Afternoon darshan at the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi and the Mathura Government Museum of Kushan sculpture (closed Mondays), and the evening aarti at Vishram Ghat. Overnight stay in Mathura.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mathura)Gokul, Mahavan and Baldeo
itinerary.text: Cross the Yamuna to Gokul, where Krishna grew up with Nanda and Yashoda, for the Raman Reti sands and the Thakurani Ghat; Mahavan for the Chaurasi Khamba temple of eighty-four pillars and the Brahmand Ghat, where young Krishna showed his mother the universe in his mouth; and Baldeo for the Dauji temple of Balarama. Overnight stay in Mathura.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Mathura to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a stop for Mathura peda, drive back to Delhi (about 180 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

name: Braj Yatra: Vrindavan, Govardhan, Barsana and Nandgaon
page_title: Braj Yatra: Vrindavan, Govardhan, Barsana and Nandgaon – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the Braj yatra: the parikrama of Govardhan hill and Radha Kund, Radha's Barsana, Krishna's Nandgaon, and the temples of Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Vrindavan)Delhi to Vrindavan
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Delhi for the drive to Vrindavan (about 160 km). Evening darshan at the Banke Bihari temple and the Prem Mandir lit after dark. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vrindavan)Govardhan parikrama
itinerary.text: Drive to Govardhan (about 25 km), the hill Krishna lifted on his finger. Make the parikrama of the hill by e-rickshaw or on foot (about 21 km; e-rickshaw paid locally), with the Mukharvind, the Radha Kund and Shyam Kund, and the Kusum Sarovar. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Vrindavan)Barsana and Nandgaon
itinerary.text: Drive to Barsana, Radha's village, and climb to the Shriji (Radha Rani) temple on Bhanugarh hill, then Nandgaon, Krishna's home, for the Nand Bhawan on its hill. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Vrindavan to Delhi
itinerary.text: After an early darshan at the Radha Raman temple, drive back to Delhi (about 160 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mathura, Vrindavan, Haridwar and Rishikesh
name: Mathura, Vrindavan, Haridwar and Rishikesh
page_title: Mathura, Vrindavan, Haridwar and Rishikesh – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days from Krishna's Braj to the Ganga: Mathura and Vrindavan, then Haridwar's Har Ki Pauri aarti and the ashrams and bridges of Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Mathura)Delhi to Mathura
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Delhi for the drive to Mathura (about 180 km). Darshan at the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi and the Vishram Ghat aarti on the Yamuna. Overnight stay in Mathura.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vrindavan)Vrindavan
itinerary.text: A day in Vrindavan: the Banke Bihari, Radha Raman and ISKCON temples, the Nidhivan and Seva Kunj groves, and the Prem Mandir at dusk. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Haridwar)Vrindavan to Haridwar
itinerary.text: A long drive north to Haridwar (about 320 km, 7 hours). Evening Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri, with thousands of lamps floated on the river. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Haridwar)Haridwar temples
itinerary.text: Take the ropeways to the Mansa Devi and Chandi Devi temples on the hills (paid locally), and visit the Daksha Mahadev temple at Kankhal and the Bharat Mata Mandir. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Rishikesh)Haridwar to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: Drive to Rishikesh (about 25 km). Walk across Ram Jhula among the ashrams, see the Lakshman Jhula bridge, and attend the evening Ganga aarti at Parmarth Niketan or Triveni Ghat. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Rishikesh to Delhi
itinerary.text: After a morning by the river, drive back to Delhi (about 240 km, 6 hours) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Udaipur with Nathdwara and Eklingji
name: Udaipur with Nathdwara and Eklingji
page_title: Udaipur with Nathdwara and Eklingji – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Udaipur with darshan of Shrinathji at Nathdwara and Eklingji, plus the City Palace, Lake Pichola and Bagore ki Haveli.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Udaipur)Arrive in Udaipur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Udaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you. In the afternoon, visit the Jagdish temple and walk down to Gangaur Ghat, then the Bagore ki Haveli dance show of Rajasthani folk dances in the evening (paid locally). Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Udaipur)Nathdwara, Eklingji and Nagda
itinerary.text: Drive to Nathdwara (about 48 km) for darshan of Shrinathji, Krishna as a child holding up Govardhan, at one of the eight daily jhankis; return by Eklingji, the family deity of the Mewar rulers, with its 108 temples, and the carved Sas-Bahu temples at Nagda. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Udaipur)City Palace and Lake Pichola
itinerary.text: Spend the morning in the City Palace on Lake Pichola, then take a boat on the lake past the Jag Mandir (paid locally) and see the Saheliyon ki Bari garden and the Fateh Sagar lake at sunset. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there is time for the Sajjangarh (Monsoon) Palace view or a miniature-painting workshop before the transfer to Udaipur airport or station. The tour ends here.

name: Khatu Shyam and Salasar Balaji
page_title: Khatu Shyam and Salasar Balaji – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days from Jaipur for darshan at Khatu Shyam ji and Salasar Balaji, with Jaipur's Govind Dev ji, Birla Mandir and Moti Dungri.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Salasar)Jaipur to Khatu Shyam and Salasar
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Jaipur airport or station for the drive to Khatu (about 80 km) for darshan of Khatu Shyam ji, Barbarika, worshipped as Krishna in Kali Yuga, and the Shyam Kund. Continue to Salasar (about 100 km) for the evening aarti at the Salasar Balaji temple, where the Hanuman idol has a beard and moustache. Overnight stay at Salasar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jaipur)Salasar to Jaipur
itinerary.text: Early darshan at Salasar Balaji and the Anjani Mata temple nearby, then drive back to Jaipur. In the evening, visit the Govind Dev ji temple in the City Palace grounds and the Birla Mandir. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Jaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast and darshan at the Moti Dungri Ganesh temple, the transfer to Jaipur airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Mehandipur Balaji and Jaipur
name: Mehandipur Balaji and Jaipur
page_title: Mehandipur Balaji and Jaipur – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days from Jaipur: darshan at the Mehandipur Balaji temple, the Chand Baori stepwell of Abhaneri, and the temples and bazaars of Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jaipur)Jaipur to Mehandipur Balaji
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Mehandipur (about 105 km) for darshan at the Balaji temple, where Hanuman is worshipped with Pretraj Sarkar and Bhairav Baba. On the way back, stop at the Chand Baori stepwell of Abhaneri. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jaipur)Jaipur temples and the old city
itinerary.text: A morning at the Govind Dev ji temple, the Moti Dungri Ganesh temple and the Galta ji, the "monkey temple" in a gorge east of the city. In the afternoon, the Hawa Mahal and the bazaars of the pink city. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Jaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast and darshan at the Khole ke Hanuman ji temple on its hill, the transfer to Jaipur airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Ajmer Sharif and Pushkar
name: Ajmer Sharif and Pushkar
page_title: Ajmer Sharif and Pushkar – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days from Jaipur: ziyarat at the Ajmer Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti, and Pushkar's holy lake, Brahma temple and Savitri hill.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pushkar)Jaipur to Ajmer and Pushkar
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Jaipur airport or station for the drive to Ajmer (about 135 km). Visit the Dargah Sharif of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti for ziyarat (head covered), the Adhai Din ka Jhonpra mosque and the Ana Sagar lake, then cross the Nag Pahar to Pushkar (about 15 km) for the evening aarti on the ghats of the holy lake. Overnight stay in Pushkar.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Pushkar)Pushkar
itinerary.text: Morning at the Brahma temple, one of very few in India, then the ropeway to the Savitri temple on its hill for the view over the lake and the sand country (paid locally). Afternoon in the bazaar and on the Varaha and Gau ghats at sunset. Overnight stay in Pushkar.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Pushkar to Jaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Jaipur (about 150 km), with a stop at the Kishangarh marble market if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Delhi for the drive to Alwar (about 160 km). Afternoon jeep safari in Sariska Tiger Reserve for tigers, sambar and peacocks (paid locally). Overnight stay at Sariska.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Sariska)Bhangarh and the Neelkanth temples
itinerary.text: Drive to Bhangarh (about 50 km), the ruined 17th-century town said to be haunted (entry only between sunrise and sunset), and the Neelkanth temples in the hills. Evening by the Siliserh lake (boating paid locally). Overnight stay at Sariska.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Sariska to Delhi
itinerary.text: After an optional early safari (paid locally), drive back to Delhi (about 200 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary
name: Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary
page_title: Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days at Bharatpur's Keoladeo National Park, one of Asia's great bird sanctuaries, with Fatehpur Sikri, the Deeg water palace and Lohagarh fort.
cities: Agra - Bharatpur - Keoladeo - Deeg - Fatehpur Sikri

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bharatpur)Agra to Bharatpur via Fatehpur Sikri
itinerary.text: Arrive at Agra airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Fatehpur Sikri (about 40 km), Akbar's abandoned capital, then on to Bharatpur (about 20 km). In the late afternoon, enter Keoladeo National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, by cycle rickshaw with a naturalist guide (paid locally). Overnight stay in Bharatpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bharatpur)Keoladeo and Deeg
itinerary.text: A dawn walk or ride through the wetlands for painted storks, sarus cranes, pelicans and, in winter, ducks and geese from Central Asia (rickshaw or bicycle and guide paid locally). In the afternoon, the Deeg water palace with its gardens and fountains (about 35 km) and the Lohagarh fort of Bharatpur. Overnight stay in Bharatpur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Bharatpur to Agra
itinerary.text: An early birding hour, then drive back to Agra (about 55 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Hadoti: Kota, Bundi and Jhalawar
name: Hadoti: Kota, Bundi and Jhalawar
page_title: Hadoti: Kota, Bundi and Jhalawar – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the Hadoti country: Kota's palace and Chambal river, Bundi's murals and stepwells, and the Gagron water fort and Jhalrapatan temples.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kota)Arrive in Kota
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kota railway station, where our representative meets you. Visit the City Palace and the Rao Madho Singh museum in the Garh, then take a boat on the Chambal river below the gorge to look for gharials and birds (paid locally). Overnight stay in Kota.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bundi)Kota to Bundi
itinerary.text: Drive to Bundi (about 40 km), the blue town below the Taragarh fort. See the Garh Palace and its Chitrashala of Bundi-school murals, the carved Raniji ki Baori stepwell and the Sukh Mahal on the lake. Overnight stay in Bundi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Kota)Jhalawar and Gagron
itinerary.text: Drive to Jhalawar (about 125 km): the Gagron water fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site surrounded by two rivers, and the Sun temple and Chandrabhaga temples at Jhalrapatan. Return to Kota. Overnight stay in Kota.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Kota
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a walk through the Kota doria sari weavers' lanes at Kaithoon if time allows, then the transfer to Kota railway station. The tour ends here.

description: Four days in Marwar: Jodhpur's Mehrangarh fort and Jaswant Thada, the temples and dunes of Osian, Khimsar and the Bishnoi villages.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jodhpur)Arrive in Jodhpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jodhpur airport or station, where our representative meets you. Climb to the Mehrangarh fort on its rock, with its palaces and armoury museum (entry paid locally), then the white marble Jaswant Thada. Evening in the Sardar market under the clock tower. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Osian)Jodhpur to Osian
itinerary.text: Drive to Osian (about 65 km), an old caravan town on the edge of the Thar, for the 8th-century Mahavira Jain temple and the Sachiya Mata temple on its hill. In the late afternoon, a camel ride or jeep on the dunes is optional (paid locally), followed by a folk music evening at the camp. Overnight stay at Osian (standard camp or hotel).

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jodhpur)Khimsar – Jodhpur
itinerary.text: Drive to Khimsar (about 90 km), a village of dunes and a 15th-century fort, and see the Bishnoi villages known for protecting the blackbuck and chinkara, then back to Jodhpur. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Jodhpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the Umaid Bhawan Palace museum (entry paid locally) before the transfer to Jodhpur airport or station. The tour ends here.

description: Three days in Bikaner: the Junagarh fort and old havelis, the Karni Mata temple at Deshnoke, the camel research centre and Gajner lake.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Bikaner)Arrive in Bikaner
itinerary.text: Arrive at Bikaner railway station or airport, where our representative meets you. Visit the Junagarh fort, never conquered, with its painted and mirrored halls (entry paid locally), and walk through the old city to the Rampuria havelis and the Bhandasar Jain temple. Overnight stay in Bikaner.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Bikaner)Deshnoke and Gajner
itinerary.text: Drive to Deshnoke (about 30 km) for the Karni Mata temple, where thousands of rats are revered, and the camel research centre on the way back, with its camel-milk products (paid locally). In the afternoon, the lake and palace grounds at Gajner (about 30 km) for the birds and the view. Overnight stay in Bikaner.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Bikaner
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a taste of Bikaneri bhujia in the market, the transfer to Bikaner station or airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Jaisalmer, Tanot and Longewala
name: Jaisalmer, Tanot and Longewala
page_title: Jaisalmer, Tanot and Longewala – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in the far west: Jaisalmer's living fort and havelis, the border temple of Tanot Mata and the 1971 war memorial at Longewala.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jaisalmer)Arrive in Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: Arrive at Jaisalmer station or airport, where our representative meets you. Walk into the living Sonar Qila, the golden sandstone fort where people still live, its Jain temples and the Raj Mahal; sunset over the town from the fort walls. Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jaisalmer)Tanot and Longewala
itinerary.text: Drive towards the Pakistan border to the Tanot Mata temple (about 120 km), run by the Border Security Force, where shells that did not explode in 1971 are kept, then to the Longewala war memorial of the famous battle. Return to Jaisalmer. Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jaisalmer)Havelis and the Sam dunes
itinerary.text: See the Patwon ki Haveli, the Nathmal and Salim Singh havelis and the Gadisar lake. Late afternoon at the Sam dunes for sunset, with a camel ride optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: After breakfast, the Bada Bagh cenotaphs at sunrise if you wish, then the transfer to Jaisalmer station or airport. The tour ends here.

title: Ranakpur and Mount Abu
name: Ranakpur and Mount Abu
page_title: Ranakpur and Mount Abu – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days from Udaipur to the great Jain temples of Ranakpur and Dilwara, with Mount Abu's Nakki lake, Guru Shikhar and Achalgarh.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Ranakpur)Udaipur to Ranakpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Udaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive through the Aravalli hills to Ranakpur (about 95 km). Visit the 15th-century Chaumukha Jain temple, with its 1,444 carved marble pillars, none alike (visitors from noon), and the Sun temple nearby. Overnight stay at Ranakpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Mount Abu)Ranakpur to Mount Abu
itinerary.text: Drive to Mount Abu (about 160 km), Rajasthan's only hill station. In the afternoon, the Dilwara Jain temples, with marble carving so fine it seems translucent (photography not allowed), and sunset at the Nakki lake. Overnight stay in Mount Abu.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Mount Abu)Guru Shikhar and Achalgarh
itinerary.text: Drive up to Guru Shikhar, the highest point of the Aravallis, then Achalgarh fort and the Achaleshwar Mahadev temple, and an evening at the Sunset Point. Overnight stay in Mount Abu.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Mount Abu to Udaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Udaipur (about 165 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Jawai: Leopard Hills
name: Jawai: Leopard Hills
page_title: Jawai: Leopard Hills – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days at Jawai, where leopards live among granite hills, temples and Rabari herders, with the Jawai dam and its winter birds.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Jawai)Udaipur to Jawai
itinerary.text: Arrive at Udaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive north to the Jawai area near Bera (about 150 km), a land of granite hills where leopards live among the villages and temples of the Rabari herders. Late-afternoon jeep drive around the hills (paid locally). Overnight stay near Jawai (standard stay).

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jawai)Leopards and the Jawai dam
itinerary.text: A dawn jeep drive to watch leopards on the rocks as they return from the night (paid locally), then the Jawai dam reservoir for crocodiles, flamingos and cranes in winter, and a Rabari village to meet the herders in their red turbans. Overnight stay near Jawai.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Jawai to Udaipur
itinerary.text: After an early drive in the hills, travel back to Udaipur (about 150 km) for your onward journey, with Ranakpur possible on the way. The tour ends here.

title: Banswara and Dungarpur
name: Banswara and Dungarpur
page_title: Banswara and Dungarpur – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Vagad, Rajasthan's green south: Dungarpur's Juna Mahal, the islands of the Mahi at Banswara, Tripura Sundari and Mangarh Dham.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Dungarpur)Udaipur to Dungarpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Udaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive south to Dungarpur (about 110 km). Visit the Juna Mahal, a seven-storey palace with painted and mirrored rooms (entry paid locally), and watch the sunset over the Gaib Sagar lake. Overnight stay in Dungarpur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Banswara)Dungarpur to Banswara
itinerary.text: Drive to Banswara (about 110 km), the "city of a hundred islands" on the Mahi river. See the Tripura Sundari temple, the Mahi dam backwaters with their islands, and the Anand Sagar lake. Overnight stay in Banswara.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Banswara)Mangarh Dham and the Bhil villages
itinerary.text: Visit Mangarh Dham, the hill memorial to the Bhil people killed there in 1913, the Arthuna temple ruins, and a Bhil village of the Vagad region. Overnight stay in Banswara.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Banswara to Udaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Udaipur (about 160 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Udaipur, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer
name: Udaipur, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer
page_title: Udaipur, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days across western Rajasthan: the lakes of Udaipur, the Ranakpur temple, Jodhpur's Mehrangarh and the golden fort of Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Udaipur)Arrive in Udaipur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Udaipur airport or station, where our representative meets you. Evening boat on Lake Pichola (paid locally) and a walk to the Jagdish temple. Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Udaipur)Udaipur
itinerary.text: The City Palace and its museum, the Saheliyon ki Bari, the Fateh Sagar lake and the Bagore ki Haveli folk dance show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jodhpur)Udaipur to Jodhpur via Ranakpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive north through the Aravalli hills to Jodhpur (about 250 km), stopping at Ranakpur for the 15th-century Chaumukha Jain temple and its forest of 1,444 carved marble pillars (visitors from noon). Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jodhpur)Jodhpur
itinerary.text: The Mehrangarh fort, the Jaswant Thada, the Mandore gardens and the clock-tower market, with the Umaid Bhawan museum (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jaisalmer)Jodhpur to Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: Drive west across the Thar to Jaisalmer (about 285 km), past villages of round mud huts and herds of camels and goats. Watch the sunset turn the sandstone town gold from the walls of the fort. Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Jaisalmer)Jaisalmer and the Sam dunes
itinerary.text: The living Sonar Qila and its Jain temples, the Patwon ki Haveli and Gadisar lake, and sunset at the Sam dunes with a camel ride optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Departure from Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for the Bada Bagh cenotaphs or a last walk in the fort bazaar before the transfer to Jaisalmer station or airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Golden Triangle with Mathura and Vrindavan
name: Golden Triangle with Mathura and Vrindavan
page_title: Golden Triangle with Mathura and Vrindavan – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days on the Golden Triangle with Krishna's Mathura and Vrindavan: Delhi, the Braj temples, the Taj Mahal at sunrise and Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Delhi)Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Delhi airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon at Humayun's tomb and India Gate, and evening at the Gurudwara Bangla Sahib. Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vrindavan)Delhi to Mathura and Vrindavan
itinerary.text: Drive to Mathura (about 180 km) for the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, then Vrindavan for the Banke Bihari temple, ISKCON and the Prem Mandir lit at dusk. Overnight stay in Vrindavan.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Agra)Vrindavan to Agra
itinerary.text: Drive to Agra (about 70 km). Afternoon at the Agra Fort and the Mehtab Bagh, for the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna at sunset. Overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jaipur)Taj Mahal – Jaipur
itinerary.text: See the Taj Mahal at sunrise, when the white marble turns from pink to gold (closed Fridays), then drive to Jaipur (about 240 km), stopping at Fatehpur Sikri, Akbar's red-sandstone capital. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jaipur)Jaipur
itinerary.text: The Amber fort, the Hawa Mahal, the City Palace and the Jantar Mantar observatory (entry paid locally), and the bazaars of the pink city. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Jaipur to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a last stop at the Albert Hall museum or a block-printing shop in Sanganer, drive back to Delhi (about 280 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.
