title: Golden Triangle with Bharatpur
name: Golden Triangle with Bharatpur
page_title: Golden Triangle with Bharatpur – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days on the Golden Triangle with a night at Bharatpur: Delhi, the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort, the birds of Keoladeo, and Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Delhi)Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Delhi airport or station. In the afternoon, see the Qutub Minar, the 73-metre tower of the Delhi Sultanate, and Humayun's tomb, the garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal. Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Agra)Delhi to Agra
itinerary.text: Drive to Agra (about 230 km) by the Yamuna Expressway. Afternoon at the Agra Fort and the tomb of Itimad-ud-Daulah, the "baby Taj". Overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Bharatpur)Taj Mahal – Bharatpur
itinerary.text: See the Taj Mahal at sunrise (closed Fridays), then drive to Bharatpur via Fatehpur Sikri. Late-afternoon cycle-rickshaw ride into Keoladeo National Park with a guide (paid locally). Overnight stay in Bharatpur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jaipur)Keoladeo – Jaipur
itinerary.text: A dawn hour among the storks, cranes and winter ducks of Keoladeo, then drive to Jaipur (about 180 km). Evening in the bazaars. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jaipur)Jaipur
itinerary.text: A full day in Jaipur: the hilltop Amber fort and its mirror palace, a photo stop at the Jal Mahal in its lake, then the City Palace, the stone instruments of the Jantar Mantar and the façade of the Hawa Mahal (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Jaipur to Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Delhi (about 280 km), with a lunch stop on the highway at Behror or Neemrana, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Golden Triangle with Orchha and Khajuraho
name: Golden Triangle with Orchha and Khajuraho
page_title: Golden Triangle with Orchha and Khajuraho – 7 Nights / 8 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Eight days from Delhi to Khajuraho: the Golden Triangle of Delhi, Jaipur and Agra, then the Bundela town of Orchha and the Khajuraho temples.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Delhi)Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Delhi airport or station, where our representative meets you. Afternoon in Old Delhi: the Jama Masjid and a rickshaw through Chandni Chowk (paid locally). Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Jaipur)Delhi to Jaipur
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive south-west to Jaipur (about 280 km). In the evening, visit the white marble Birla Mandir below the Moti Dungri hill and walk through the Johari and Bapu bazaars of the pink city. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jaipur)Jaipur
itinerary.text: Climb to the Amber fort above the Maota lake for its mirror palace and ramparts, then the City Palace of the Kachwaha rulers, the Jantar Mantar observatory and the pink façade of the Hawa Mahal (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Agra)Jaipur to Agra
itinerary.text: Drive east to Agra (about 240 km), stopping at the Chand Baori in Abhaneri, a stepwell of 3,500 narrow steps, and at Fatehpur Sikri for the Buland Darwaza and the tomb of Salim Chishti. Overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Orchha)Taj Mahal – Orchha
itinerary.text: See the Taj Mahal at sunrise (closed Fridays) and the red Agra Fort, then drive south through Gwalior, with a view of its hill fort, to Orchha on the Betwa river (about 250 km). Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Orchha)Orchha
itinerary.text: A day in the old Bundela capital: the Jahangir Mahal built for the Mughal emperor's visit, the Ram Raja temple where Rama is worshipped as a king, the soaring Chaturbhuj temple, and the royal chhatris on the Betwa at sunset (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Orchha.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Khajuraho)Orchha to Khajuraho
itinerary.text: Drive to Khajuraho (about 175 km). Afternoon at the Western Group of temples and the evening light-and-sound show (paid locally). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : Departure from Khajuraho
itinerary.text: A morning at the Eastern Group's Jain temples and the Duladeo temple of the Southern Group, then the transfer to Khajuraho airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Jaisalmer
name: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Jaisalmer
page_title: Golden Triangle with Jodhpur and Jaisalmer – 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Nine days from Delhi to the Thar: the Golden Triangle of Delhi, Agra and Jaipur, then Jodhpur's Mehrangarh and the golden fort of Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Delhi)Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Delhi airport or station. Afternoon at the Red Fort (closed Mondays), Raj Ghat and India Gate. Overnight stay in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Agra)Delhi to Agra
itinerary.text: Drive to Agra (about 230 km) by the Yamuna Expressway. Afternoon at the Agra Fort, where Shah Jahan spent his last years looking out at the Taj, and sunset over the Taj Mahal from the Mehtab Bagh across the river. Overnight stay in Agra.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Jaipur)Taj Mahal – Jaipur
itinerary.text: Enter the Taj Mahal at sunrise for the changing light on the marble (closed Fridays), then drive to Jaipur (about 240 km) via Fatehpur Sikri, Akbar's abandoned capital. Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Jaipur)Jaipur
itinerary.text: A day in the pink city: the Amber fort and its Sheesh Mahal, the City Palace museum, the giant sundials of the Jantar Mantar and the Hawa Mahal, with an evening in the bazaars (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Jodhpur)Jaipur to Jodhpur
itinerary.text: A long drive west to Jodhpur (about 340 km), passing Ajmer and the Aravalli hills. Evening in the Sardar market below the clock tower, with the blue houses of the old city climbing towards the fort. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Jodhpur)Jodhpur
itinerary.text: Climb to the Mehrangarh fort on its sheer rock, with its palaces, armoury and cradle galleries, then the white marble Jaswant Thada and the museum in the Umaid Bhawan Palace (entry paid locally). Overnight stay in Jodhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Jaisalmer)Jodhpur to Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: Drive west across the Thar Desert to Jaisalmer (about 285 km), arriving in time to see the sunset light up the golden sandstone fort from the Vyas Chhatri. Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Jaisalmer)Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: The Sonar Qila, the Patwon ki Haveli, the Gadisar lake, and sunset at the Sam dunes with an optional camel ride (paid locally). Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : Departure from Jaisalmer
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a stop at the Gadisar lake's carved gateway in the early light, then the transfer to Jaisalmer station or airport for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Delhi)New Delhi

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Delhi
itinerary.text: After breakfast, there may be time for the National Museum or Dilli Haat before the transfer to Delhi airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Prayagraj: Triveni Sangam
name: Prayagraj: Triveni Sangam
page_title: Prayagraj: Triveni Sangam – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Prayagraj: a boat to the Triveni Sangam for the holy dip, Bade Hanuman, the Akshayavat, Alopi Devi and Anand Bhawan.
cities: Prayagraj - Triveni Sangam - Bade Hanuman - Alopi Devi

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Prayagraj)Arrive in Prayagraj – the Sangam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Prayagraj airport or junction, where our representative meets you. Take a boat out to the Triveni Sangam, where the Ganga, the Yamuna and the unseen Saraswati meet, for a holy dip (boat paid locally), then darshan of the reclining Bade Hanuman near the fort. Evening Ganga aarti at the Sangam. Overnight stay in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Prayagraj)Akshayavat and Prayagraj
itinerary.text: Visit the Patalpuri temple and the Akshayavat, the undying banyan inside the Allahabad fort, the Alopi Devi Shakti Peeth, and Anand Bhawan, the Nehru family home (closed Mondays). In the afternoon, Chandrashekhar Azad Park and the Allahabad museum. Overnight stay in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Prayagraj
itinerary.text: After an early dip or a last boat at the Sangam, the transfer to Prayagraj airport or station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Prayagraj, Shringverpur and Chitrakoot
name: Prayagraj, Shringverpur and Chitrakoot
page_title: Prayagraj, Shringverpur and Chitrakoot – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days on the trail of Rama's exile: the Sangam at Prayagraj, Nishadraj's Shringverpur, and Chitrakoot's Ramghat, Kamadgiri and Sati Anusuya.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Prayagraj)Arrive in Prayagraj – Shringverpur
itinerary.text: Arrive at Prayagraj airport or junction, where our representative meets you. Drive to Shringverpur (about 40 km) on the Ganga, where the boatman Nishadraj ferried Rama, Sita and Lakshmana at the start of their exile, then return for the evening aarti at the Sangam. Overnight stay in Prayagraj.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Chitrakoot)Prayagraj to Chitrakoot
itinerary.text: Drive to Chitrakoot (about 125 km), the forest where Rama spent eleven years of his exile. Evening deepdaan and aarti at Ramghat on the Mandakini, with a boat ride optional (paid locally). Overnight stay in Chitrakoot.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Chitrakoot)Kamadgiri and Sati Anusuya
itinerary.text: Walk the parikrama of Kamadgiri, the hill said to grant every wish, then the Bharat Milap temple where Bharat met Rama, Gupt Godavari, Sphatik Shila and the forest ashram of Sati Anusuya. Overnight stay in Chitrakoot.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Chitrakoot to Prayagraj
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Prayagraj (about 125 km), with a dip at the Sangam if time allows, for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Varanasi, Chunar and Vindhyachal
name: Varanasi, Chunar and Vindhyachal
page_title: Varanasi, Chunar and Vindhyachal – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days from Varanasi: the Kashi Vishwanath corridor and Ganga aarti, the Chunar fort, and the Vindhyavasini Shakti Peeth and trikon parikrama.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Varanasi)Arrive in Varanasi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Varanasi airport or station, where our representative meets you. Walk through the Kashi Vishwanath Dham corridor for darshan of the Jyotirlinga, then watch the Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat from the steps or a boat (paid locally). Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Vindhyachal)Chunar fort and Vindhyachal
itinerary.text: Drive to the Chunar fort on its rock above the Ganga (about 40 km), held in turn by Sher Shah, the Mughals and the British, then on to Vindhyachal for darshan at the Vindhyavasini Devi Shakti Peeth and the trikon parikrama of the Ashtabhuja and Kali Khoh temples. Overnight stay at Vindhyachal or Mirzapur.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Varanasi)Vindhyachal to Varanasi
itinerary.text: An early darshan at Vindhyavasini, then drive back to Varanasi (about 75 km). Afternoon at the Sankat Mochan Hanuman temple and the Banaras Hindu University's Bharat Kala Bhavan museum. Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Departure from Varanasi
itinerary.text: A sunrise boat along the ghats from Assi to Manikarnika (paid locally), then the transfer to Varanasi airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Varanasi, Ayodhya and Gorakhpur
name: Varanasi, Ayodhya and Gorakhpur
page_title: Varanasi, Ayodhya and Gorakhpur – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days on the Ganga and the Saryu: Varanasi's ghats and Kashi Vishwanath, Sarnath, the Ram Janmabhoomi temple at Ayodhya, and Gorakhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Varanasi)Arrive in Varanasi
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you at Varanasi airport or station. Evening Ganga aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, watched from a boat on the river (paid locally). Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Varanasi)Kashi Vishwanath and Sarnath
itinerary.text: A sunrise boat along the ghats, darshan at the Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga, then Sarnath (about 10 km), where the Buddha gave his first sermon, with the Dhamek stupa and the museum of the Ashokan lion capital (closed Fridays). Overnight stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ayodhya)Varanasi to Ayodhya
itinerary.text: Drive to Ayodhya (about 210 km). Evening Saryu aarti at the Ram ki Paidi ghats. Overnight stay in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ayodhya)Ram Janmabhoomi and Hanumangarhi
itinerary.text: Darshan at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi temple (security checks; phones are deposited), then Hanumangarhi, the Kanak Bhawan of Sita and the Dashrath Mahal; the Guptar Ghat in the evening. Overnight stay in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gorakhpur)Ayodhya to Gorakhpur
itinerary.text: Drive to Gorakhpur (about 135 km) for the Gorakhnath temple of the Nath yogis and the Gita Press, publisher of Hindu scriptures, with its Leela Chitra Mandir. Evening at the Ramgarh Tal lake. Overnight stay in Gorakhpur.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Gorakhpur
itinerary.text: After breakfast and an early darshan at the Gorakhnath temple, the transfer to Gorakhpur airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Lucknow: the City of Nawabs
name: Lucknow: the City of Nawabs
page_title: Lucknow: the City of Nawabs – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Lucknow: the Bara Imambara and its maze, the Rumi Darwaza, the Chota Imambara, the 1857 Residency, Awadhi food and chikankari.
cities: Lucknow - Bara Imambara - Rumi Darwaza - Residency

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Lucknow)Arrive in Lucknow – the Imambaras
itinerary.text: Arrive at Lucknow airport or station, where our representative meets you. Visit the Bara Imambara and its Bhool Bhulaiya maze of passages, the Asafi mosque and the stepwell, then the Rumi Darwaza gate and the Chota Imambara lit with chandeliers (entry paid locally). Evening in the Chowk for Awadhi kebabs. Overnight stay in Lucknow.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Lucknow)The Residency and Hazratganj
itinerary.text: See the ruined British Residency of the 1857 siege and its museum, the Husainabad clock tower and picture gallery, and the Ambedkar memorial park; afternoon on Hazratganj and in the chikankari embroidery shops of Aminabad. Overnight stay in Lucknow.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Departure from Lucknow
itinerary.text: After breakfast and a stop at the La Martiniere college façade on the Gomti, the transfer to Lucknow airport or station. The tour ends here.

title: Char Dham Yatra from Rishikesh
name: Char Dham Yatra from Rishikesh
page_title: Char Dham Yatra from Rishikesh – 9 Nights / 10 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Ten days from Rishikesh to all four dhams of Uttarakhand: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath, with a night at Kedarnath and Mana village.
cities: Rishikesh - Barkot - Yamunotri - Uttarkashi - Gangotri - Guptkashi - Kedarnath - Badrinath

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Barkot)Rishikesh to Barkot
itinerary.text: Our representative meets you in Rishikesh for the drive into the Yamuna valley to Barkot (about 210 km, 7–8 hours) via Mussoorie and the Kempty falls. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Barkot)Yamunotri
itinerary.text: Drive to Janki Chatti (about 45 km) and walk the 6 km path up to Yamunotri (ponies or palkis paid locally). Bathe in the Surya Kund hot spring, cook rice in its water as prasad, and have darshan of Yamuna Devi. Return to Barkot. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Uttarkashi)Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: Drive to Uttarkashi (about 100 km) on the Bhagirathi. Evening darshan at the Kashi Vishwanath temple of Uttarkashi. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Uttarkashi)Gangotri
itinerary.text: Drive to Gangotri (about 100 km) through Harsil, bathe in the Bhagirathi and have darshan at the Gangotri temple, with a stop at the Gangnani hot spring on the way back. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Guptkashi)Uttarkashi to Guptkashi
itinerary.text: A long drive via Tehri lake and the Mandakini valley to Guptkashi (about 220 km). Overnight stay in Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Kedarnath)Kedarnath
itinerary.text: Drive to Sonprayag and take the shuttle to Gaurikund, then walk the 16 km path up to Kedarnath (ponies, palkis or porters paid locally). Evening aarti at the Kedarnath Jyotirlinga. Overnight stay at Kedarnath (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Guptkashi)Kedarnath to Guptkashi
itinerary.text: Early darshan at Kedarnath and the Bhairavnath temple above it, then walk down to Gaurikund and drive to Guptkashi. Overnight stay in Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Badrinath)Guptkashi to Badrinath
itinerary.text: Drive via Chopta and Joshimath to Badrinath (about 190 km). Bathe in the Tapt Kund and attend the evening aarti at the Badrinath temple. Overnight stay in Badrinath.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : (Rudraprayag)Badrinath – Mana – Rudraprayag
itinerary.text: Early darshan at Badrinath, then Mana, the last village before Tibet, with the Vyas Gufa and Bhim Pul; drive down to Rudraprayag at the confluence of the Alaknanda and Mandakini. Overnight stay in Rudraprayag.

itinerary.title: Day 10 : Rudraprayag to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive down via Devprayag, where the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda join as the Ganga, to Rishikesh (about 140 km). The tour ends here.

title: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar, with Harsil
name: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar, with Harsil
page_title: Yamunotri and Gangotri from Haridwar, with Harsil – 5 Nights / 6 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Six days to Yamunotri and Gangotri with a night at Harsil, the apple village near Gangotri, and the Har Ki Pauri aarti at Haridwar.
cities: Haridwar - Barkot - Yamunotri - Harsil - Gangotri - Uttarkashi

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Barkot)Haridwar to Barkot
itinerary.text: Arrive at Haridwar station, where our representative meets you, and drive via Dehradun and Mussoorie to Barkot in the Yamuna valley (about 220 km). Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Barkot)Yamunotri
itinerary.text: Drive to Janki Chatti and walk up the 6 km trail to Yamunotri (ponies or palkis paid locally), with darshan of Yamuna Devi and the Divya Shila and Surya Kund. Return to Barkot. Overnight stay in Barkot.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Harsil)Barkot to Harsil
itinerary.text: Drive to Uttarkashi and up the Bhagirathi to Harsil (about 175 km), a quiet village of apple orchards and deodar forest. Visit Mukhba, the winter seat of Ganga Maa, across the river. Overnight stay in Harsil.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Uttarkashi)Gangotri – Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: An early drive to Gangotri (about 25 km) for darshan at the temple and a dip in the Bhagirathi, then down to Uttarkashi via the Gangnani hot spring. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Haridwar)Uttarkashi to Haridwar
itinerary.text: Drive down via Chamba and Rishikesh to Haridwar (about 170 km). Evening Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : Departure from Haridwar
itinerary.text: After a morning dip at Har Ki Pauri, the transfer to Haridwar station for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Hemkund Sahib and the Valley of Flowers
name: Hemkund Sahib and the Valley of Flowers
page_title: Hemkund Sahib and the Valley of Flowers – 6 Nights / 7 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Seven days for the Valley of Flowers and Gurdwara Hemkund Sahib: the walk to Ghangaria, the alpine meadows and the high lake, from Haridwar.
cities: Haridwar - Joshimath - Govindghat - Ghangaria - Valley of Flowers - Hemkund Sahib

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Joshimath)Haridwar to Joshimath
itinerary.text: Arrive at Haridwar station, where our representative meets you, and drive up the Alaknanda valley via Devprayag and Rudraprayag to Joshimath (about 270 km, 9–10 hours). Overnight stay in Joshimath.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Ghangaria)Govindghat to Ghangaria
itinerary.text: Drive to Govindghat and Pulna, then walk about 10 km up the Lakshman Ganga valley to Ghangaria (ponies or porters paid locally). Overnight stay at Ghangaria (simple stays).

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Ghangaria)Valley of Flowers
itinerary.text: Walk into the Valley of Flowers National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site (about 4 km in; forest permit paid locally), a high meadow of hundreds of alpine flowers at its best from July to early September. Return to Ghangaria. Overnight stay at Ghangaria.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Ghangaria)Hemkund Sahib
itinerary.text: Climb about 6 km to Gurdwara Hemkund Sahib by its glacial lake at about 4,150 metres, where Guru Gobind Singh is said to have meditated in a past life, with the Lokpal Lakshman temple beside it (ponies paid locally). Return to Ghangaria. Overnight stay at Ghangaria.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Joshimath)Ghangaria to Joshimath
itinerary.text: Walk down to Pulna and drive to Joshimath, with an optional visit to Badrinath (about 45 km) if time allows. Overnight stay in Joshimath.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Rudraprayag)Joshimath to Rudraprayag
itinerary.text: Drive down to Rudraprayag (about 140 km), stopping at Nandprayag and Karnaprayag on the Alaknanda. Overnight stay in Rudraprayag.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : Rudraprayag to Haridwar
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Haridwar (about 160 km) via Devprayag for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Adi Kailash and Om Parvat
name: Adi Kailash and Om Parvat
page_title: Adi Kailash and Om Parvat – 8 Nights / 9 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Nine days to the high Vyas valley on the China border: Om Parvat from Nabhidang and Adi Kailash with Parvati Kund, staying at Gunji.
cities: Kathgodam - Pithoragarh - Dharchula - Gunji - Om Parvat - Adi Kailash

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Pithoragarh)Kathgodam to Pithoragarh
itinerary.text: Arrive at Kathgodam station, where our representative meets you, and drive through Almora to Pithoragarh (about 210 km), the "little Kashmir" of Kumaon. Overnight stay in Pithoragarh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Dharchula)Pithoragarh to Dharchula
itinerary.text: Drive along the Kali river, the border with Nepal, to Dharchula (about 95 km). Complete the Inner Line Permit and medical formalities at the SDM office. Overnight stay in Dharchula.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Gunji)Dharchula to Gunji
itinerary.text: Drive up the Vyas valley past Budhi and the Chhiyalekh pass to Gunji (about 80 km), a Rung village at about 3,200 metres. Overnight stay in Gunji (simple homestays).

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Gunji)Acclimatisation at Gunji
itinerary.text: A rest day to get used to the altitude: an easy walk through Gunji and the neighbouring village of Napalchu, with their carved wooden houses, and a drive to the Kali temple at Kalapani, the source of the Kali river. Overnight stay in Gunji.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : (Gunji)Om Parvat
itinerary.text: Drive to Nabhidang (about 25 km) to see Om Parvat, where the snow on the rock face forms the sacred "Om", and return to Gunji. Overnight stay in Gunji.

itinerary.title: Day 6 : (Gunji)Adi Kailash and Parvati Kund
itinerary.text: Drive to Jolingkong (about 35 km) for the view of Adi Kailash (Chhota Kailash) and its reflection in Parvati Kund, with the Gauri Kund and Shiva-Parvati temple; return via Kuti village. Overnight stay in Gunji.

itinerary.title: Day 7 : (Dharchula)Gunji to Dharchula
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back down the Vyas valley past Budhi and the waterfalls of the Kali gorge to Dharchula, where the road runs beside the river opposite Nepal. Overnight stay in Dharchula.

itinerary.title: Day 8 : (Pithoragarh)Dharchula to Pithoragarh
itinerary.text: Drive back to Pithoragarh along the Kali river, then visit the Kapileshwar Mahadev cave temple and the old Pithoragarh fort for the view over the Soar valley. Overnight stay in Pithoragarh.

itinerary.title: Day 9 : Pithoragarh to Kathgodam
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive through Almora, with a stop at the Chitai Golu Devta temple of hanging bells, to Kathgodam (about 210 km) for your onward train. The tour ends here.

title: Chakrata Hills
name: Chakrata Hills
page_title: Chakrata Hills – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days in Chakrata, a quiet deodar-forest hill town: the Kalsi rock edict, Tiger Falls, the Deoban viewpoint and the Budher caves.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Chakrata)Dehradun to Chakrata
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dehradun airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Chakrata (about 90 km), stopping at Kalsi for Emperor Ashoka's rock edict on the Yamuna. Evening walk through the deodar woods of this quiet cantonment town. Overnight stay in Chakrata.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Chakrata)Tiger Falls and Deoban
itinerary.text: Walk down to Tiger Falls (about 20 km by road, then a short path), one of the highest falls in the Garhwal hills, then drive up to Deoban for the view of the Himalayan peaks over the forest, or walk to the Budher caves with a guide (paid locally). Overnight stay in Chakrata.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Chakrata to Dehradun
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Dehradun (about 90 km), with a stop at the Robber's Cave (Guchhupani) or the Forest Research Institute if time allows. The tour ends here.

title: Kanatal and Tehri Lake
name: Kanatal and Tehri Lake
page_title: Kanatal and Tehri Lake – 3 Nights / 4 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Four days in Tehri Garhwal: the ridge of Kanatal, the ropeway to the Surkanda Devi temple, and boating on the great Tehri lake.
cities: Dehradun - Kanatal - Surkanda Devi - Tehri Lake

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Kanatal)Dehradun to Kanatal
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dehradun airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive via Mussoorie and Dhanaulti to Kanatal (about 80 km), a ridge of apple orchards and forest facing the snow peaks. Overnight stay at Kanatal.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Kanatal)Surkanda Devi and the Kodia forest
itinerary.text: Take the ropeway up to the Surkanda Devi temple, a Shakti Peeth on the ridge at about 2,750 metres, for the Himalayan view (paid locally), then a walk in the Kodia forest. Overnight stay at Kanatal.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Tehri)Kanatal to Tehri lake
itinerary.text: Drive down to New Tehri and the Tehri dam reservoir (about 40 km), one of the largest lakes in the Himalaya, for a boat ride or jet-ski on the water (paid locally) and the viewpoint over the dam. Overnight stay near Tehri lake.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : Tehri to Dehradun
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Dehradun (about 110 km) via Chamba and Rishikesh for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Rishikesh and Shivpuri
name: Rishikesh and Shivpuri
page_title: Rishikesh and Shivpuri – 2 Nights / 3 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Three days on the Ganga: Rishikesh's ashrams, bridges and aarti, a night at a riverside camp in Shivpuri, and sunrise at Kunjapuri.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Rishikesh)Haridwar to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: Arrive at Haridwar station, where our representative meets you, and drive to Rishikesh (about 25 km). Walk across Ram Jhula among the ashrams, see the Lakshman Jhula and the Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia; entry paid locally), and attend the evening Ganga aarti at Parmarth Niketan. Overnight stay in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Shivpuri)Shivpuri river camp
itinerary.text: Drive upstream to Shivpuri (about 16 km), where the Ganga runs through forested gorges. Optional white-water rafting back towards Rishikesh with a licensed operator (paid locally; September to June), or a walk to the Neer Garh waterfall; evening by the river at a standard camp. Overnight stay at Shivpuri.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : Kunjapuri sunrise – Haridwar
itinerary.text: An early drive to the Kunjapuri temple for sunrise over the Garhwal peaks, then back to Haridwar for your onward journey. The tour ends here.

title: Harsil Valley
name: Harsil Valley
page_title: Harsil Valley – 4 Nights / 5 Days | Holiday Guru Travel
description: Five days in the Harsil valley on the Bhagirathi: apple orchards and deodar forest, Gangotri darshan, Dharali and the winter seat of the Ganga at Mukhba.

itinerary.title: Day 1 : (Uttarkashi)Dehradun to Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: Arrive at Dehradun airport or station, where our representative meets you, and drive via Chamba and the Tehri lake to Uttarkashi on the Bhagirathi (about 145 km). Evening at the Kashi Vishwanath temple. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 2 : (Harsil)Uttarkashi to Harsil
itinerary.text: Drive up the Bhagirathi valley past the Gangnani hot spring to Harsil (about 75 km), a valley of apple orchards, deodar forest and wooden houses, first planted with apples by an Englishman, Frederick Wilson. Overnight stay in Harsil.

itinerary.title: Day 3 : (Harsil)Gangotri and Dharali
itinerary.text: A morning trip to Gangotri (about 25 km) for darshan and the Surya Kund falls, then walk through the orchards of Dharali and visit Mukhba, the winter home of the Ganga goddess. Overnight stay in Harsil.

itinerary.title: Day 4 : (Uttarkashi)Sattal – Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: A walk to the small lakes above Harsil, or a quiet morning by the river, then drive back to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay in Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 5 : Uttarkashi to Dehradun
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive back to Dehradun (about 145 km) for your onward journey. The tour ends here.
